**The problem it solves**

Handling digital costs, reimbursements, salaries, and planning finances is getting more and more challenging for remote workers, freelancers, and full-time employees with older and disjoined systems. The most prominent issues include reimbursement delays through manual handling, the absence of a central platform to have standard expense submission, and confusion because SaaS subscriptions are spread everywhere. Cross-border complexities of finances like currency conversion rates and tax adherence also complicate things. Further, workers do not have access to organized financial instruments such as EPF and mutual funds, suffer from tool overload on unconnected platforms, and have no escalation support for issues. The user of AI automation results in increased manual labor and decreased productivity overall.

Now our solution consist of Auto Reimbursements: Accelerates approvals and eliminates manual tracking.
Unified Expense Dashboard: Tracks all expense activities under one roof.
SaaS & Digital Tool Tracking: Eliminates duplicate subscriptions and streamlines reimbursements.
Global Finance Tools: Manages currency conversion, taxes, and compliance for distributed teams.
AI-Powered Tax & Salary Insights: Does calculations automatically and gives intelligent tax insights.
Smart Financial Planning: Assists in investing and saving with built-in tools.
Live Tracking & Support: Provides real-time reporting and transparent issue escalation.
AI-Driven UI: Reduces manual effort and increases productivity.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges We Faced
Building a unified, intelligent financial platform for remote workers and organizations came with its share of significant challenges—both technical and operational. As a small but focused team, Ideahunt had to navigate complex systems, user behavior patterns, and real-world edge cases. Here's a breakdown of some key hurdles we faced:
1. Designing a Dynamic Yet Intuitive Category System
Creating a flexible yet user-friendly expense categorization model was more challenging than expected. We had to:
Ensure adaptability across industries, job roles, and countries.
Account for tax-compliant grouping of expenses without overwhelming the end-user.
Balance automation with user control in selecting and modifying categories.

2. Aggregating Financial Data from Disparate Sources
Remote workers and companies use a wide variety of tools—wallets, banks, HRMS systems, tax portals, and SaaS subscriptions. Integrating and normalizing this data:
Required extensive API research and secure data handling protocols.
Involved syncing real-time data while preventing redundancy.
Demanded strong validation mechanisms to ensure accuracy and avoid duplicate claims or miscalculations.

3. Building for Scalability in Production
What worked in development often posed challenges in production:
Deployment pipelines had to be optimized to handle async tasks like email triggers, document uploads, and currency conversions.
Serverless architecture (like AWS Lambda or Vercel) introduced cold start and timeout constraints that needed optimization.
We also had to ensure minimal latency for real-time financial insights, regardless of user location.

4. Ensuring Security & Compliance
With sensitive financial and identity data involved, we prioritized:
End-to-end encryption and secure authentication (OAuth2, 2FA).
Adherence to GDPR, Indian IT laws, and international data privacy standards.

**FinTech & DeFi Innovations**

Our platform bridges the gap between finance and technology, offering a unified solution for remote workers and modern businesses in the gig economy. It simplifies complex financial tasks like expense tracking, payroll, reimbursements, tax compliance, and financial planning—bringing automation and intelligence to workflows that were once manual and disjointed.

Key FinTech Contributions:
Expense & Payroll Automation: Streamlined tracking, categorization, salary disbursement, and reimbursement handling.

Tax Compliance: Automated tax documentation and compliance tracking for global workers.
Financial Planning: Data-driven insights and alerts for better financial decisions.
Remote Workforce Support: Tools tailored for freelancers and distributed teams to manage payments, currencies, and wallets.
Embedded Finance: API-ready infrastructure for seamless integration into business ecosystems.

**What is the problem your project solves?**

There will be more than **a billion software engineers by next year**, and most of them will be non-technical people using Claude Code.

I have already met people building amazing applications with no technical background. I have met a sociology professor who built a complete pipeline to translate books from English to local languages. But the biggest hurdle for them is no longer creating software; it is deploying it. That includes deploying ML models, web apps, load balancers, and databases.

The bottleneck has now moved from development to deployment, and none of the cloud providers are catching up fast enough. It is still very difficult for non-technical vibe-coders to get their products out there.

**What is the deployed URL for this project?**

https://tinkerers.space

**How you are solving it?**

I have been homelabbing since my teens. A few months ago, I created an agentic loop that analyzes a repo or project, writes a Dockerfile based on the requirements, and deploys it.

Many of my friends who are Product Managers started using it to deploy their personal projects.

I realized we needed to build a new cloud platform for Agentic Engineering—one designed by people whose introduction to software engineering was through vibe-coding.

This new cloud, Tinkerers.Space, is agent-first: users (or their agents) do not need to install a CLI. Instead, they can provision GPUs, servers, and serverless instances through natural interaction. The best part is that it is cheaper and more convenient than AWS, GCP, or Azure; because we own and operate our own infrastructure.

**How Did You Use Claude?**

I tried to productionize it today by updating the CLI and adding Anthropic models along with OpenAI models.

I found Claude Managed Agents intriguing and was tempted to use them since they were solving a lot of my problems, especially those related to security. But I decided not to, due to two major concerns: a 5-hour hackathon is not ideal for testing out new technologies that require major rewrites and subsequent testing, and the concern of vendor-locking myself to Anthropic. Even though it seems they are winning the model wars, one can never be too sure.

However, one must say that using Claude Opus with Langchain DeepAgents did give a slightly better result than using the GPT model.

**Description of your solution**

**Verity**: Pioneering a Trusted Digital News Ecosystem

In an era where misinformation spreads faster than truth, we are thrilled to introduce Verity, a revolutionary social media platform engineered to build a global community founded on verified information. Verity is a dynamic short-form video app where credibility is paramount. Our mission is to empower creators and consumers to foster a healthier, more truthful digital world by ensuring every piece of news content undergoes a rigorous, transparent fact-checking process before it reaches an audience.

A New Era for News Consumption and Creation

For consumers, Verity offers a personalised and reliable news experience. Users can curate their feeds by pinning interests and locations, receiving tailored summaries of local news and global events. A key feature is our interactive AI chatbot, which allows users to instantly verify any claim in real-time, fostering a culture of critical thinking and active engagement.

For content creators, Verity is a collaborative partner in truthful storytelling. When a creator uploads a news video, it enters our sophisticated AI verification backend. If any inaccuracies or biases are detected, the video isn’t simply rejected. Instead, our system provides specific, constructive feedback, guiding the creator to refine their content to meet the highest standards of integrity. This educational loop ensures that only the most accurate and well-vetted information gets published.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a6173d9117c8420da076b7247c26d900/433912bf-2fb0-40b5-a70c-be7f0457aabd.png)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a6173d9117c8420da076b7247c26d900/fd989780-8c5a-46e0-8e0e-0434489f483c.png)

The AI Engine Behind the Truth

The power of Verity lies in our advanced AI verification engine, orchestrated by **LangGraph**. This system deploys a team of AI agents that work in concert to analyze content from every angle. The process begins with ingesting and transcribing video, audio, and text. Next, our AI identifies key claims and cross-references them against a vast network of trusted sources, including the GNews API and our internal **Neo4j** "Truth Web"—a sophisticated knowledge graph of established facts.

Finally, a powerful **GPT-4** driven agent performs a deep credibility analysis, scanning for AI manipulation like deepfakes, emotional loading, and bias. This multi-layered process guarantees a comprehensive and unbiased review, ensuring that Verity remains a trusted source for news.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a6173d9117c8420da076b7247c26d900/3dea2bdf-8146-41a4-9c47-ad40eea8f938.png)

Built on a Foundation of Cutting-Edge Technology

Verity is powered by a robust and scalable tech stack designed for performance and security. Our AI and backend services run on Python FastAPI, with Flutter and React delivering a seamless user experience across mobile and web. Data is managed through PostgreSQL and Amazon S3, while the entire infrastructure is orchestrated by Kubernetes and secured by Cloudflare.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a6173d9117c8420da076b7247c26d900/5ba41ca3-5854-4307-ad47-3f991d89dd37.png)

Verity is more than just an app; it is a movement toward a more informed public and an accountable media landscape. Join us in building a future where you can trust what you see. Join us in building Verity.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

**Verity**: A Proactive Agentic AI Ecosystem for News Verification

Explanation:
Verity is an advanced Agentic AI system designed to combat misinformation at its source, making it a direct and comprehensive solution for this track. Our platform addresses every requirement by creating a proactive verification pipeline that vets news content before it gets published, preventing the viral spread of falsehoods.
Here’s how Verity perfectly aligns with the track’s goals:
Agentic AI System: At our core, **we use LangGraph to orchestrate a multi-agent team—including a Listener, Question Master, Library Searcher, and Fact Verifier. These agents work in concert to deconstruct, analyze, and validate every piece of content, forming a robust and intelligent verification workflow.**
**Continuous Scanning & Multi-Source Verification: Our "Super Library Searcher" agent is engineered to continuously scan and cross-reference a vast array of sources. It queries the GNews API for credible journalism, uses Puppeteer for dynamic web scraping of primary sources, and cross-references data with our internal Neo4j graph database (our "Truth Web") to verify facts with deep context.**
Detection and Verification: Verity’s primary function is to proactively detect potential misinformation and verify claims within user-uploaded videos. Our AI agents extract key assertions and rigorously validate them against gathered evidence, flagging inaccuracies, logical fallacies, and even signs of AI manipulation.
Easy-to-Understand Updates for the Public: Our system provides clear, easy-to-understand, and contextual updates in two critical ways:
For the Public: By ensuring only verified content reaches the news feed, the entire platform becomes a source of trusted, real-time updates—especially vital during crises.
For the Creator: If a video contains unverified claims, our system generates a simple, actionable report explaining what needs to be corrected. This empowers creators and fosters an ecosystem of accuracy.
Verity is the definitive solution for creating a well-informed public by stopping misinformation before it starts.

> “Detect. Verify. Inform. Empower.”

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

CivicCheck is an Agentic AI-powered misinformation detection and verification system designed to safeguard the public during crises. It continuously scans news portals, social media, and official channels to identify emerging claims, verify their authenticity using trusted data sources, and generate easy-to-understand, multilingual updates for citizens and authorities.

The system uses a combination of natural language processing, retrieval-augmented verification, and autonomous AI agents that reason over credible sources to decide whether a claim is True, False, or Unverified. Each decision is transparent—users can see the supporting evidence, source credibility, and confidence scores.

In crisis scenarios such as natural disasters, health emergencies, or public safety incidents, CivicCheck provides real-time, trustworthy updates to help reduce panic, misinformation, and confusion.
The platform includes a simple dashboard for monitoring claims, reviewing evidence, and sharing verified public updates in English, Hindi, and Marathi.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

CivicCheck directly aligns with the Misinformation track’s objective of building an Agentic AI system that combats the spread of false or misleading information in real time.

It fulfills every part of the Problem Statement 1:
	• Continuously scans multiple sources of information — CivicCheck ingests data from social media (Twitter/X), news outlets, and government feeds.
	• Detects emerging misinformation — It identifies trending or potentially false claims using AI-based claim detection.
	• Verifies facts — The system retrieves evidence from trusted sources and evaluates the truthfulness of each claim.
	• Provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates — It automatically generates multilingual summaries and updates for the public and crisis responders.
	• Supports decision-making during crises — During health scares, disasters, or civic emergencies, it delivers real-time verified information to reduce panic and misinformation spread.

In essence, CivicCheck transforms raw, chaotic online chatter into clear, evidence-based updates, empowering citizens and authorities with truth during uncertainty.

# What We Are Solving

( second video in the preview )

## The Problem
Students spend hours staring at textbooks, forgetting everything they read. YouTube has generic videos. AI tools either make basic graphs or cost too much. Learning is broken.

I started with the aim of helping my younger brother, who struggles with reading and memorizing textbooks. My teammate began building a solution tailored to his needs, as he is a visual learner and benefits more from interactive and visual content.

## What We Built Different
While others make videos, **we generate entire personalized courses in 5 minutes.**

**The breakthrough:** Our AI doesn't just create content - it reads your learning style and builds videos exactly how YOUR brain works best.

- **YouTube:** One video for millions of people
- **Us:** Millions of different videos for each person

- **Other AI tools:** Expensive, slow, basic diagrams  
- **Us:** Fast, cheap, detailed educational content with perfect labeling

## The Magic
First video ready in 90 seconds. Complete course in 5 minutes. Works for any subject - even dusty old textbooks with zero online content.

**Cost:** We will start with ₹1 for a week trials for students in Bharat. **Speed:** Faster than reading a single chapter. **Result:** Actually understanding what you're learning.

## Why This Matters
We cracked personalized education. Every student gets content made specifically for how they think and learn.

**Built by frustrated students who were tired of wasting time learning the wrong way.**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/761f2591839f4de6a202cacfa7d2b18a/b540eabd-f0f5-4f7f-813b-246a5780dfee.png)architecture.png

**Challenges we ran into**

* **Technical Integration Complexity**
  Orchestrating multiple AI services—**Gemini 2.0/2.5 Flash**, **Sarvam AI**, **Google TTS**, **Imagen 3/4**, and **Assembly AI**—into a cohesive pipeline while maintaining high speed and output quality.

* **Content Quality Assurance**
  Ensuring educational accuracy across a range of subjects (e.g., storytelling, science, history, arts) during automated content generation. This required sophisticated quality evaluation systems powered by **Gemini 2.5 Flash**.

* **Speed vs. Quality Balance**
  Delivering the **first video within 90 seconds** while upholding educational rigor and academic structure. Achieved through extensive optimization of the **parallel processing pipeline**.

* **Intent Classification Accuracy**
  Developing reliable AI systems to interpret diverse educational intents from **PDF content**, using **fine-tuned prompts** and **multi-layered validation mechanisms** to ensure intent alignment.

* **Multi-Modal Synchronization**
  Ensuring **precise alignment** of audio narration and visual content across various educational contexts and scene types, leveraging **Remotion** for seamless synchronization.

* **Race Condition Management**
  Handling concurrent image and audio generation processes that may complete asynchronously. Implemented advanced **synchronization mechanisms** to prevent pipeline failures and manage **resource allocation** efficiently during parallel AI service calls.

* **Image Generation Quality Optimization**
  Ensuring consistent, educationally-appropriate visual outputs from **Imagen 3/4** through robust **prompt engineering**, iterative **quality evaluation loops**, and **fallback mechanisms**—all while preserving the **90-second delivery target**.

### TrackShred
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/trackshred-aac4) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/YaseenZaman1421/TrackShred) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/bTa15L2blNE) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackPrix%20Season%202-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackprix-2025.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-10-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> CLI tool to securely clean metadata for privacy.

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Linux](https://img.shields.io/badge/Linux-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Problem It Solves -

TrackShred is a powerful Linux-only CLI utility designed to help users securely delete sensitive files and eliminate metadata traces that could compromise their privacy or be recovered later.

Most users believe that deleting a file is enough — but in reality:
File remnants remain in free disk space
Metadata in files (like images, PDFs) can reveal user info, locations, creation dates
Application data (e.g. browser history, thumbnail caches, trash folders) can expose private activities
Sensitive data might remain in swap memory or recent-files lists

TrackShred solves all of this, by:
Securely shredding files with multiple overwrite passes
Cleaning metadata (EXIF, document properties)
Wiping browser caches, recent file history, and thumbnails
Wiping free disk space and swap area
Offering a dry-run mode and profile system for safe, flexible usage

This tool makes secure cleaning accessible to privacy-conscious users, journalists, security pros, and regular Linux users — all from a simple CLI interface.

**Challenges we ran into**

I had multiple challenges during this build -

1 - Command-line structure vs usability:
- Making a CLI tool that’s both powerful and beginner-friendly was tricky. I solved this by:
-- Showing a welcome help screen by default
-- Adding ASCII art branding and clear examples
-- Structuring commands like --deep, --dry-run, --target, and --profile

2 - Secure deletion on different environments:
- Linux environments can vary a lot. I ran into:
-- Missing exiftool binaries
-- shred not installed by default on some distros
-- PATH issues during install
-- I added a system pre-check script to validate binaries and permissions before use, and a dual-mode installer (--install and --install-user) to handle this cleanly.

3 - Making it modular yet hackathon-fast:
- I wanted to keep it extensible (for free space wiping, browser cleaning, profile modes) without making it overly bloated.
- I modularized the code and kept logic separate per task to scale cleanly post-hackathon.

**Open Innovation**

TrackShred is built entirely on open-source principles:

- It’s Linux-native, Python-based, and doesn’t rely on closed platforms or SaaS tools.
- It solves a real-world need: privacy and data security, without requiring technical expertise.
- It is modular and extensible, other developers can add new “cleaners” as plugins or extend the profile system.
- It’s made for the community not locked into a vendor or proprietary ecosystem.
- TrackShred promotes open access to digital hygiene tools from cybersecurity students to privacy advocates, anyone can use, modify, and contribute to it.

> Your Gateway to Concise, Credible Information

![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![Artificial Intelligence](https://img.shields.io/badge/Artificial%20Intelligence-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Whisper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Whisper-333333?style=flat-square) ![newsapi](https://img.shields.io/badge/newsapi-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square) ![BASE](https://img.shields.io/badge/BASE-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The speed at which we operate nowadays has made online conversations like meetings, discussions, and collaboration at newsworthy events commonplace. Such interactions, however, are often unproductive. Capturing value unimportant details, follow-up actions participants forget important, and get vague outlines of what discussion center around. Manual note-taking is still the norm. It is a slow, inconsistent, error prone process. The notes that are taken, in many cases, are inadequate or misunderstood which results in actions being missed or taken erroneously, often resulting in delusions.  

The use of remote teams and global collaborations add other complications like, with language barrier, if not addressed could lead to misinterpretation. Without clarity and understanding, trust in content produced by AI frameworks raises a different set of concerns. The increased usage of automation to provide transcription and summarization results in questioning their trust for accuracy and reliability. This becomes even more pressing in sensitive fields like healthcare, law, and finance where the meeting’s summaries and recordings are crucial when precision needs to be maintained.  

The absence of a check and standard compliance regarding the validity and trustworthiness of meeting summaries post serious problems particularly in regulated and compliance driven markets.

Establishing a system that maintains the accuracy of summaries/chunks of text while also allowing communication to be clear, precise, actionable, and done in an easy manner will improve productivity and collaboration not only across teams, but also across different industries.

**Challenges we ran into**

Audio/Video Processing: Handling diverse file formats and implementing audio enhancement for better transcription accuracy.
Resource Management: Balancing transcription quality against memory/CPU constraints by implementing customizable Whisper model sizes and chunking.
External Service Integration: Managing connections to multiple APIs (Groq, Monad blockchain, Kafka) with proper error handling.
Streamlit State Management: Working around Streamlit's stateless nature for user authentication and session persistence.
Error Resilience: Implementing comprehensive error handling and an offline mode for graceful degradation when services are unavailable.
Blockchain Implementation: Adding data provenance tracking with Monad blockchain required specialized web3 integration.
Multi-language Support: Maintaining quality across different languages for transcription and translation.
Performance Optimization: Processing large media files efficiently without overwhelming server resources.

**Groq track**

The project transcribes, summarizes, and analyzes audio/video meeting content with features like action item extraction, sentiment analysis, and multilingual translation—demonstrating deep integration of advanced language models.

**Monad Track**

The project leverages blockchain to hash and record transcripts for data provenance and credibility scoring, ensuring that AI-generated insights are traceable and tamper-proof—ideal for use in regulated or trust-critical domains.

**Base Track**

The project incorporates a full authentication and subscription system, managing user sessions, free vs. pro access tiers, transaction history and enabling scalable deployment as a SaaS product.

> SolvYaar: Where Math Meets AI Brilliance
SolvYaar transforms math learning through AI-powered problem solving, interactive visualizations, and engaging games.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Netlify](https://img.shields.io/badge/Netlify-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square) ![Framer Motion](https://img.shields.io/badge/Framer%20Motion-333333?style=flat-square) ![groq ai api](https://img.shields.io/badge/groq%20ai%20api-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

SolvYaar addresses key challenges in mathematics education:
Math Anxiety: Through friendly AI assistants and interactive visualizations, we reduce the intimidation factor of complex math concepts.
Visualization Difficulties: Abstract mathematical concepts become tangible through dynamic, interactive visualizations that respond to user input.
Limited Personalized Support: Our AI math mentor adapts to individual learning styles and knowledge levels, providing personalized guidance that traditional classroom settings cannot offer.
Engagement Issues: By incorporating gamification (Number Maze), creative elements (Math Meme Generator), and cultural connections (Math Personas), we transform math from a dry subject into an engaging experience.
Accessibility Barriers: Step-by-step solutions with clear explanations make mathematics more accessible to students of all ability levels, including those with learning differences.
Isolation in Learning: Our platform encourages sharing achievements and creative content, transforming solitary math practice into a social learning experience.

**Challenges we ran into**

AI Integration with Mathematical Context
Integrating Groq's LLM for accurate mathematical reasoning presented significant challenges. Mathematical notation, formulae rendering, and context preservation required specialized prompt engineering beyond standard text generation.
Solution: We developed a custom middleware layer with dedicated context management that properly formats mathematical expressions using LaTeX/KaTeX before rendering, ensuring accurate representation of complex equations.

Mathematical Visualization Engine
Creating interactive visualizations for abstract concepts proved technically challenging, particularly with browser rendering inconsistencies across devices.
Solution: We implemented a hybrid rendering approach using D3.js with MathJax, along with comprehensive error handling and fallbacks for different browser capabilities. This required refactoring our visualization pipeline three times to achieve consistent performance.

Real-time Keyboard Navigation in Games
Implementing responsive keyboard controls for the Number Maze game led to unexpected event handling conflicts and focus management issues, particularly on mobile devices.
Solution: We completely rewrote the keyboard event handling system using direct document-level listeners with precise debouncing, adding visual feedback indicators and preventing default browser behaviors that interfered with game controls.

**Groq track**

SolvYaar leverages Groq's powerful LLM API as its core intelligence engine, utilizing the exceptional speed and accuracy of Groq's inference capabilities to deliver real-time mathematical problem solving. We've engineered specialized prompt structures that optimize Groq's mathematical reasoning abilities, enabling our platform to provide step-by-step solutions, generate diverse math perspectives through our persona system, and power our educational games with contextually relevant content. Groq's superior performance allows us to deliver instantaneous responses for complex mathematical queries, making advanced concepts immediately accessible to students without the frustration of waiting for solutions - a critical factor in maintaining engagement during learning.

**Monad Track**

SolvYaar incorporates Monad's blockchain technology to create a verifiable achievement system that recognizes and rewards mathematical milestones. We implemented smart contracts on Monad's testnet to mint achievement badges as NFTs when users complete learning challenges, creating permanent proof of mathematical accomplishments. This blockchain integration provides students with tangible rewards for their progress while demonstrating a practical educational application of blockchain technology. By leveraging Monad's efficient infrastructure, we've created a system where learning achievements become digital assets that students can proudly own and display, adding a meaningful layer of motivation to the mathematics learning experience.

**InfinyOn/Fluvio Track**

SolvYaar integrates Fluvio's data streaming capabilities to enhance the real-time responsiveness of our math learning platform. We implemented a client-server architecture with Fluvio producers and consumers to manage event-based communication, enabling efficient streaming of mathematical queries and responses between users and our AI systems. This integration allows for seamless handling of concurrent requests during collaborative sessions and real-time updates to our interactive visualizations. Despite deployment challenges in Windows environments that required developing fallback mechanisms, Fluvio's robust architecture provides the foundation for SolvYaar's responsive experience, ensuring mathematical insights flow smoothly between the AI backend and users without latency issues that would disrupt the learning process.

![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Nodemailer](https://img.shields.io/badge/Nodemailer-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Nodejs](https://img.shields.io/badge/Nodejs-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Campus placement processes are often manual, fragmented, and inefficient, relying heavily on spreadsheets, emails, and repetitive administrative work. This results in errors in eligibility checks, lack of transparency for students, and an increased workload for Training & Placement Officers (TPOs).

**How people can use it**

**Students:**

1. Check ATS compatibility scores (0–100) for their resume against any job description before applying.
2. Upload resumes and automatically extract skills and relevant information.
3. View real-time eligibility status for each application.
4. Receive suggestions to improve resume quality and ATS readability.
5. Track real-time application status and receive notifications.
6. Explore and apply to external job and internship opportunities.

**TPO:**

1. View student profiles and resumes and provide feedback.
2. Send placement drive invitations to recruiting companies.
3. Manage companies, job postings, placement drives, and offers from a single dashboard.
4. Track applications, eligibility overrides, and offer updates with complete audit logs.
5. Upload offer letters for selected students.
6. Reduce manual errors and administrative workload through automation.

**Administrators **

1. Add and manage student and TPO profiles individually or via bulk Excel upload, with options to activate/deactivate accounts.
2. Upload and update academic details (CGPA, backlogs, semesters) using Excel.
3. View company details along with complete audit logs.
4. Define and enforce eligibility criteria for each company and automate eligibility calculation based on CGPA, backlogs, branch, and policies.
5. Generate branch-wise and company-wise placement reports.
6. Send announcements and notifications to students of specific branches.

**Recruiting Companies**
1. Send placement invitations to institutes for hiring.
2. Receive and review invitations, preview offer letters and documents, and approve placement drives.
3. Save screening time by accessing pre-validated, ATS-optimized, and standardized resumes.

**How it makes existing tasks easier and safer**
1. Eliminates manual shortlisting with rule-based automation.
2. Ensures fairness and transparency through enforced policies and audit trails.
3. Reduces last-minute rejections by allowing students to optimize resumes before applying.

In short, the platform transforms campus placements into a transparent, automated, and student-empowering system, benefiting institutions, recruiters, and students alike.

**Challenges we ran into**

**1. Role-Based Access Control**
Ensuring that Admins, TPOs, Students, and Companies could only access authorized data without any leaks was tricky.

**How I solved it:**
1. Implemented role-based middleware on all APIs.
2. Added route-level and data-level permission checks to enforce security.
3. Used JWT authentication to verify user identity before granting access.

**2. Integrating Multiple Systems in Limited Time**
Coordinating frontend, backend, database, and ML services within a hackathon deadline was challenging.

**How I solved it:**
1. Focused on core workflows first (student and tpo management, ATS scoring).
2. Broke the system into modular components for parallel development.

**Managing Bulk Data Uploads**
Uploading hundreds of student profiles or academic records caused validation issues and potential errors.

**How I solved it:**
1. Built Excel import validation with error reporting.
2. Added backend checks for duplicates, missing fields, and format errors.
3. Logged all bulk uploads for transparency and traceability.

### Rime
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/rime-d957) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/tanctl/rime/) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://rime-rs.vercel.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/NAFqb7Jc22Q) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Zypherpunk-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://zypherpunk.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-9-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> A Privacy-hardened UA light client for Zcash.

![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/Rust-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tor](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tor-333333?style=flat-square) ![Zcash Protocol](https://img.shields.io/badge/Zcash%20Protocol-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Current zcash light clients leak metadata through multiple vectors - memo fetch patterns, block-range queries, timing differences, and network identifiers which can allow transaction graph reconstruction and timing correlation attacks, revealing which shielded outputs belong to a wallet, even though the underlying zcash transactions are private.
Rime solves this by providing a hardened, unified address light client that reduces these leaks on the client side. PIR, dummy traffic, full-memo retrieval, bucketing, constant-cost trial decryption, tor integration, and stateless/ephemeral modes make common wallet operations safer without requiring changes to consensus or lightwalletd.

**Challenges we ran into**

- Receive only ufvk derivation (non-standard sapling path): zip 32 assumes spend authority, but rime is receive-only, sapling uses a custom all-hardened path (not zip-32 compatible) while orchard stays standard zip-32. Getting both to yield consistent ivks/ufvks and making trial decryption succeed in practice took careful path selection and validation because theres no clear reference for a receive-only ufvk pipeline.
- PIR from scratch: built xor-pir client/server tooling with fixed-size buckets, two-server query shares, and bucket reconstruction back into valid CompactBlock structures. Ensuring bucket sizing, padding, and xor assembly didnt break witness positions, plus adding a constant-rate dummy scheduler, required several iterations to balance correctness, bandwidth, and sync performance.
- Sync correctness across sapling/orchard: maintaining incremental witnesses/positions for both pools, handling reorgs (reset-to-birthday, block-hash checks), and checkpointing trees every 1000 blocks while keeping SQLite state consistent was a bit complex. Edge cases like replaying history after reorgs and aligning witnesses with block batches needed multiple redesigns.
- Tor circuit isolation with arti: splitting RPC vs PIR isolation groups, jittering connects, and managing separate tor state/cache dirs was under-documented. Making isolation reliable (no state leaks, graceful failure handling) required diving into arti’s behavior and tweaking connection timing and isolation tokens.

**Self-Custody & Wallet Innovation**

Rime is a self-custody unified address light client that handles all key material, note detection, trial decryption, and sync logic locally. It implements receive-only ufvk derivation for sapling and orchard, encrypted seed handling, and stateless/ephemeral modes that dont rely on long-term stored state. The wallet introduces new sync modes (constant-bandwidth, dummy fetches, tor-isolated circuits) that change how a light client interacts with the network and improve privacy without shifting trust to servers. The design emphasizes client-side scanning and minimizing reliance on server-visible metadata.

**Private Payments & Transactions**

Rime strengthens private payments by reducing the metadata a light client leaks when receiving and monitoring shielded funds. PIR hides which outputs are being fetched, dummy patterns and smoothing hide activity timing and note density, full-memo mode prevents selective-memo correlation, and tor-isolate support keeps RPC and PIR traffic separated across circuits. These mechanisms improve the privacy properties of shielded transactions at the network and wallet-interaction layer.

**Privacy Infrastructure & Developer Tools**

Rime is primarily a privacy infra project, it implements several metadata hardening mechanisms that dont exist in current zcash light-client tooling: PIR memo retrieval, dummy/constant-rate fetch patterns, smoothing and bucketing, tor-isolate routing, and full-memo modes. These components are built as separate rust crates (rime-core, rime-lightclient, rime-pir, PIR server) so they can be reused as building blocks. The project contributes new client-side privacy techniques and developer usable infrastructure for building more private zcash applications.

**General Bounty**

Rime is a unified address light-client, focused on metadata privacy. It implements PIR memo retrieval, dummy/constant-rate sync modes, tor-isolated circuits, receive-only ufvk derivation, and full client-side orchard/sapling scanning. Rime qualifies as a contribution to zcash's privacy infrastructure and light-client ecosystem.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/zypher-trade-f540) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/wDULkY_1AEM) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Zypherpunk-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://zypherpunk.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-9-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Private perp trade

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-333333?style=flat-square) ![GraphQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/GraphQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/Rust-333333?style=flat-square) ![Redis](https://img.shields.io/badge/Redis-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Privacy and private transactions are paramount in financial and capital markets. Traditional DeFi perpetual trading platforms require users to connect wallets and expose their on-chain identity, creating a permanent link between their trading activity and public addresses.

Zypher Trade solves this by marrying Zcash's shielded transaction technology with decentralized perpetual trading on Hyperliquid.

All users need to do is send Zcash (ZEC) to a single address with a memo containing their trading instructions - that's it. No wallet connections, no KYC, no on-chain identity exposure. The platform:

Receives shielded ZEC deposits with JSON-encoded trading instructions in the memo field
Swaps ZEC → USDC via Near Intent cross-chain swaps
Executes leveraged perp trades on Hyperliquid
Auto-closes positions and returns profits as ZEC to the user's shielded address
This creates a truly private DeFi trading experience where your financial activity remains completely shielded.

**Challenges we ran into**

**1. Zcash Node Synchronization & Connectivity**
**Challenge:** Setting up and syncing the Zcash node (migrating from zcashd to Zebra) proved extremely challenging. Initial connection issues prevented block downloads, and syncing to mainnet took considerable time.

**Solution:** We containerized the infrastructure using Docker, configured lightwalletd for efficient transaction monitoring, and implemented robust retry mechanisms in the LightwalletdService to handle network interruptions gracefully.

**2. Real-time Transaction Monitoring**
**Challenge:** Detecting incoming Zcash deposits in real-time, including mempool transactions before confirmation, required careful orchestration to avoid duplicates while ensuring no transactions were missed.

**Solution:** Built a custom polling service that monitors both confirmed blocks and mempool, using Redis to track processed transaction IDs and last scanned heights for resumability.

**3. Cross-Chain Swap Integration**
**Challenge:** Integrating ZEC ↔ USDC swaps was complex. We initially explored SwapKit/THORChain but encountered "swap halted" errors, requiring us to pivot to Near Intent's OneClick SDK.

**Solution:** Implemented a flexible SwapService with proper intent creation, status polling, and timeout handling. Added refund mechanisms to return funds to users if swaps fail.

**4. Hyperliquid API Stability**
**Challenge:** The Hyperliquid SDK threw HyperliquidAPIError: No response received from server during initialization and WebSocket processing, causing unhandled promise rejections and application crashes.

**Solution:** Wrapped SDK calls with comprehensive error handling, implemented exponential backoff retries, and added graceful degradation so the application continues running even during API outages.

**5. Temporal Workflow Reliability**
**Challenge:** Orchestrating the complex multi-step deposit→swap→bridge→trade flow with proper error handling, retries, and state management was difficult. "Failed to start deposit workflow" errors appeared intermittently.

**Solution:** Leveraged Temporal's durable execution guarantees, configured appropriate timeouts and retry policies, and implemented proper activity separation for each step of the flow.

**6. Bridging USDC to Hyperliquid**
**Challenge:** After swapping ZEC to USDC on Arbitrum, bridging funds to Hyperliquid's L1 for perp trading required tracking balance changes and implementing polling with timeouts.

**Solution:** Implemented balance polling loops in workflows with configurable timeout periods, ensuring funds are confirmed on Hyperliquid before trade execution.

**7. Memo Parsing & Instruction Validation**
**Challenge:** The entire user experience depends on correctly parsing JSON memos from Zcash transactions. Malformed memos or unsupported instructions needed graceful handling.

**Solution:** Implemented schema validation for memo parsing with clear error responses and refund mechanisms for invalid instructions.

**Description of your solution**

**ComplyNext** is an AI-powered Regulation-Aware Agent that helps fintech companies stay compliant with evolving financial regulations. It continuously monitors official sources like RBI, SEBI, MCA, and the Gazette of India and other relevant sources as per the business, automatically fetching new circulars and comparing them with existing rules. Using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), it extracts and interprets key changes in plain English, while Agentic AI reasoning evaluates their business impact and recommends specific actions.

For example, when a new RBI guideline is released, ComplyNext identifies the change, explains what it means for a company’s operations, and alerts teams with actionable insights like — “Update your onboarding process to comply with Clause 4.1(b) of the revised KYC norms.”

By automating this entire workflow, ComplyNext saves hours of manual effort, reduces audit risk by up to 40%, and ensures fintechs never miss critical regulatory updates.

**Pain Points Addressed**
- Information Overload: Frequent regulatory updates are hard to track and interpret manually.
- Legal Complexity: Dense legal jargon makes it difficult for non-experts to understand compliance obligations.
- Time and Cost Inefficiency: Compliance teams spend hours reading PDFs to even find relevance or consulting legal experts.
- High Audit and Non-Compliance Risk: Missing updates can lead to fines or reputational damage.


**Target Audience**
- Primary Users: Fintech startups, NBFCs, neobanks, and payment service providers that need to stay compliant with RBI/SEBI regulations.
- Secondary Users: Compliance officers, legal teams, and risk management professionals across financial institutions and enterprises.
- Market Need: Especially critical for SMEs and emerging fintechs that lack large legal or compliance departments.

**GTM Strategy:**
- Pilot Launch: Start with a free beta for fintech startups to demonstrate value and gather feedback.
- Strategic Partnerships: Integrate ComplyNext with fintech SaaS platforms or compliance management tools.
- Thought Leadership: Publish weekly regulatory summaries and insights to establish brand credibility in RegTech circles.

**Revenue Streams:**

- Subscription Model: Tiered monthly plans based on the number of alerts, users, or monitored entities.
- Enterprise Licensing: Custom integrations for banks, NBFCs, and audit firms.
- Premium Intelligence Reports: Paid access to detailed comparative analyses, historical compliance data, and audit-ready summaries.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Frequent updates from regulators like RBI, SEBI, and MCA make it challenging for fintech companies to stay compliant. Compliance teams spend hours reading lengthy PDFs and interpreting legal jargon, while smaller firms often lack the expertise to understand what’s changed or how it affects their operations. This leads to delays, higher audit risks, and costly non-compliance. There’s a need for an intelligent Regulation-Aware Agent that can automatically read,interpret, and explain financial laws in plain English—highlighting what changed, why it matters, and what actions to take.

**Description of your solution**

**PrepWise** is an **AI-powered mock interview platform** that simulates realistic, high-stakes technical interviews.

**The Problem**: The "practice gap" for high-stakes technical interviews, especially in specialized fields like Fintech, is a massive barrier. Candidates rely on generic books and LeetCode, which offer zero feedback on communication, clarity, or real-world problem-solving. They go in blind, top talent gets rejected, and dream jobs are lost.

**Our Solution (PrepWise)**: PrepWise is a cutting-edge, AI-powered platform that solves this. It provides an on-demand, realistic practice environment where job seekers can conduct mock interviews with an intelligent AI agent anytime, anywhere.

Our Core Innovation (The Agentic AI): This isn't just a chatbot. The core of PrepWise is a true Agentic AI Interviewer. This agent autonomously:

1. **Simulates** a senior hiring manager for a specific role (e.g., "Fintech Quant").

2. **Selects** complex, role-specific questions from a specialized knowledge base.

3. **Listens** to and analyzes the user's spoken answers in real-time.

4. **Provides** an instant, comprehensive report on technical accuracy, problem-solving approach, and communication clarity.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

**Problem**: We're tackling the massive "practice gap" for tough technical interviews in the Fintech world. If you want to be a Quant or a Fintech Engineer, you can't just find realistic practice—you're basically going in blind.

**Solution (PrepWise)**: We solve this by using an Agentic AI.

The core of our platform is an AI agent that acts just like a senior hiring manager. This agent:

1. **Runs the show**: It picks tough, relevant questions a real Fintech interviewer would ask.

2. **Actually listens**: It analyzes your spoken answers on the fly, judging your tech skills and how you explain things.

3. **Gives real feedback**: You get instant, actionable advice, just like you would from a real person.

**PrepWise** uses this AI agent to fix a huge, real-world problem for anyone trying to break into Fintech.

**The problem it solves**

### **Problem Statement: Restoring Fairness and Authenticity in the Remote Hiring Era**

The global shift to remote work has democratized the hiring process, allowing companies to access a worldwide talent pool and candidates to pursue opportunities without geographical constraints. However, this digital transformation has introduced a critical vulnerability that undermines the very foundation of merit-based hiring: **the erosion of interview integrity.**

Today, interviewees can leverage sophisticated, real-time "Interview Coder" applications. These tools use AI and automation to transcribe an interviewer's questions, provide perfect answers instantly, and even write code in real-time—all while remaining completely invisible, even during screen sharing.

This creates a two-fold crisis:

1.  **For Companies:** The technical interview, once a reliable measure of a candidate's true problem-solving ability, becomes a high-stakes gamble. Hiring managers can no longer be certain if they are assessing genuine skill or merely the effectiveness of a cheating tool. This leads to costly hiring mistakes, underperforming teams, and a loss of faith in the remote hiring process.

2.  **For Candidates (The Humane Crisis):** More tragically, it creates a deeply inequitable environment for the vast majority of candidates who are **honest, skilled, and have prepared diligently.** They are forced to compete on an unlevel playing field, where their genuine expertise can be overshadowed by sophisticated deception. An honest candidate can lose their dream job not because they were less qualified, but because they were more ethical.

The fundamental problem is a **crisis of trust and authenticity.** The tools meant to connect us have inadvertently created a barrier to genuine assessment.

Our mission is to answer the question: **How can we restore the integrity of the remote technical interview? How can we create a secure, controlled, and fair environment where a candidate's true skills can shine, ensuring that the most deserving individual is hired, not simply the one with the best tools to cheat?**

We built **Garura** to be that answer.

**Challenges we ran into**

### **Challenges I Ran Into**

The most significant and humbling challenge we faced during the development of Garuda was not a single bug, but a **cascade of silent failures** originating from a fundamental architectural misunderstanding between our secure Electron desktop client and our Next.js web server.

#### The Problem: A Frozen Application and a Crisis of Confidence

After building what we believed was a feature-complete application, we encountered a soul-crushing bug: upon launching the secure client, the initial "System Security Check" screen would appear, beautifully styled, but completely frozen. The loaders would spin endlessly, the application would never progress, and worst of all, there were **no errors in the console**. The app was failing silently, a developer's worst nightmare.

For hours, we were trapped in a frustrating loop, chasing ghosts:
*   Was it a **styling issue**? We reconfigured our entire CSS pipeline, but the freeze persisted.
*   Was it a **React re-render loop**? We refactored our component state management, lifting state up and using memoization, but the loaders kept spinning.
*   Was it the **security scan itself**? We suspected our PowerShell script, which checks for screen-hiding applications, was hanging. We rewrote it, made it more robust, and even replaced its execution logic with a more modern library (`execa`). Still, the application remained frozen.

The hurdle wasn't just technical; it was a test of perseverance. It felt like every fix was met with the same silent, unmoving screen, eroding our confidence and making us question the entire architecture.

**Challenges we ran into**

## ⚙️ Challenges I Ran Into

### 🧠 Building the Recommendation System (hardest part)

The most difficult part of Turtle wasn’t uploads, payments, or streaming.  
Those are mostly standard backend problems with known solutions.

The real challenge was making the platform **feel intelligent**.

At first, my recommendation logic was very simple:

same genre → recommend

It worked technically, but the experience was bad.  
Users kept seeing similar movies again and again, and discovery felt boring.

So I redesigned the system properly.

I moved to a **vector-based approach**:

- Each movie → feature vector (genres, tags, ratings, views, trends)
- Each user → preference vector (watch history + behavior)
- Calculate similarity score
- Rank and return only the top movie IDs

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/610f5f0f07ca4d49bdb6da8313f34ae8/b6e23ae2-a50c-42d8-8674-13747e209817.png)

After this, feeds felt fresh and smart instead of repetitive.

---

### 🤖 AI Agent Integration

Integrating the AI assistant into a backend system was trickier than expected.

This caused parsing errors and broke the UI.

So I added:

- strict instructions
- schema validation
- response guards
- timeout + fallback to local algorithm
- connecting AI to my database using vector tools and providing context to it from user data stored in the database

The system now treats AI as a helper, not a dependency.  
If AI fails, the app still works normally.

---

### 📦 Uploading & Streaming Edge Cases

File handling also had some practical issues:

- invalid formats
- partial uploads

Fix:

- streaming uploads with Multer
- file type/size validation
- safe limits

These were more engineering problems than algorithmic ones.

---

## 📌 What I Learned

Algorithms and personalisation 

The hardest and most important part of Turtle ended up being:

- recommendation logic
- scoring algorithms
- AI features

Not the uploads.

That’s what makes Turtle feel like a smart platform instead of just another movie hosting site.

**The problem it solves**

## The Problem It Solves

* **Overburdened Primary Healthcare System:** With only **1.2–1.4 doctors per 1000 people** and around **2–3 primary health centers per million population**, doctors face a massive workload, leaving little time for each patient.

* **Communication Gaps:** Many patients and doctors come from different linguistic backgrounds, making it difficult for doctors to **understand patient problems accurately** due to **language and dialect differences**.

* **Time Constraints:** Doctors typically have **less than 3 minutes per patient**, which limits their ability to review past medical reports, prescriptions, and understand the case deeply.

* **Manual Record Analysis:** Doctors and nurses rely on paper-based prescriptions and reports, making it hard to **analyze old records**, maintain patient histories, and connect previous diagnoses with current conditions.

---

## What People Can Use It For

* **Nurses:** Use the mobile app to record patient interactions, scan prescriptions, and automatically create structured medical summaries.

* **Doctors:** Access AI-generated **medical histories and visit summaries** before consultation, allowing for faster and more informed decision-making.

* **Administrators:** Monitor patient flow, manage health center data, and detect regional health trends or outbreaks in real time.

---

## How It Makes Existing Tasks Easier and Safer

* **Saves Consultation Time:** AI-generated patient summaries reduce time spent reading and asking repetitive questions.

* **Improves Accuracy:** AI extracts key details from scanned reports and prescriptions, minimizing human error in manual data entry or report reading.

* **Bridges Communication Gaps:** Real-time transcription and summarization help doctors understand patients better, even across different languages.

* **Enhances Record Management:** All patient data, including prescriptions and medical histories, are **digitally organized and accessible** through UHID-based records.

* **Enables Preventive Care:** Aggregated, anonymized data can help identify **local disease outbreaks** early, improving public health response.

* **Strengthens Trust:** With clear records and better understanding, both patients and doctors experience **more transparent and confident consultations**.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges and Solutions

* **Real-time Transcription Accuracy**

  * *Challenge:* Handling multi-language (Hindi + English) speech during nurse–patient conversations caused inconsistent transcription.
  * *Solution:* Implemented language detection and context-based transcription models to improve accuracy and maintain sentence flow.

* **Document Scanning and Data Extraction**

  * *Challenge:* Extracting consistent information from scanned prescriptions and handwritten reports was difficult due to unstructured layouts.
  * *Solution:* Combined OCR with AI summarization to extract and organize data into a standardized medical history format.

* **Backend Scalability and Reliability**

  * *Challenge:* Managing multiple user roles (nurse, doctor, admin) and real-time sync led to backend overload during parallel sessions.
  * *Solution:* Deployed backend services using **AWS Lambda (serverless)** architecture to auto-scale functions and ensure smooth, cost-efficient performance.

* **Real-time Data Sync Between Dashboards**

  * *Challenge:* Nurse updates were not reflecting instantly on the doctor’s dashboard during initial builds.
  * *Solution:* Designed a **polling mechanism algorithm** to continuously fetch updated transcriptions and present them in real time on the doctor’s dashboard.

* **Outbreak Visualization on Maps**

  * *Challenge:* Displaying regional health trends dynamically on maps required optimized data handling and fast rendering.
  * *Solution:* We will implement **React-Leaflet** integrated with **MongoDB’s geospatial queries** to visualize real-time health outbreaks efficiently and interactively.

**REMARKABLE INTEGRATION OF AWS**

Our project, **Swasya AI**, relies on a **hybrid cloud architecture** built entirely on AWS to achieve both scalability and low-latency performance in healthcare-grade workloads. We strategically combined **serverless compute**, **real-time communication**, and **secure data handling** to bring intelligent medical transcription, OCR, and SOAP note generation to life, all in real time.

**Explore Full AWS Implementation Doc:**
[**AWS_INFRASTRUCTURE.md →**](https://github.com/chahatkesh/swasya-ai/blob/main/docs/AWS_INFRASTRUCTURE.md)

### Challenges We Faced

1. **Unpredictable AI Workloads:** Audio transcription and OCR tasks varied heavily in execution time, leading to inconsistent performance.
2. **Scalability vs. Cost:** Constant EC2 uptime was expensive for workloads that were not always active.
3. **Real-Time Communication:** We needed live updates between nurse and doctor dashboards without polling overhead.
4. **Secure Data Handling:** Managing PHI (Protected Health Information) required encryption, access control, and compliance-aware design.

### How AWS Solved Them

* **AWS Lambda (Serverless Compute):** Handles compute-intensive AI tasks (speech-to-text, OCR, note generation) asynchronously,  scaling instantly without idle cost.
* **EC2 + Application Load Balancer:** Powers low-latency REST APIs with sub-200ms response time for patient queue management and CRUD operations.
* **DynamoDB:** Provides ultra-fast reads/writes for patient data and medical history with automatic scaling and Streams-based event triggers.
* **AWS IoT Core (MQTT):** Enables real-time updates between nurse and doctor dashboards with secure, persistent connections (no polling).
* **S3 + Lambda Triggers:** Creates an event-driven pipeline for uploading, processing, and storing audio/image files.
* **CloudWatch + IAM + Secrets Manager:** Ensures full observability, least-privilege security, and encrypted credential management.

This hybrid architecture lets our system **scale on demand**, **stay cost-efficient**, and **deliver instant updates** in clinical settings, even under variable workloads.

**Best Use of Gemini API**

**Swasya AI** uses the Gemini API to address a core challenge in India’s primary healthcare system — the delay in diagnosis and miscommunication between nurses and doctors caused by unstructured and handwritten medical data.

### How We Used the Gemini API

We built an **AI-powered document processing pipeline** using Gemini to analyze scanned prescriptions and reports uploaded by nurses. Gemini intelligently detects **handwriting quality**, enhances legibility, and extracts key medical details before passing them through our **OCR + Summarization layer**, giving doctors clear, structured patient histories within seconds.

### Our Creative Implementation

We didn’t just call Gemini directly. We built a **custom intermediate architecture** that syncs Gemini’s output with a **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)** system. When multiple documents are scanned for one patient, this setup cross-checks and merges data to build an accurate **medical timeline**, not just a single-document summary.

### Why It Stands Out

* **Innovative synergy** of Gemini + RAG + OCR for healthcare automation
* **Solves a real bottleneck** in rural diagnosis workflows
* **Scalable design** for multi-language, multi-document processing

### Outcome

With Gemini at its core, Swasya AI turns messy handwritten medical records into structured, AI-understandable timelines, giving doctors faster insights and enabling truly intelligent, connected healthcare.

**Best Use of MongoDB Atlas**

**Swasya AI** leverages **MongoDB** as the backbone of its real-time healthcare data infrastructure - powering fast, reliable, and scalable management of patient information across nurses, doctors, and administrators.

### How We Used MongoDB

We use **MongoDB** extensively to store and fetch:

* **Real-time transcription data** generated during nurse–patient conversations
* **AI-generated summaries** for doctors to access instantly before consultations
* **Medical timelines and document histories** for every patient, built dynamically from scanned reports and prescriptions

MongoDB’s **flexible schema** allows us to handle diverse data - text, images, and structured summaries - all within a unified database, ensuring seamless syncing across roles.

### Why It Fits This Track

* **Real-time performance:** Enables instant data updates between nurse and doctor dashboards.
* **Dynamic schema design:** Perfect for evolving healthcare data formats and AI-generated outputs.
* **Scalability:** Handles large volumes of patient and transcription data across multiple PHCs efficiently.
* **Integration-ready:** Works seamlessly with our RAG and AI summarization pipelines.

### Outcome

By using MongoDB as our central data engine, **Swasya AI** achieves sub-second retrieval of medical summaries, synchronized updates across all users, and a robust foundation for real-time, AI-powered healthcare delivery.

**Description of your solution**

**What We Are Building**
*Plutus* is a **voice-powered, AI financial assistant** built on an agentic LangChain framework. It automates budgeting by connecting to accounts, categorizing transactions, and **allocate funds for essentials**. For goal planning, it intelligently allocates any calculated **"free cash"** into dedicated buckets and tracks progress with tailored advice. The AI-driven alert system leverages memory to **proactively warn users** of overspending risks against their budget, remind them of upcoming bills, and **identify money leaks** like unused subscriptions, all managed through a conversational voice interface.

**Pain Points Addressed**
*Plutus* **tackles financial anxiety** by eliminating manual tracking, **preventing accidental overspending**, and providing **clear, real-time insights on safe-to-spend "free cash."** It moves beyond static reports to offer **proactive, actionable guidance**.

**Target Audience**
Our target is **young adults**, who find **traditional budgeting overwhelming** and seek an intuitive, automated solution to **manage their finances confidently**.

**Go-to-Market & Revenue Model**
Our go-to-market is a **freemium model to drive acquisition**. The free tier offers essential tools, while revenue comes from monthly/yearly subscriptions for premium features like family-linked accounts and advanced debt/tax planning.

**Priya's Journey with *Plutus*: A Short Example**
Meet Priya, a young Mumbai designer struggling to manage her **₹70,000** monthly salary.

After connecting her accounts, *Plutus* **instantly automates her budget**. It locks funds for her rent and bills, then shows her a clear **"Free Cash"** balance. **For the first time, she knows exactly what's safe to spend**. Using her voice, she quickly sets a savings goal for a trip.

Throughout the month, *Plutus* acts as **her financial guardian**:

- It sends alerts to prevent overspending on large purchases.
- It reminds her, "**Electricity bill due** in 2 days. **Chill, funds are safe.**"
- It reminds her about duplicate subscription she'd forgotten about.

At the end of the month, with cash left over, *Plutus* suggests a beginner-friendly investment. This **sparks her interest in building long-term wealth**. She explores the premium plan, realizing she can use its advanced tools to also **help her retiring parents** manage their finances. She subscribes, completing her journey from being **financially stressed to empowered**.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

For India's young adults, managing finances is a source of daily stress because current tools are merely passive reports, failing to answer the most critical question: **“How much of my money is actually safe to spend today?”** This uncertainty fuels a vicious cycle of accidental overspending, mental burden, and pervasive financial anxiety. They don't need another spreadsheet; they need a proactive financial guardian that automates their discipline and provides an immediate, trustworthy answer so they can manage their money with confidence.

Solving this requires a true **agentic AI** with specific capabilities. The system must be able to: continuously integrate real-time financial data from multiple sources; reason and plan by distinguishing between essential commitments, savings goals, and disposable income; and act proactively by securing funds, identifying financial risks, and delivering personalized, timely advice through a simple, conversational interface. It must function not as a static tool, but as a dynamic, trusted financial buddy.

**The problem it solves**

# PawHub 🐾 — Smart Animal Welfare Platform

Status Code 2 Submission  

Description:  
PawHub is a comprehensive animal welfare platform built to tackle real-world challenges in urban animal management. Our goal was to create a system where citizens, NGOs, and public organizations can work together to manage stray populations, respond to emergencies, and promote adoptions efficiently.

In cities like Delhi, with a very high stray dog population, it’s difficult for organizations to track animals, respond to incidents quickly, and plan sterilization or vaccination drives. PawHub addresses this by combining citizen reporting, machine learning, and a centralized dashboard to make real-time animal welfare actionable.

---

## What We Built

Citizen-Facing Flutter App: Allows users to report stray sightings, lost pets, and emergencies with geotagged images.  
NGO Dashboard (Next.js): Lets NGOs and public organizations track emergencies, stray populations, adoption events, and sterilization drives.  
Django REST API: Serves as the backend, with PostGIS and PG Vector integration for geospatial and similarity-based queries.  
Machine Learning Models: Match similar sightings, connect lost pets to reported sightings, and track individual animal profiles over time.  
Deployment: Full stack deployed on Vultr with ML models on cloud GPUs, Django API on VPS, and managed PostgreSQL DB.

---

## Workflows

1. Sighting → Matching → Profile Creation  
   - Users report stray animals.  
   - ML models match sightings to existing profiles or create new profiles.  
   - Nearby NGOs and vets are alerted instantly.  

2. Lost Pet Matching  
   - Users register lost pets.  
   - ML continuously matches sightings with lost pet reports.  
   - Owners receive immediate notifications of potential matches.  

3. Community Missions (Drives)  
   - NGOs create sterilization drives, vaccination camps, or adoption events.  
   - Citizens receive notifications and can participate.  
   - Progress is tracked in real time.  

4. Emergency Reporting  
   - Users report injured, aggressive, or trapped animals.  
   - Reports appear on the dashboard with severity markers.  
   - NGOs/vets respond faster, improving rescue outcomes.

---

## Future Scope

Better Matching Models: Explore dynamic embeddings, multi-modal vision models, and temporal tracking to improve sighting matching.  
Predictive Analytics: Use historical sighting data to predict stray hotspots and optimize sterilization drives.  
Gamification & Incentives: Encourage user participation for reporting and mission participation.

---

## Why PawHub is Different

Unlike existing solutions, PawHub combines real-time citizen reporting, ML-based sighting matching, and NGO dashboards in a single platform. It enables:
Faster response to emergencies.  
Centralized animal profiles for population tracking.  
Data-driven planning for sterilization, vaccination, and adoption drives.  
Scalable deployment for high-density urban areas like Delhi.

---

## Repositories

ML Models: [StatusCode2_pawhub-ML](https://github.com/spaceexplorer3672/StatusCode2_pawhub-ML.git)  
Django API: [pawhubAPI](https://github.com/NarenKarthikBM/pawhubAPI/)
Flutter app: [Flutter app](https://github.com/jayb71/pawhub)
Dashboard: [pawhubAPI](https://github.com/NirmanJaiswal36/pawhub-web-dashboard)
---

## Hackathon Impact

PawHub demonstrates how citizen-driven reporting + ML + data dashboards can transform urban animal welfare. Our platform empowers communities to respond faster, track stray populations efficiently, and improve the lives of animals in cities struggling with high stray populations.

**Challenges we ran into**

# PawHub Challenges 🐾

This document outlines the main challenges we faced while building PawHub, our urban animal welfare platform.

---

## 1. Matching Accuracy
Problem: Stray animals have diverse appearances, and our ML models initially used static embeddings.  
Impact: Difficulty in reliably matching sightings to existing animal profiles.  
Cause: Limited availability of high-quality, labeled stray animal datasets.  

---

## 2. Movement of Strays
Problem: Stray animals are constantly on the move.  
Impact: Tracking them over time and linking multiple sightings to the same animal is challenging.  
Approach: Used geospatial data (PostGIS) and temporal logic to partially track movement patterns.  

---

## 3. Vaccination Identification
Problem: Determining vaccination status from images alone is unreliable.  
Impact: Hard to monitor health campaigns and ensure population safety.  
Potential Solution: Future integration with QR tags or IoT-enabled collars.  

---

## 4. User-Driven Data
Problem: PawHub relies on citizens reporting sightings and emergencies.  
Impact: Uneven reporting leads to incomplete coverage and biased population tracking.  
Approach: Incentivization through notifications and community missions is planned for the future.  

---

## 5. Real-Time Operations
Problem: Ensuring low-latency alerts to NGOs and vets across the city.  
Impact: Delays in reporting can affect emergency response times.  
Solution: Optimized API deployment on Vultr VPS, with ML models on cloud GPUs for fast processing.  

---

## Summary
Despite these challenges, PawHub successfully:
Matches sightings with existing animal profiles.
Alerts NGOs in real time.
Tracks lost pets and community missions.
Provides a scalable framework for urban animal welfare.  

Future improvements include better ML models, vaccination tracking, predictive analytics, and integration with IoT devices.

---

**The problem it solves**

The Problem We're Solving:

Modern coding is powerful — but fragmented.
We realized that today’s developers juggle too many tools — code editors, AI chatbots, StackOverflow, screen sharing apps — just to write a few efficient lines of code. This wastes time, breaks focus, and makes collaboration messy.

So, we built AIEditorX, an all-in-one intelligent coding workspace powered by Groq.

⚡ Our Solution – AIEditorX
AIEditorX is an all-in-one, intelligent code editor that unifies essential development tools into a single seamless experience:

🧠 AI Ghost Line Suggestions
Generate full code blocks instantly with Blackbox-style ghost suggestions

🎙️ Voice + Text AI Commands
Debug, generate, and navigate code by speaking — hands-free coding.

🖍️ Syntax Highlighting & Error Detection
Errors are caught live with red highlights; no need to wait till runtime.

🧑‍💻 Live Cursor + Screen Sharing
Pair program or teach in real-time — like Google Docs for code.

💡 Hover-to-Explain
Hover over any keyword to get instant explanations — no more Googling 

It’s not just smarter. It’s seamless, visual, and voice-enabled.
Welcome to the future of development.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into
Building AIEditorX came with its fair share of hurdles:

⚠️ Real-time AI Response Latency:
Initially, we faced delays while fetching suggestions from the AI model using the Groq API. We optimized our API request handling and implemented async loading indicators to improve user experience.
🎙️ Voice Command Integration:
Making the AI understand both natural language prompts and code-specific instructions was tricky. We trained it to differentiate between code generation, debugging commands, and explanations using role-specific prompts and better context framing.
🔐 API Key Security:
During early builds, we accidentally exposed API keys. We fixed this by creating a secure .env structure and properly configuring backend calls from the Electron app.

**Groq track**

1. Ghost Line Suggestions
You use the Groq API to generate contextual code suggestions in real-time. As the user types, Groq analyzes the existing code structure and provides ghost-line suggestions (predictions of the next line/block of code) based on patterns and context, similar to Blackbox-style code completions.

2.Hover-to-Explain
Using Groq's AI-powered language model, users can hover over keywords or code segments to get instant explanations. This eliminates the need to look up documentation or search for code explanations online, streamlining the learning process for both beginners and experienced developers.
