### Tattva
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/tatva-5284) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-MumbaiHacks%202025%20--%20Round%201%20(Online)-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mumbaihacks25-round1.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Informed Opinions

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenAi](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenAi-333333?style=flat-square) ![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square) ![n8n](https://img.shields.io/badge/n8n-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**Tattva**

People see clips, posts, and ads that make strong claims. They need help to see facts, context, and bias. A yes/no fact check is not enough. People want to know who says what, what sources support it, and how close their own view is to the evidence.

**What Tattva does**
Tattva is a web app and a browser extension. You paste or share any link: a YouTube video, a post on X, an Instagram reel, a podcast clip, or an article.

*Tattva:*
- Finds the key claims.

- Pulls evidence and citations from diverse sources.

- Gives a Tattva Score (0–100) for truthfulness and evidence strength.

- Lets you add your stance (optional).

- Shows your Reality Distance from the evidence.

- Explains why it scored the way it did.


**Who it is for**
People who want to check political clips, influencer ads, pop culture takes, or health claims.

**Communities that want shared context and sources.**
Platforms that may embed the Tattva Score.

**Why it is different**

- Focus on context, not only verdicts.

- Optional stance input to meet the user where they are.

- Scoring that shows its work with citations and weights.

- Gentle prompts that help users reflect, not preach.

**Revenue model**

- Freemium (consumer)

1. Free: extension + web app, Tattva Score, citations, and a basic feed. Track up to 2 topics. Tattva keeps researching those topics and posts updates as Signals (a short digest) with a Pulse-like view of changes over time.


2. Premium: unlock more tracked topics, custom feeds, higher update frequency, deeper dives, saved searches, and custom alerts. Users choose their topics; Tattva keeps them updated with ongoing Signals and a Pulse-style trend view.


3. Rationale: keep public access broad while charging for more topics, control, and depth.

- APIs (pay-per-use)


1. Endpoints: claim extraction, scoring, citations, topic status, and alert webhooks.

2. Model: pay per analysis call with volume discounts. Optional SLA, audit logs, and crisis-mode topic pages as add-ons.

3. Who pays: platforms, publishers, and tools that want the Tattva Score and citations inside their products.

- Teams & Enterprise (seats + add-ons)


1. Seats: newsroom, brand, NGO, or enterprise consoles for bulk link scoring, saved topics, alerts, exports, SSO, and RBAC.

2. Add-ons: private topic hubs for incidents, review workflows, and data retention controls.

3. Model: per-seat pricing with optional incident or compliance packages.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

Tattva fits the Misinformation track as an agentic AI that watches the open web, detects risky claims, verifies them with citations, and publishes clear, local context during fast-moving events.

Continuous scan. Background agents crawl news sites, social posts, videos, and transcripts. They extract atomic claims, deduplicate them, and cluster by topic and location.

Detect emerging misinformation. We flag spikes in unverified or conflicting claims, low-cred link networks, and sudden shifts in sentiment within a topic cluster.

Verify facts. A retrieval step pulls primary documents and high-cred sources. The system computes a Tattva Score (0–100) based on evidence strength, source diversity, recency, and cross-region consensus. Every score links to 3–5 citations.

Contextual public updates. In “crisis mode,” Tattva spins up a live topic page that shows: what is known, what is uncertain, key timelines, and a Local Lens for the affected region. Short update cards are easy to share. When evidence changes, subscribers get an alert and the score updates.

Human-in-the-loop. Editors can pin official guidance and resolve disputes; the system logs why each decision changed the score.

Outcome: the public sees a plain-English view of contested claims, grounded in sources, with location-aware context that updates as the situation evolves.

**Description of your solution**

**XPort Pay is your 24×7 AI trade manager, guiding every export and import decision. It replaces costly human managers by predicting markets, optimizing payments, comparing shipments, and handling paperwork automatically. It turns uncertainty into strategy and makes global trade smarter, faster, and stress-free.**

**1. TradeMate – Agentic AI Assistant**
Idea: Your AI export-import manager that acts like a human manager, handling shipments, market changes, and decisions automatically.
Factors:
•	Real-time shipment monitoring
•	Carrier selection
•	Tariff & policy tracking
•	Learning user preferences
**Example:**
•	Trump suddenly imposes a 50% tariff on Indian textiles → TradeMate suggests exporting the same product to Vietnam or Bangladesh for better profit.
•	Auto-selects the best carrier and predicts delivery time based on current trends.
**Benefits:**
•	Instant decisions
•	Reduced risk from sudden policy changes
•	Smarter trade without human errors


**2. PayPilot – Forex & Payment Intelligence**
Idea: Optimizes payments to maximize profit and reduce forex loss.
**Factors:**
•	Best invoicing currency (USD, EUR, INR)
•	Advance/balance payment split
•	Shipment schedule vs payment optimization
•	Predictive forex trends
**Example:**
•	Exporting to Europe → PayPilot suggests invoicing in EUR instead of USD to take advantage of a temporary favorable rate and splits payments to save ₹15,000.
**Benefits:**
•	More profit per shipment
•	Smooth cash flow
•	Reduced currency risks


**3. PortWay – Market & Route Intelligence**
**Idea:**
Finds the best market and shipping route factoring cost, delivery, reliability, and sustainability.
**Factors:**
•	Tariffs & trade policy changes
•	Shipping cost & delivery time
•	Reliability & insurance
•	Carbon emissions & eco-benefits (discounts or incentives for low-carbon shipments)
•	Alternate ports & countries
**Example:**
•	Exporting leather bags → PortWay compares DHL vs Maersk vs local carriers:
o	DHL: ₹60,000, 10 days, medium carbon
o	Maersk: ₹65,000, 9 days, low carbon → qualifies for a 2% green shipping discount from the port authority
o	Local Carrier: ₹58,000, 12 days, high carbon
•	PortWay recommends Maersk to Germany: slightly higher cost but faster, low carbon, and eligible for green shipping discount → net savings + faster delivery + eco-friendly.
**Benefits:**
•	Maximize profit while considering all cost factors
•	Reduce shipment risks with reliable carriers
•	Take advantage of eco-friendly incentives or discounts


**4. PaperLess – Smart Docs & Compliance**
Idea: Automates all export-import paperwork and resolves shipment issues.
**Factors:**
•	GST filing
•	Consignment/shipment documents
•	Export/import licenses & customs forms
•	Shipment seizure handling
**Example:**
•	Shipment stuck at customs → PaperLess identifies missing IEC/license, auto-generates forms, guides release.
•	GST filing done automatically for every shipment.
**Benefits:**
•	Save hours of manual work
•	Avoid fines & penalties
•	Trade confidently without stress

**XPort Pay – Fintech for Export-Import**
The **global export-import industry** is worth over **$25 trillion** annually, with S**MEs making up 60% of cross-border trade.** Yet, most small exporters struggle with **complex tariffs, fluctuating forex, and time-consuming paperwork.**
“Imagine having a personal financial manager for your export-import business — but smarter, faster, and always on.”
XPort Pay leverages **Agentic AI** to **optimize payments, forex, and trade decisions**, acting autonomously so SMEs never miss profit opportunities.
•	**PayPilot:** Picks the best currency, timing, and payment splits.
•	**PortWay:** Chooses markets and shipping routes considering tariffs, costs, delivery speed, and carbon incentives.

The AI doesn’t just advise — **it executes, learns, and manages risk.** SMEs can now **trade globally with confidence, smarter cash flow, and optimized profits.**

**In short:** XPort Pay turns every shipment into a **financially optimized, low-risk, high-profit decision.**

**Description of your solution**

Many young individuals struggle to develop healthy saving habits early. For example, children often receive pocket money but lack guidance and tools to save effectively, while parents find it difficult to monitor or teach financial discipline. 
Casharoo addresses this gap by making saving tangible, trackable, and engaging. By instilling goal-oriented financial habits early, it empowers the next generation to become disciplined, financially responsible adults.

**What We Plan to Build:**
Casharoo is a hybrid tangible + digital savings solution combining an Arduino-based smart bank with AI-driven features and a real-time web dashboard. It combines AI and IoT creating an an Arduino-based smart bank with sensors, LEDs, and a servo motor to detect coin/note deposit The smart bank detects coin and note deposits using sensors, LEDs, and a servo motor, while the dashboard tracks savings, sets goals, and provides actionable insights.

**Features:**
1. Digital Ledger & Data Management: Deposits are logged via Arduino → Node.js server → MongoDB.
2. User Profiles & Multi-User Support: Each family member can create accounts, track deposits, and set goals.
3. AI & Gamification: AI-driven messages, badges, and progress tracking motivate users to save and achieve goals.
4. Hybrid Payments: Supports physical coins and digital deposits via UPI/Razorpay.
5. Insights & Analytics: Visual charts show savings trends, goal progress, and predictive suggestions for future savings.

**Pain Points Addressed:**
-Low engagement and motivation in saving money among Gen Z.
-Lack of interactive tools for families to teach financial literacy.
-Difficulty in tracking and managing savings across multiple users.

**Target Audience:**
-Gen Z individuals to help in learning financial discipline.
-Families and parents seeking an engaging way to teach money management.

**Go-To-Market & Revenue Streams:**
-GTM: Launch via online campaigns targeting parents and young users, collaborate with fintech platforms and educational institutions, leverage social media for engagement.
-Revenue Streams: Sale of smart bank devices, subscription-based premium dashboard features (analytics, AI suggestions), and potential partnerships with banks or fintech apps.

**Impact:**
Casharoo promotes financial literacy, habit formation, and goal-oriented saving. By combining technology, gamification, and education, it prepares the next generation to make smarter financial decisions and grow into financially responsible adults.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Casharoo leverages Agentic AI to provide personalized, proactive financial guidance for users. Unlike traditional fintech apps, the system observes savings patterns, predicts goal completion, and recommends actions, effectively acting as a financial agent for Gen Z users.

Agentic AI Features:
1. Predictive Goal Forecasting: AI analyzes deposit trends to predict if a user will reach their savings goal and suggests adjustments.
2. Personalized Savings Nudges: Sends real-time, contextual messages like “You’ve saved ₹100 this week—keep it up!” or “Try saving ₹50/day to reach your goal by next month.”
3. Automated Allocation Suggestions: Agentic AI recommends splitting savings into categories (emergency fund, entertainment, investment) based on user habits.
4. Gamified Learning Agent: The AI actively encourages savings behavior through challenges, badges, and progress tracking.

Impact:
By combining Agentic AI with tangible interaction, this project transforms saving from a passive activity into an engaging, personalized financial experience, building strong financial literacy and self-managed money habits in Gen Z.

### ******🚨 Why Live Streams\News Channels Dominate Misinformation Spread: The Critical **Evidence********

---
The urgency of addressing misinformation in live streams becomes clear when examining the data. Research from MIT reveals that false news spreads 6 times faster than true stories on social platforms, and this phenomenon is amplified exponentially in live streaming environments where real-time consumption meets zero verification time.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/33a0c15f7a7b4474a04ac0b55a6b3d52/1366f837-ac2d-4ca2-ba5f-c9349486d080.png)

*🎯 The Gap Identified
Static content (posts, articles) can be reported and fact-checked later, but live streams and real-time broadcasts reach audiences immediately - making them the biggest misinformation risk during crises.*

---

****💡 ADROIT's Core Innovation: The Agentic Approch to Supervise streams****
Place an Agentic filter layer between live content creators/News Channels and their audiences that:
******1. Scans content in real-time as it's being streamed
2. Only allows verified information to pass through cleanly
3. Flags questionable content with instant user notifications
4. Builds creator credibility scores based on accuracy over time******

---

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/33a0c15f7a7b4474a04ac0b55a6b3d52/0ead5e8c-e385-4ffd-9c61-8c11dae0b111.jpeg)

**Learning Loop:**
All agents share data to improve collective intelligence

## Technical Implementation

MIASMA Filter is a middleware solution that operates between the streamer and the broadcasting server to help detect and mitigate the spread of misinformation across social media platforms. It evaluates the credibility of claims made within live video streams by cross-referencing them against trusted, reputable sources.

The system alerts viewers with verified information by assigning a confidence score to the claims detected in the stream. A Supervisor Agent continuously monitors incoming data streams via a multimodal interface powered by API and Gemini AI. It identifies sensitive or potentially misleading claims and triggers a fact-checking process. Verified insights are then passed to an Action Agent, which embeds the video with real-time confidence scores, providing users with immediate context about the accuracy of the content they are watching.

Tech Stack: ReactJS (frontend), Python (backend), Gemini AI, Vertex AI (for advanced ML and fact-checking pipelines), and AWS (for scalable infrastructure and deployment).

**FocusTwin – AI-Powered Productivity Companion**

Students and professionals often struggle to **prioritize tasks effectively** because productivity fluctuates with *stress* and *energy levels*. Most productivity tools are **static**, sending generic reminders that fail to adapt to how the user actually feels, leading to **missed deadlines** and **low efficiency**. **FocusTwin** solves this by using an **AI-powered chatbot** to *assess the user’s current stress and energy*, **dynamically prioritize tasks**, send **personalized reminders and motivational messages**, track task completion, and award **points for staying on track**. Built entirely with **free and accessible tools**, our solution targets **students and professionals seeking smarter productivity**, and can scale via **freemium subscriptions, corporate packages**, or **gamified in-app rewards**.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

**FocusTwin** directly addresses a significant healthtech problem: the impact of stress and poor habits on individual well-being and productivity. It goes beyond simple task management by treating productivity as an integral part of holistic health. By leveraging an *agentic AI* (Groq LLM), the app doesn't just respond to user commands; it proactively and autonomously optimizes a user's day.

* *Addressing a Healthtech Problem* : The core problem FocusTwin solves is the cycle of stress, poor sleep, and reduced focus that leads to burnout and reduced well-being. By considering health data (sleep, stress, mood), the app provides a solution that is tailored to a person's physiological and mental state, which is a key component of personal health management.
* *Leveraging Agentic AI* : The project's use of Groq LLM makes it agentic in several ways:
    * *Proactive Scheduling* : Instead of waiting for the user to ask, the AI autonomously generates a personalized daily plan based on a continuous flow of data (tasks, calendar, health).
    * *Real-time Nudges* : It doesn't just present a plan; it sends timely nudges to guide the user throughout the day, acting as an intelligent, autonomous coach.

**Description of your solution**

**Problem Statement:**

In India, millions of poor and middle-class citizens remain unaware of the government schemes they are eligible for. Even if they know, the application process is often complicated, with document verification and tracking being a major hurdle.
SahayakAI solves this problem by acting as an **agentic AI **assistant that connects citizens to the right schemes at both national and Maharashtra state levels.
Citizens can interact through **WhatsApp** (for scale and accessibility), receive automated calls via **Vapi AI** for voice-based interactions, or directly use the website UI.
The assistant asks simple questions in English, Hindi, and Marathi, classifies the user based on their profile (income, caste, gender, occupation, etc.), and identifies eligible schemes.
Once filtered, the citizen gets two options:
Direct Government Portal – Redirect to official scheme application link.


One-Stop Application (via our platform) – Upload required documents on our website or send directly via WhatsApp. The AI agent verifies them, applies automatically to the respective scheme portals, and provides feedback if errors are found.
Once the required documents or details are received through WhatsApp or Vapi AI, the agent, after taking the user’s permission, **directly applies** for the scheme on their behalf. The user then receives notifications about the application status through WhatsApp and/or automated Vapi AI calls.
Users get **real-time updates** on their application status via WhatsApp notifications, the website dashboard, or** automated voice calls** through Vapi AI.
This creates a **scalable, automated, and citizen-friendly system** that removes the dependency on middlemen and empowers people to access welfare benefits directly.

**Impact:**

- Increases awareness of government benefits.
- Saves time by reducing manual paperwork.
- Provides digital inclusion for low-literacy users.
- Scalable to all states & local languages

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

**AI/ML & Generative AI** – AI agent for classification, eligibility detection, and response generation.

**GovTech / Social Impact** – Solving accessibility challenges for government schemes.

**Web & Mobile Development** – Web dashboard, WhatsApp chatbot integration, and automated Vapi AI voice calls.

**Agentic AI / Automation** – Document verification and automated scheme application.

**Inclusivity & Accessibility** – Multilingual support (Hindi, Marathi, English), WhatsApp-first design, and automated voice calls for low-literacy users.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**Introduction**
This project develops a multi-agent system to identify and explain false information in text, photos, audio, and video, with an emphasis on transparent evidence, source provenance, and structured verdicts.The system adopts a role-specialized pipeline consisting of claim extraction, evidence retrieval, and verdict. The core models, configured for tool use, structured outputs, and high-effort reasoning, support agentic workflows at production quality, utilizing advanced instances for optimal performance.

**Inputs**
- News content in many formats, including text articles/posts, photos, audio clips, and videos.

**Core Logic (Multi Agent System)**
The system is composed of several models, starting with 

**Model 1 — Claim & Context Agent.**
- Extracts valid atomic claims from input.
- Performs author/source surface checks
- Captures contextual information required for verification

**Model 2 — Evidence & Source Agent**
- Retrieves and ranks evidence from credible sources, including provenance and dates, using web search, reverse image/audio search, and archives as appropriate.
- Creates evidence packs for each claim, including supporting, opposing, and neutral items.
- If there is insufficient evidence, iterates through targeted retrieval or returns Not Enough Info (NEI), which is ready for escalation.

**Model 3 — Verdict & Rationale Agent**
- Weighs evidence and classifies each claim: True, False, Partly True/Misleading, or NEI, producing a concise, cited rationale.
- Generates a standardized report that includes the claim, verdict, rationale (why), context, and sources (with publisher and date).

**Output**
The output of the system is a per-claim fact-check card, which includes:

- Claim text, Verdict (True/False/Partly True/Misleading/NEI), Confidence.
- A rationale outlining how each mentioned source/evidence supports the decision.
- Context summary (who, when, and where), modality comments (e.g., image provenance).
- Sources with provenance (publisher, date, URL/archival reference).

**Data Sources**
- Reputable news outputs and publisher feeds (RSS/sitemaps/APIs) for up‑to‑date reporting.
- Web search indices with time filters and domain whitelists; archival services for historical snapshots.
- Reverse image/video search and perceptual hashing can detect reused or out-of-context media.
- Social platform APIs for trending claims, with meticulous provenance monitoring.

**Description of your solution**

We are building Clara, an AI-powered assistant that verifies misinformation across all social media platforms with just voice. Users can share any suspicious content whether it's a WhatsApp message (text or voice), Instagram post, Facebook video, or X thread and Clara automatically checks if it's real or fake.

Most Indians use these platforms for information or entertainment. This AI agent is designed for non-English users because 70% of Indians still don't know the difference between AI and real content. Misinformation spreads faster than fact-checkers can respond. Fake WhatsApp forwards, manipulated videos, and resurfaced old news cause panic and harm before verification happens. Current tools are slow, limited, and mostly text-based.

Clara accepts any type of content text, image, audio, video, or link and verifies it in under a minute using autonomous AI. No manual checking or platform integration is needed.

Why is Clara different from others?
Most teams have the same idea as ours, but Clara can flag WhatsApp messages as fake or real, transcribe audio, extract text from images, analyze videos frame by frame, and detect reused or manipulated media. It's multilingual (Hindi, English, and mixed-language) and context-aware, recognizing when visuals or quotes are taken out of context.
Clara empowers every user to stop misinformation before it spreads, turning every smartphone into a fast, reliable, and universal truth-checking assistant.

## **WealthWise — “Your Intelligent Path to Financial Freedom”**

---

### 🔹 **Overview**

**WealthWise** is an *Agentic AI–powered financial coach* that offers hyper-personalized budgeting, savings, and investment recommendations using behavioral analytics and predictive modeling — designed for individuals with irregular income streams.

---

### 🔹 **Core Modules & Features**

1. **Personalized Budgeting Engine**

   * Tracks income, expenses, and spending patterns.
   * Dynamically adjusts budgets using **reinforcement learning**.
   * Example: A user earning ₹60,000/month with variable freelance income sees a **15% improvement in saving rate** after 3 months.
   * **Tech:** Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis.

2. **Investment Advisor**

   * Suggests diversified portfolios based on **Modern Portfolio Theory** and user risk profiles.
   * Uses **Monte Carlo simulations** to forecast returns.
   * Example: A “Moderate” risk profile generates an expected **8.4% annualized return** over 5 years.
   * **Tech:** PyTorch, NumPy, QuantLib.

3. **Behavioral Spending Insights**

   * AI detects emotional overspending and nudges users with timely alerts.
   * Example: 30% reduction in impulsive transactions after 4 weeks of behavior feedback.
   * **Tech:** NLP with Hugging Face Transformers, Kafka for event streams.

4. **Risk Prediction & Early Alerts**

   * Predicts financial shortfalls using **LSTM-based time-series forecasting**.
   * Example: Detects 92% of “overspend risk” events 2 weeks in advance.
   * **Tech:** PyTorch, AWS SageMaker.

5. **Conversational Financial Coach (Agentic AI)**

   * Context-aware dialogue agent trained on user goals and transactions.
   * Auto-plans actions: “Increase SIP by ₹1000 next month” or “Pause discretionary budget”.
   * **Tech:** LangChain, OpenAI GPT-5 API, Vector DB (Pinecone).

6. **Privacy & Compliance Layer**

   * Fully encrypted (AES-256) PII and financial data.
   * GDPR + RBI data localization compliance.
   * **Tech:** AWS KMS, Vault, CloudWatch audit trails.

7. **Performance Metrics Dashboard**

   * Real-time KPIs: Net savings %, portfolio ROI, financial stability index.
   * Example: Dashboard shows user’s “Financial Health Score” improvement from **62 → 78** in 90 days.
   * **Tech:** React, Next.js, D3.js, AWS Amplify.

### 🔹 **Impact Vision**

Empower 1 million gig and salaried users in India to gain **data-driven financial independence** through adaptive, explainable, and ethical AI by 2027.

**Description of your solution**

1. The solution is a full-featured evaluation platform designed to test AI models for fact-checking, misinformation detection, and safety with high accuracy and reliability.

2. Users onboard by adding their model endpoints (API, container, etc.) and choosing relevant test profiles like hallucination checks, jailbreak detection, dataset leakage, or performance regression.

3. Diverse input variants are automatically generated through fuzzing and paraphrasing to test models under realistic and adversarial conditions.

4. An orchestrator manages the scheduling of tests, dispatching workloads to workers that query the AI models with custom prompts and track response data like latency, cost, and token logs.

5.A powerful evaluation engine scores outputs using deterministic methods (string matching, regex) and AI-based methods (BERTScore, embedding similarity, toxicity, jailbreak detection, factuality inference).

6.Test scores are aggregated to provide severity labels, pass/fail metrics, and confidence levels, which are shown in dashboards for user monitoring.

7.Integration with ticketing and webhook systems allow automated alerting on critical failures, helping rapid incident response.

8.A feedback loop supports sending failed test cases to retraining pipelines or human reviewers, improving model quality continuously.
 
9.In addition to text-based LLM evaluation, the solution includes specialized modules for examining images and videos to detect deepfakes, protecting against multimedia misinformation.

10.A dedicated AI bot analyzes statements or inputs, judging if they represent factual information or misinformation, improving the system’s scope beyond just language models.

11.The modular and scalable design enables easy extension for new types of models or data, including multimedia and real-time social media monitoring.

12.This end-to-end platform helps organizations deploy trustworthy AI systems confidently, ensuring only reliable and safe models handle sensitive fact-checking tasks.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

Our project solves the problem by providing a full platform to evaluate AI models for fact-checking, safety, and misinformation detection.

Users can add their AI models via API or container endpoints and select specific test profiles tailored to their needs.

The platform generates diverse input variants to challenge models under different real and adversarial scenarios.

Test orchestration dispatches workloads to workers that run the model with custom prompts while recording detailed logs and metrics.

An evaluation engine applies advanced checks for hallucination, factuality, bias, toxicity, jailbreak attempts, and incorrect citations.

Results are aggregated into easy-to-understand scores with pass/fail and severity indicators, displayed on dashboards and integrated with alerting systems.

The system has modules to check images and videos for deepfakes, adding defense against multimedia misinformation.

A dedicated AI bot verifies whether statements are facts or misinformation, enhancing the scope beyond language models alone.

Continuous feedback includes sending failures to retraining or human reviewers to improve model quality over time.

This comprehensive and adaptive framework ensures only trustworthy AI models handle sensitive fact-checking, directly addressing the urgent misinformation challenges described in the problem statement.

**Description of your solution**

TruthGuard 🛡️ is an AI-powered misinformation detection and verification system that acts as a digital shield for users across news and social media platforms. It combines real-time data monitoring, natural-language understanding, and fact-checking intelligence to help users instantly verify what they read or share.

The system works through a simple workflow:
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/c96bd0a7d6b248faa633644d48e036b6/1d6d4767-8046-4ee5-acaf-ebc562cd855c.jpeg)

1. Fetches trending data from sources like News API, Twitter/X, and fact-check databases.

2. Analyzes content using NLP and LangChain-powered LLMs (GPT-4 / Gemini / Llama) to detect bias, exaggeration, or factual inconsistencies.

3. Cross-checks claims against verified databases (Google Fact Check, Wikipedia, reliable media sources).

4. Generates Smart Fact Cards with a credibility score, verified sources, and short summaries in the user’s preferred language.

5. Delivers alerts through a web dashboard, chatbot, and browser extension—so users are protected wherever they consume content.

TruthGuard isn’t just a tool — it’s a movement toward informed digital citizenship, empowering people to think critically, verify easily, and trust responsibly.

TruthGuard directly addresses the “Check Misinformation” track by providing a proactive, AI-powered system that detects, verifies, and explains misleading information in real time. Unlike traditional fact-checkers that react after misinformation spreads, TruthGuard:

Monitors news and social media trends as they emerge.

Generates concise, multilingual Fact Cards with credibility scores.

Combines AI reasoning (LangChain + LLMs) with human review for transparency and trust.

Works across platforms (web, mobile, browser), ensuring users get verified information wherever they encounter it.


This fits the track perfectly because it empowers users to identify, understand, and act on misinformation, enhancing digital literacy and reducing the impact of fake news.

- Personalized Alerts: Tailored updates based on user preferences and location.

**Differentiation**

- Auto-fusion of text, images, and videos into coherent insights.
- Multi-category data merging with AI mood maps and conversational personalization.
- Knowledge graphs for deeper context, surpassing static heatmaps and manual reporting tools.

**Impact**
- Proactive Prevention: Reduces unplanned downtime by up to 45% with predictive alerts.
- Civic Engagement: Increases user interaction by 30–40% with personalized alerts.
- Cost Efficiency: Cuts emergency repair costs by approximately 33%, optimizing infrastructure spend.

**Technical Stack**
- Front End: Flutter
- Back End: FastAPI
- AI/ML: Vertex AI, Gemini, Gemma
- DevOps: Vercel, Docker
- Cloud Platform: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
- Data Processing: BigQuery, Apache Beam
- APIs/SDKs: OpenRoute Service

**Business Feasibility**
- Urban Sentiment Index (USI): Monetize aggregated mood/stress data via subscriptions.
- Subscription Model: Premium tiers offering localized insights and advanced analytics.
- Experience-as-a-Service (EaaS): White-labeled civic tech solutions for smart cities.
- B2B Partnerships: Collaborate with retailers, event organizers, and insurers for predictive insights.

**In Short**
CityPulse transforms chaotic city data into a “live pulse” — empowering stakeholders with timely, actionable insights to enhance urban living.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

**CityPulse** addresses the misinformation problem statement by tackling the chaotic data overload in cities like Bengaluru and Pune, where **scattered**, **repetitive**, and **outdated** information from social media, traffic updates, and civic complaints fuels confusion and false narratives. Through its unified real-time ingestion and AI-powered summarization, it consolidates noisy data into a single, verified stream, using Gemini clustering and multimodal analysis to deduplicate and validate geo-tagged photos, videos, and audio, thus reducing the spread of unconfirmed reports. Predictive intelligence with Vertex AI forecasts issues like congestion or outages before they escalate, while personalized alerts tailored via Gemma-powered user profiles ensure relevant, trustworthy updates, countering generic misinformation. This **end-to-end solution**, supported by a scalable backend and interactive dashboard, transforms fragmented data into actionable insights, helping citizens, officials, and service providers stay informed and act decisively, effectively curbing **misinformation's impact**.

> System to Detect and Counter Misinformation

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**Agentic AI Misinformation Firewall & Rescue Agent**

This is a multi-agent platform which shows actual reality behind the news with the proofs. A user submits a news item with media. The first agent searches social media and the web to collect all related posts, articles, and evidence. The second agent analyzes that collected data and calculates a trust score (true, likely true, likely fake, fake). The third agent prepares a clear result and shows the verdict and all supporting proofs on a dashboard. The system aims to make verification fast, transparent, and easy to use.

How it works (step-by-step):

User adds the news text + media (image/video/link).

Agent 1 (Collector) gathers related content across platforms, grabs timestamps, sources, user profiles, and similar posts.

Agent 2 (Verifier) runs checks: cross-source matching, reverse image/video search, credibility of sources, fact checks, and ML classifiers then computes a score.

Agent 3 (Presenter) builds a readable report with the final verdict, score, evidence links, key quotes, and visual timeline on a dashboard.

Built with LangGraph, Gemini/Claude APIs, and real-time data pipelines, it’s a step toward a more resilient information ecosystem.

**Description of your solution**

=> **SmartAuction - Voice-Powered Real-Time Auction System**

****#Problem Statement**
Conventional auction platforms rely heavily on manual inputs - users must continuously monitor the site, refresh bids, and manually place offers.

This process:
Lacks accessibility for differently-abled or visually challenged users.
Is time-sensitive and demands constant user attention.
Provides limited engagement - there’s no interactive or conversational interface.
Makes it hard for businesses to run auctions efficiently across multiple products.

As AI assistants and voice interfaces become mainstream, there’s an opportunity to transform how users interact with real-time marketplaces.

**# Solution Overview
**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/da0ae4a167bf450c9720a7cd1e424f52/cada2aea-9018-4f81-a615-c88cbb56624e.png)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/da0ae4a167bf450c9720a7cd1e424f52/b7d83ad1-3cf6-41a6-aab4-42d22eb5bc82.png)

**SmartAuction **is an** AI-powered**, **voice-interactive**, **real-time auction system** that enables users to participate hands-free using natural language.
Our system combines speech recognition, conversational AI, and real-time bidding to deliver a seamless and accessible auction experience.

Users can:
-Speak naturally to place or modify bids - e.g., “Increase my bid by ₹1000 on the iPhone 15.”
-Converse with an intelligent AI agent that answers queries like “What’s the highest bid right now?” or “When does this auction end?”
-Receive instant updates on bid changes and product status in real time.
Admins can manage auctions, view analytics, and close auctions via a web dashboard.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/da0ae4a167bf450c9720a7cd1e424f52/ad04881c-aa19-4c87-92cc-ed8009a5dc48.png)

**#System Architecture (End to End) & #Agentic Workflow**
1.)System Architecture:

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/da0ae4a167bf450c9720a7cd1e424f52/3c118f88-45ab-4b5e-9d94-ff0b51047964.png)

2.)Wireframing and Webflow

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/da0ae4a167bf450c9720a7cd1e424f52/bed7aa79-4bb1-4040-87ed-0c1785fedf2b.png)

->Frontend (Web UI) - Users or admins interact with the dashboard to view or manage auctions.

->Voice Agent (OmniDimension) - Handles speech input/output, powered by ChatGPT-4.0, Deepgram (STT), and ElevenLabs (TTS).

->Flask Backend – Processes user intents, validates bids, handles real-time updates, and communicates with the database.

->MongoDB Database – Stores auction, product, and bid data, ensuring persistence and scalability.

# Key Features: 

-Voice-driven Bidding: Participate in auctions using natural speech commands.
-AI-assisted Conversations: OmniDimension agent responds contextually and                            handles follow-up queries.
-Real-time Updates: Live reflection of bid changes and auction expiry.
-Dashboard Control: Admins can manage products, monitor bids, and track analytics.
-Auto-expiry Logic: Auctions automatically end when their duration expires.
-Multi-platform Integration: Works with web and voice interfaces in sync.

# Impact

-Democratizes auctions by making them accessible and inclusive (voice-first interface).
-Adds AI intelligence to traditional e-commerce bidding systems.
-Provides a scalable model for property auctions, NFT marketplaces, art sales, and charity bidding platforms.
-Promotes fairness and transparency through automated bidding validation.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

InformalStack is an agentic AI platform revolutionizing credit access for India's 450 million informal sector workers—street vendors, gig workers, daily wage earners, and micro-entrepreneurs locked out of traditional banking.

**The Problem:** Banks cannot assess creditworthiness for irregular income earners with no credit history. These workers rely on exploitative moneylenders charging 40%+ interest, trapping them in poverty cycles.

**Our Solution:** InformalStack creates alternative credit profiles using non-traditional data: UPI transactions, gig platform earnings (Swiggy, Uber, Rapido, Urban Company), utility payments, GST filings, and community verification. Our custom machine learning models detect stability in irregular income patterns that banks miss.

Agentic AI Innovation: Beyond passive analysis, our AI agent autonomously acts on users' behalf. It continuously monitors earning patterns via India Stack's Account Aggregator framework, builds credit profiles, then negotiates with 50+ microfinance institutions in real-time to secure optimal loan terms. The agent reduces interest rates from 40% to 18-24%, cutting borrowing costs in half.

Most critically, the AI acts as an "AI guarantor"—proactively adjusting credit limits as income grows, sending early warnings for financial stress, and continuously advocating for better opportunities. Users own their credit history through immutable ledgers, creating portable financial identity that builds wealth over decades.

Impact: Target 60,000 users in Year 1, facilitating ₹500 crore loan book. Enable first-time credit access for workers earning ₹15K-40K monthly.

**Note:** We couldn't fit the PPT in the submission window and hence full pitch deck available at [**Here**](https://drive.google.com/file/d/12pZPk_JSDnVQ_mA05_h3fgx8YKMVSyc4/view?usp=sharing) due to submission window constraints.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

InformalStack is quintessentially fintech across three critical dimensions:

**Core Financial Infrastructure:** We're building essential lending infrastructure—a credit scoring engine and digital lending marketplace. Our solution leverages AI/ML for risk assessment, and full India Stack integration (UPI, Account Aggregator, DigiLocker, Aadhaar). Credit scoring is the foundation of all financial services, and we're reimagining it for India's largest underserved segment.

**Alternative Credit Innovation:** Traditional fintech still relies on CIBIL scores requiring existing credit history. We pioneer alternative credit scoring using digital footprints—transaction data, gig earnings, behavioral patterns. This is fintech's next evolution: using technology to democratize access. Our models achieve 70% approval rates versus 15% from traditional lenders for informal workers.

**Complete Fintech Value Chain:** We touch every fintech domain—credit assessment, risk management, digital lending, payments integration, regulatory compliance (RBI Account Aggregator framework), and financial literacy. Our B2B2C model connects gig platforms, microfinance institutions, NBFCs, and end-users, creating an ecosystem generating ₹500+ crore loan book in Year 1.

**Market Impact:** Financial inclusion is fintech's highest mission. We're solving credit access for 450M Indians—a ₹10 lakh crore market gap. Our technology reduces borrowing costs by 50% while helping lenders tap previously invisible markets with 60% lower operational costs than traditional field agents.

InformalStack uses agentic AI to transform invisible workers into creditworthy borrowers, proving that fintech's greatest innovation isn't just moving money faster—it's moving it to those who need it most.

> LEVERAGING AI TO PREVENT MISINFORMATION

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

WE ARE CREATING AN AI WHICH WOULD TAKE INPUT AS FILES TO CHECK FOR MIS INFORMATION AND PROVIDE OUTPUT AS THE CORRECT INFORMATON USING RELIABLE SOURCES.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

We propose MisInfoGuard[TATHYA], an intelligent agentic AI system that autonomously detects and counters misinformation in real-time across digital platforms. The solution leverages GEMINI and custom-trained NLP models to continuously monitor social media feeds, news articles, and messaging platforms, automatically identifying suspicious content through semantic analysis, source verification, and cross-referencing with trusted fact-checking databases. When misinformation is detected, the AI agent independently initiates corrective actions: posting fact-checked responses, flagging content for human review, and generating personalized educational content to help users recognize false information. The system learns from each interaction, adapts to emerging misinformation patterns, and provides dashboard analytics for content moderators and platform administrators. By combining automated detection, proactive response, and continuous learning, MisInfoGuard creates a self-sustaining ecosystem that reduces the spread of false information while educating users, making it particularly effective during high-stakes events like elections, health crises, or breaking news situations.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

In an era overwhelmed with misinformation, FactClub emerges as a one stop solution to filter the fact from the noises this world beholds. Before going further let me introduce to some basic rules of FactClub.
Rule 1: We never spread misinformation
Rule 2: Always remember Rule 1.

At first glance, misinformation may seem insignificant but history reminds us again and again that it is capable of collapsing economies, toppling governments and divide societies. Even the slightest of misinformation can cause stocks to crash, create chaos and affect the masses.
Case Study: Satyam Computers – Stock Crash Due to Misinformation (src: https://knowledge.wharton.upenn.edu/article/scandal-at-satyam-truth-lies-and-corporate-governance/)
In December 2008, Satyam Computers announced plans to acquire Maytas Infra and Maytas Properties, companies associated with its founder. This move raised concerns among investors about potential conflicts of interest and governance issues. Although the board was not directly implicated in the fraud, the announcement led to a sharp decline in Satyam's stock price. The situation escalated when, on January 7, 2009, founder Ramalinga Raju confessed to inflating the company's accounts by over $1 billion. This revelation caused the stock to plummet by 78% in a single day, highlighting the significant impact of misinformation on investor confidence and market stability

WORKFLOW
FactClub is an Agentic AI which provides verified news about user requirements and can even verify the news provided by the user. The workflow is as follows:-
1. FactClub fetches news using News APIs
2. Use NLP(Natural Language Processing) to convert the text to numbers
    a. TF-IDF(Term Frequency - Inverse Document Frequency): Better for small to medium dataset and quick training and testing.
    b. BERT: Captures context, negation and nuance resulting in better accuracy but GPU requirements are high.
3. Score tested on Machine learning Algo(which is a train_test_split in sci-kit learn linear regression model tested on a number of verified factual news and verified misinformation converted to numbers using NLP) and a credibility score is assigned to the news.
4. If the credibility of news is better than the minimum credibility required then the credibility of the source is incremented accordingly and then the source of the news is checked
    a. If credibility score of source is more than the minimum requirements then the news is published.
    b. If credibility score of source is less than minimum requirements then the news is not published but pushed to be verified by users.
    But if credibility of news is lower than minimum credibility then credibility of source is decremented accordingly.
5. If the news pushed to be verified by user has majority upvotes then it is published and the credibility score of source is incremented accordingly.

MONETIZATION 
User Subscription Model:
    Free Trial: 3 months free trial then 1 month for ₹150
    Subsequent Months: ₹120, Net Profit = ₹120 − ₹75 = ₹45

Ad Revenue (Free Users):
    ₹15 to 20 per month for each free user, which partly covers the cost (₹75 per user)

Break-even per User:
    Break-even Month = Operational Cost per User / Net Revenue per User
    First Paid Month: ₹75/₹75 = 1 month
    Weighted Average for 100 Users (50% paid, 20% free, 30% churn) is about 2 to   2.5 months

Operational Costs (Monthly):
    GPU & Model Hosting: ₹1,50,000
    Servers/Database: ₹50,000
    News APIs: ₹25,000
    Dev & Maintenance: ₹30,000
    Marketing/Support: ₹1,00,000
Total is about ₹3.55 lakh (early stage)

Revenue & Profit Example (10,000 Users, Early Stage):
    Paid Users: 50%, which means 5,000 × ₹120 = ₹6,00,000 monthly revenue
    Free Users' Ad Revenue: 20%, meaning 2,000 × ₹15 = ₹30,000
Total Revenue is about ₹6.3 lakh
Costs for 10,000 Users is around ₹7,50,000, so break-even is possible as more users convert

B2B / Enterprise APIs:
    API/Dashboard Client Revenue: ₹20,000 to 50,000 per month
    Uses B2C data to improve AI accuracy, providing a high-margin contribution

Growth & Scalability (50,000 Users plus B2B Clients):
    Subscription Revenue: 25,000 × ₹120 = ₹30 lakh
    Ads: 10,000 × ₹15 = ₹1.5 lakh
    B2B Revenue: 10 clients × ₹30,000 = ₹3 lakh
Total Revenue is about ₹34.5 lakh
Operational Costs are around ₹7 lakh, leading to a Net Profit of approximately ₹27.5 lakh (~60% margin)

Global B2C Base plus Enterprise Integration leads to revenue from subscriptions, ads, and API, which offers scalable revenue with high profit margins
The focus remains on B2C, while B2B enhances profitability and enterprise credibility

**Description of your solution**

Misinformation spreads rapidly on social media, confusing users and often causing harm. ***VerityGuard*** is an **AI-powered app** designed to make fact-checking engaging, intuitive, and accessible for everyone. ***VerityGuard*** continuously monitors news from diverse sources, **including RSS feeds** and social media platforms, to provide comprehensive coverage of emerging misinformation trends.

***Transparent Trust Scoring***
At the core of VerityGuard is its transparent Trust Score, calculated as:

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/933aa79139134138b73d30d2e3cd65ac/99ea5631-04e2-438c-9dfd-2549e1a18dad.png)
Verified Source Points are weighted higher for credible sources (e.g., government agencies, scientific journals). For example, an article with 8 verified sources and 2 unverified claims scores 80%. Scores ≥75% earn a ✅ "Verified" mark, while lower scores show ⏳ until verification is complete.

***Seamless User Journey***
Users sign up securely and can instantly browse trending stories. Tapping an article reveals sentence-level highlights powered by Explainable AI (XAI), showing which claims impacted the Trust Score by including a source link. Users can report false news with proof, which is verified via a hybrid AI-human workflow: a fine-tuned BERT model pre-screens content, enabling admins to efficiently confirm reports against trusted databases.

***Gamified Community Impact***
Approved reports earn points, unlocking badges and titles like Fact Finder or Verified Guardian, fostering a community of active truth-seekers. Gamification, real-time notifications, and safety tips strengthen digital literacy and keep users engaged.

***Built for Scale, Designed for Impact***
Deployed as a web app on Vercel and optimized for mobile, ***VerityGuard’s*** **lightweight, cost-effective architecture ensures global accessibility**. **Modeling projects a 70% reduction in exposure to misinformation, helping build a resilient and informed online community.**

***VerityGuard*** exemplifies how ethical, explainable AI can counter digital misinformation at scale.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

***VerityGuard*** perfectly aligns with the **Misinformation Detection AI** track by **combining advanced artificial intelligence, ethical design, and user-centric innovation** to counter the rapid spread of false information during crises. Driven by a fine-tuned **BERT NLP model**, ***VerityGuard*** **autonomously** scans and verifies content in real time, assigning each article a transparent **Trust Score** based on the ratio of verified to unverified claims. **This ensures measurable accuracy and contextual clarity, enabling users to instantly assess credibility.**

To sustain **high performance**, the **system retrains continuously on adversarial samples and updates via a domain-adapted knowledge graph**, ensuring resilience against evolving misinformation tactics. Beyond detection, ***VerityGuard*** integrates **Explainable AI (XAI)** to highlight specific sentences influencing Trust Scores, and employs gamified verification to turn users into active truth-seekers, promoting engagement and digital literacy.

**Its patent-pending lightweight cross-platform widget uniquely delivers Trust Scores and XAI insights seamlessly across web and mobile, ensuring a consistent, scalable, and cost-efficient user experience. Grounded in recent research (ScienceDirect, 2024 [https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2667325824000414] ; MDPI, 2023 [https://www.mdpi.com/2079-9292/12/24/5041]) on AI-driven misinformation detection,** ***VerityGuard’s*** **combination of explainability, community participation, and scalable ethical AI establishes a distinctive, high-performance ecosystem that not only detects misinformation but restores trust and strengthens information integrity globally.**

**Description of your solution**

Auramind is an agentic AI-powered health assistant that turns raw lab reports into actionable, personalized wellness insights. Many professionals undergo regular checkups but struggle to interpret biomarkers, leaving early health deviations unnoticed. Traditional apps and coaches either lack medical context or provide one-time guidance.

Auramind continuously monitors uploaded blood reports, detects trends, and generates adaptive nutrition and fitness plans. Its AI agent reasons over data, plans interventions, and interacts conversationally to answer queries or clarify results. A feedback loop personalizes recommendations over time.

The MVP allows users to upload sample reports, visualize trends, and receive tailored guidance. Auramind makes preventive care proactive, personalized, and engaging—like having a health analyst and nutrition coach in your pocket.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Auramind fits HealthTech by enabling preventive and personalized care. It continuously monitors biomarkers, translates medical data into actionable insights, and helps users make informed lifestyle, nutrition, and fitness decisions proactively.
Auramind uses Agentic AI to move beyond static recommendations. It autonomously monitors user biomarkers, analyzes trends, and identifies potential risks before they escalate. By reasoning and planning multi-step actions—like suggesting diet changes, recommending supplements, or scheduling follow-up tests—it adapts to each user’s unique responses over time. Human feedback refines its guidance, making recommendations increasingly precise and personalized. This goal-driven, adaptive approach ensures that Auramind acts as an intelligent health manager rather than a passive assistant, continuously guiding users toward optimal health outcomes with proactive, personalized, and actionable insights.

**Description of your solution**

What we plan to build
We propose an Agentic AI Media Insight Agent delivered through WhatsApp, designed to autonomously evaluate, contextualize, and provide evidence-backed insights on information shared through online videos that users forward it. The agent extracts key claims from videos, assesses credibility, debunks frivolous or misleading claims, and offers relevant context and alternative sources — all while remaining neutral and transparent.

Pain points addressed

Rapid spread of misinformation: Short-form and online videos circulate quickly, making it hard for users to distinguish reliable content.

Difficulty in verifying claims: Users often lack the time or tools to cross-check statements, leading to misconceptions.

Limited access to verification tools: Many young people, especially in rural or semi-urban areas, do not have accessible solutions to understand or contextualize online content.


Target audience

Youth demographic (students, young professionals) whose opinions and understanding of current events are heavily influenced by online video content on platforms like Instagram and YouTube.


GTM and Revenue Streams

The agent can collect anonymous analytics on trending topics, widely circulated narratives, and frequently debunked claims.

This data can be offered to content creators, infotainment platforms, and news organizations to help them understand audience interests, detect misinformation trends, and create informed content strategies — providing a revenue stream without compromising user privacy.


Impact

Empowers users to critically evaluate online content.

Provides a neutral, educational tool to navigate misinformation.

Enables organizations to gain insights into information trends responsibly.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

With India’s predominantly young population consuming news and information primarily through short-form videos on platforms like Instagram and YouTube, misinformation spreads rapidly in visually engaging yet unverified content.
Unlike traditional news sources, these videos often lack context, source credibility, or fact verification — leading to distorted understanding of current events and social issues.
There is a growing need for intelligent, autonomous systems that can analyze, interpret, and verify the authenticity of video-based information, empowering users to make informed judgments instead of passively consuming potentially misleading content.

PaperTrade Pro is India’s #1 virtual paper trading platform that simulates real-time stock market conditions. It provides a completely safe, risk-free environment for aspiring and seasoned traders to practice, test strategies, and build market confidence using virtual money—not real capital.

• **Current Positions Management:** Track all open positions with key insights like Average Cost, Current Price, Total Value, and P&L for each holding.

**Description of your solution**

Autonomous Digital Inheritance & Probate Agent (ADIPA)
A Multi-Agent System for Autonomous Digital Estate Management

1. Introduction
The exponential growth of digital assets — ranging from cryptocurrencies and NFTs to 
digital banking portfolios — has created an urgent need for a secure, automated, and 
legally compliant mechanism for digital inheritance management. Traditional probate 
processes are slow, fragmented, and heavily dependent on human intermediaries.
To address this challenge, ADIPA (Autonomous Digital Inheritance & Probate Agent)
has been conceptualized as an expert-level Multi-Agent AI System (MAS) that 
autonomously manages the end-to-end digital inheritance and probate lifecycle. The 
system leverages agentic intelligence to perform high-level legal, financial, and 
technical functions traditionally carried out by fiduciaries, lawyers, and compliance 
officers.

2. Problem Statement
Current digital estate transfer methods are manual, time-consuming, and prone to 
security and compliance risks. There is no unified mechanism for:
• Validating digital wills and heirship.
• Discovering and valuing multi-platform digital assets.
• Ensuring compliance with global KYC/AML standards.
• Securely transferring ownership of digital assets upon confirmation of death.
ADIPA aims to create a trustless, compliant, and autonomous solution that bridges 
this gap using intelligent agent orchestration.

3. System Overview
ADIPA functions as a multi-agent legal-financial executor, mirroring a human team of 
estate administrators. The architecture is modular, with distinct agents responsible for 
specialized domains such as legal validation, asset discovery, valuation, compliance, 
and secure transfer.
Each agent operates autonomously but collaborates through an orchestration 
framework to ensure consistency and legal defensibility. The overall workflow includes:

- Legal Validation – Verifying wills, heirship, and compliance documents.
- Digital Asset Discovery – Identifying and indexing assets across multiple platforms.
- Valuation – Assessing the market value of volatile and non-volatile digital assets.
- Secure Transfer – Executing ownership transfer using MPC-based cryptography.
- Audit & Compliance Logging – Maintaining an immutable transaction record via Kafka streams.

4. Key Functional Agents
• Legal Validation Agent
Interprets digital wills, verifies beneficiary credentials, and performs compliance 
checks using embedded legal RAG systems.
• Digital Discovery Agent
Uses encrypted credential vaults to locate and list digital assets across banking, 
blockchain, and cloud platforms.
• Valuation Agent
Calculates real-time fair market value using integrated financial data APIs and 
price feeds.
• Secure Transfer Agent
Executes non-custodial digital asset transfers via Multi-Party Computation 
(MPC) wallets, ensuring cryptographic integrity.

5. Innovation and Impact
ADIPA transforms probate from a manual, opaque, and slow process into a 
transparent, auditable, and fully autonomous system. Its unique integration of multi￾agent intelligence, MPC cryptography, and RAG-driven legal reasoning provides:
• Zero human intervention in digital asset inheritance.
• Regulatory compliance through built-in KYC/AML validation.
• Legal defensibility with Kafka-based audit trails.
• Scalability for cross-jurisdictional digital estates.
This system represents a significant advancement toward autonomous fiduciary 
intelligence — a foundational element for future AI-governed financial ecosystems.

6. Tech stack

- Agent Orchestration (Microsoft AutoGen): Coordinates AI agents and delegates tasks.

- Core Intelligence (GPT-4, Claude, SLMs): Executes complex legal and financial reasoning.
 
- Legal RAG Engine (PostgreSQL + pgvector): Grounds the AI in verified legal documents.
 
- Backend (FastAPI): Enables communication between agents and system integration.
 
- Data Layer (PostgreSQL): Stores records, audit logs, and vector embeddings.
 
- Event Streaming (Apache Kafka): Manages immutable audit trails and agent communication.
 
- Security (AWS KMS / Bitwarden): Manages secure credential storage and encryption keys.
 
- Crypto Custody (MPC Wallets): Executes secure, non-custodial asset transfers.
 
- Cloud Deployment (Kubernetes on AWS/Azure/GCP): Provides scalable and compliant infrastructure.
 
- Compliance (Open Banking & KYC/AML APIs): Automates beneficiary verification 

7. Conclusion
The Autonomous Digital Inheritance & Probate Agent (ADIPA) establishes a new 
benchmark in the intersection of AI governance, digital finance, and legal 
automation. By combining multi-agent collaboration with regulatory-grade security, 
it redefines how digital estates are managed in a decentralized economy.
This initiative not only streamlines the inheritance process but also lays the foundation 
for self-governing fiduciary AI systems that can operate transparently, securely, and 
autonomously in the future of digital trust.

To address this challenge, ADIPA (Autonomous Digital Inheritance & Probate Agent)

**Description of your solution**

**CivicShield** is a **comprehensive solution** designed to address the escalating issue of **misinformation during elections** by leveraging a **multi-agent intelligent architecture**. This platform **autonomously monitors** a wide range of **content streams** spanning **social media**, **news outlets**, and **messaging platforms**, ensuring **real-time detection** of **emerging misinformation trends**. It integrates **advanced fact verification techniques** that **cross-reference claims against trusted government databases** and reputable fact-checking repositories, thereby fostering **election integrity and transparency**.

The system incorporates a **deepfake detection module** using **state-of-the-art computer vision models** to identify **manipulated audio-visual content** that can influence public perception. **Network analysis** employs **graph neural networks** to map the **propagation of misinformation**, detect potentially malicious **bot networks**, and prioritize critical threats based on **viral spread patterns**.

Built on a **cloud-native infrastructure** utilizing **container orchestration with Kubernetes** and **real-time data streaming via Apache Kafka**, CivicShield ensures **scalability**, **high availability**, and efficient management of vast incoming data. Its backend microservices, implemented with **Node.js and Python**, coordinate seamlessly through an **event-driven orchestration layer**, enabling **autonomous yet collaborative operation of specialized AI agents**.

The platform supports **multilingual contextual explanations** delivered through **large language models** and **retrieval-augmented generation**, enhancing **accessibility and understanding** for **diverse audiences** across India’s linguistic spectrum. Compliant with government standards on **security and data privacy**, CivicShield incorporates **end-to-end encrypted communication**, **role-based access control**, and **comprehensive audit logging**, ensuring trustworthy integration with **Election Commission systems**.

Through **adaptive continuous learning workflows** that leverage ongoing feedback, CivicShield evolves to meet the challenges posed by novel **misinformation tactics** and **electoral crises**, establishing itself as an indispensable tool for **safeguarding democratic processes**.

### **Key USPs and Features**

- **Multi-Agent Autonomy:** Five specialized AI agents working collaboratively to monitor, verify, analyze, detect, and respond to election misinformation in real-time.
- **Cross-Referenced Fact Verification:** Automatically validates claims using trusted government databases and fact-checking repositories, ensuring high-confidence accuracy.
- **Deepfake & Media Manipulation Detection:** Utilizes cutting-edge computer vision and audio forensics models to detect synthetic or manipulated media.
- **Network Spread & Bot Detection:** Employs graph neural networks for detailed mapping of misinformation spread and identifying coordinated bot networks.
- **Real-Time Scalable Architecture:** Cloud-native deployment on Kubernetes and Apache Kafka enables seamless horizontal scaling and high availability during peak loads.
- **Multilingual Accessible Explanations:** Generates contextual, easy-to-understand alerts and explanations across 22+ Indian languages catering to diverse populations.
- **Continuous Adaptive Learning:** Real-time feedback integration improves model accuracy and resilience against evolving misinformation tactics.
- **End-to-End Security & Compliance:** Incorporates robust encryption, role-based access, audit trails, and compliance with government standards ensuring data privacy and trust.
- **Seamless Election Commission Integration:** Standardized API layer enables smooth interoperability with existing government election management systems.

**Description of your solution**

We present VeritasAI an agentic AI ecosystem for real-time misinformation detection and verification during crises, built using the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) and the Pathway Framework.

Our system autonomously scans multi-source, multimodal data streams (social media, news, video transcripts, and forums) to detect emerging misinformation clusters, extract and verify claims, and generate contextual, audience-specific summaries that explain the truth clearly and transparently.

At its core, VeritasAI is a multi-agent architecture featuring specialized agents for ingestion, classification, claim extraction, retrieval-augmented verification (RAG), consensus reasoning, correction generation, and ethical auditing. Pathway powers continuous, low-latency data streaming and live vector indexing for sub-second misinformation detection.

2. Automated claim extraction and verification via trusted databases and fact-checking APIs.
3. Explainable verdicts and provenance trails (true/false/misleading with citation-linked reasoning).
4. Public dashboards, journalist briefs, and developer APIs for real-time insights.
5. Continuous learning feedback loops for improved accuracy over time.

This system directly combats misinformation harms, from false medical advice to fake evacuation alerts, empowering citizens, journalists, and policymakers with verified, comprehensible, and transparent information.

**In short**: VeritasAI brings together real-time data intelligence, multi-agent orchestration, and explainable verification to ensure that, in moments of crisis, truth travels faster than lies.
