**Description of your solution**

SafeBalance
Your friendly cash companion
By Team Harkonnen

**Background**
The gig economy represents the sector of the economy with workers engaged in flexible, short-term jobs often involving day-to-day payments. Gig economy workers are often hired on a temporary basis for certain , and their wages vary widely depending upon the quantity of tasks they receive per day, and the payout for each task. This is unlike the full-time employment offered in traditional white or blue-collar jobs, which offer a stable contractually mandated monthly salary. Examples of blue collar work include delivery services, drivers for cab aggregators like Ola and Uber, freelance work like graphic design or writing, people engaged in part-time labour intensive work as farm labour and so on. Per a [2022 policy brief](https://www.niti.gov.in/sites/default/files/2023-06/Policy_Brief_India%27s_Booming_Gig_and_Platform_Economy_27062022.pdf)  by NITI Aayog, India had approximately 7.7 million gig and platform workers in 2020-21, a figure projected to surge to 23.5 million by 2029-30.

**Featureset**

**Income Volatility Prediction Engine**
The heart of the platform will be an Income Volatility Prediction Engine, a collection of lightweight machine learning based predictive models built using historical data that will adapt itself to the user’s spending habits. The cash flow will be recorded from multiple sources; UPI apps (like GPay or PhonePe), bank accounts transaction histories and manual cash entries. By unifying fragmented financial data, the agent will build a profile of a user’s income and expenses. It will parse spending from transactions, classify it into categories (rent, EMIs, food, travel), and continuously update the user’s financial profile. Based on this data, the users will be classified into user types. The users will be classified on the basis of their income levels, their vulnerability, the variance in their monthly incomes, and their willingness to adjust their financial habits.

**Conversational Chat Interface**
The user will be able to interact with the AI agent through a chat interface. The agent will be multilingual and will support conversations in multiple Indian languages, with a voice mode for easier accessibility. Users can ask questions like,
*How much can I spend this weekend?*
Or 
*How much money should I save for my child’s birthday next month?,*
without going through complex planning or navigating through spreadsheets of account data.


**Insights**
The agent will deliver short snippets of financial suggestions in the form of “Insights”. These are short notifications that suggest immediate action, delivered in-app or through email/SMS. The actions suggested will be intuitive and can be easily executed by the user. For example,
*Phone EMI payment next week, move 800₹ to savings.*
Or
*Expected increase in expenditure at the end of month, conserve money by reducing spending.*
These Insights will be capped to a certain amount (around 10–20 per month) in the free tier to prevent user annoyance, and the Insight limit could be increased in the paid tier.


**Cashflow Forecasting and Budgeting**
SafeBalance will predict the cash flow using time series modelling of the user’s transactions. Using this it can predict, with a certain level of certainty, the likelihood of the user being in a financially unsafe position at some point in the near future. For example,
*69% chance of bank balance dropping below 1000₹ by October 15th*
Each forecast will come with an explanation and suggested actions for the user. Based on whether the user carries out the action, we can also figure out how receptive the user is to suggestions and how likely they are to execute them.

**Privacy and Data Control**
SafeBalance will follow stringent privacy and security practices for handling personal data in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the Sensitive Personal Information Rules, 2011. User data will be anonymised. Every data integration will be opt-in. Users can view the data accessible to the platform and delete it anytime they want.

**Business Model and Revenue**
The platform would utilize a freemium business model, with a free tier and paid tier with a monthly subscription focused on more enhanced Insights. An additional revenue stream could be through partnerships with banks and other financial institutions and services, enabling integrated services and potential collaboration of ideas. At a more advanced stage, the platform could also offer investment advice for the users to invest their spare cash into.

**Tech Stack**
Flutter app(cross-platform for iOS & Android)
Firebase Auth (Google, Email/Password, Phone OTP)
MongoDB Atlas (Transactional Data (Time-Series))
PostgreSQL (User data and analysis)
IVP Engine  (LSTM(TensorFlow/PyTorch))
Flask and Docker for endpoints and containerization
Azure for deployment
UPI API for transaction access.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

SafeBalance is a financial AI agent for part-time employees, gig economy workers and other members of the informal workforce to safely manage their income and make better financial decisions. It is intended to be an adaptive agent that continuously learns a user’s cashflow patterns from multiple data streams, detects risks (late bills, low-cash windows), and proactively suggests/automates concrete actions in an easy, intuitive format. Our project aims to solve challenges faced by informal economy workers.

The informal sector (of which the gig economy is a part)constitutes the backbone of India's economy, accounting for over 90% of the workforce and contributing 45% of the national GDP. The defining hallmark of the informal sector is the lack of income stability as experienced by its workforce. A report by the University of Pennsylvania and the Indian Federation of App-Based Transport Workers (IFAT) showed that 43 per cent cab drivers reported a net monthly earning (that is after deducting costs such as food, fuel, vehicle maintenance and easy monthly instalments) of below Rs 15,000, while 34 per cent delivery persons reported a net monthly earning of Rs 10,000. This led to difficulty in managing household expenses, as experienced by over 70 per cent cab drivers and delivery persons reported.
The earnings of informal sector workers are unstable and vary widely depending upon external factors. Most of these factors are beyond their control. For example, food delivery sales jump during weekends and festivals, but may remain stagnant otherwise. An agricultural labourer may not find employment outside of crop season. Cab aggregators may earn less depending upon their area of operation (outside cities vs inside cities).
The classification of informal sector workers as “partners” rather than employees ends up excluding them from labour protection laws. A majority of platform workers have no social security net, leaving them without health insurance, pension, or paid leave.
As a result of their low spare cash flow, these workers also struggle to adequately balance their finances and save money for rainy day situations such as health emergencies.
Furthermore, many workers in India’s gig and informal economy come from low-education backgrounds, which significantly affects their earning potential, financial management ability, and career mobility. Those from rural areas may also lack the technological literacy required to understand the increasingly digitized payment structures, taxation systems, or benefits associated with savings and digital finance.
Digital payment apps like PhonePe, PayTM and Google Pay have enabled millions of people to become part of the informal sector, but they have also encouraged smoother, and consequently more impulsive, spending habits. The very nature of these apps encourages users to spend money more impulsively, which is a behavioural hazard for variable income workers, who have a low income to begin with.
We thus propose SafeBalance, a personalized financial AI agent designed to help gig workers, part-time earners, and members of India’s informal economy achieve financial stability and wellness. It will continuously learn from the user’s actual earning and spending behaviour, detect risk patterns like upcoming cash shortfalls, and provide easy-to-understand guidance in the form of Insights to improve financial decisions.

In today’s fast-paced and stressful world, people go through countless experiences and emotions every day but rarely take the time to reflect on them. Most individuals struggle to maintain a consistent journaling habit, and traditional methods like notebooks or simple note-taking apps often fail to provide meaningful insights or motivation. The lack of emotional awareness, disorganized entries, and privacy concerns make it difficult for users to understand their personal growth over time. The Personal Experience Journaling Platform solves these problems by providing a secure and intelligent digital space where users can record their thoughts, emotions, and daily experiences. # 🌱 Problems BioHarvest AI Solves  

**BioHarvest AI tackles fundamental, real-world challenges that profoundly impact global food security and environmental sustainability — ultimately affecting everyone’s daily life.**

---

## 1. 🌍 The Climate Crisis Threatening Food & Environment  

**Real-world Impact:**  
- **Food Instability:** Extreme weather events (droughts, floods, heatwaves) devastate global crop yields, leading to volatile food prices, reduced variety, and unstable supply chains for every household.  
- **Environmental Degradation:** Weak crops demand excessive water, chemical fertilizers, and pesticides — resulting in **polluted water bodies, degraded soil, and compromised ecosystems** in local communities.  

**Significance:**  
➡️ These are **not just scientific issues** — they are **critical daily life problems** affecting **health, economy, and the planet’s future.**

---

## 2. ⏳ Inefficient & Slow Agricultural Adaptation  

- **Problem:** Traditional crop breeding methods are **painstakingly slow** — taking **10–15+ years** to develop new varieties.  
- **Gap:** This pace is **utterly insufficient** to adapt agriculture to the **rapidly accelerating impacts of climate change**, leaving humanity **vulnerable**.  

---

## 3. 🔬 Fragmented Genetic Design & Validation  

**Problem:** Scientists currently rely on **disconnected tools** and **manual processes** for:  
- **Genetic Discovery:** Sifting through disparate databases.  
- **Mutation Design:** Largely **guesswork**, lacking systematic AI guidance.  
- **Prediction & Validation:** Limited, often human-centric tools with **little to no integrated scientific explanation**.  
- **Experimental Planning:** **Manual protocol generation** and **inefficient resource estimation**.  

**Gap:**  
➡️ There’s **no unified, intelligent platform** to proactively design, predict, and plan genetic modifications for **specific climate-resilience traits in crops**.  
➡️ This leads to **massive R&D costs, wasted resources, and slow progress.**

---

# 🌾 The BioHarvest AI Solution  

**BioHarvest AI bridges these gaps** by providing an **integrated, AI-driven solution** that:  
✅ Accelerates **genetic adaptation**  
✅ Ensures **stable food supplies**  
✅ Protects a **healthier environment for all**

**Challenges we ran into**

**Problem:**
Our core innovation relies on state-of-the-art Protein Large Language Models (LLMs) like ESM-2/Evo2 for generative design and complex mutation prediction. These models are computationally intensive, requiring significant GPU power (H100/A100) for real-time inference. For a hackathon MVP, securing consistent, free access to such high-end GPUs for a live backend was the biggest hurdle. The sheer latency of even smaller LLMs on limited free-tier GPUs also posed a challenge for a "real-time" demo experience.

**How We Overcame It:**

**1. Strategic Simulation & Frontend Excellence:** We focused our efforts on building an impeccable, fully functional frontend prototype that simulated the LLM's instant responses. Instead of a live, slow AI, we crafted a visually dynamic and interactive UI that presented pre-computed/hardcoded, compelling AI insights (e.g., optimal mutation suggestions, multi-trait radar charts, XAI explanations) within 1-2 seconds of loading animation. This ensured a flawless demo experience that truly showcased the intended power and speed of our AI, adhering to the "Technical Soundness & Prototype/Presentation" criteria.

**2. Robust Backend Architecture Plan:** We rigorously designed a modular FastAPI backend, optimized for Modal's serverless H100/A100 GPUs. We thoroughly researched LLM deployment strategies (e.g., using transformers library, optimizing for inference speed) and secured a clear, viable plan for integrating these high-performance models post-hackathon. This demonstrated our deep technical understanding and feasibility, despite the hackathon's resource limitations.

**3. LLM Model Selection Flexibility:** We researched fallback options like smaller ESM-2 variants (esm2_t30_150M_UR50D) which could potentially run on more accessible GPUs (like Colab's free T4s or even CPUs) with Modal Serveless if a minimal live backend was feasible, showing adaptability.

**The problem it solves**

Access to high-performance computing remains a major challenge in universities. Students and teachers alike struggle with the limited availability of GPUs, CPUs, and storage resources needed for cutting-edge research and modern coursework. Whether it’s training deep learning models, simulating scientific experiments, rendering architectural designs, or processing large datasets, these tasks require significant computational resources—resources that are often locked behind expensive cloud services or restricted campus labs.

---

## The Problem in Context

* **Student Scenario:** A computer science undergraduate is working on an AI project that requires GPU acceleration to improve model accuracy. The university lab is fully booked, their free cloud credits have expired, and the project deadline is looming. Without affordable and accessible compute power, innovation is blocked.

* **Teacher Scenario:** A professor teaching computational biology assigns a project where students must run protein structure simulations. However, the department’s limited compute cluster cannot support all students simultaneously, leading to delays, frustration, and compromised learning outcomes.

---

## The Core Issues

* **High cost of centralized compute platforms** (AWS, GCP, Azure) makes them unsustainable for academic use.
* **Limited and inconsistent free access** (e.g., Google Colab timeouts, restricted student credits).
* **Overbooked or outdated university labs** unable to handle peak demand.
* **Lack of a trusted ecosystem** for securely pooling underutilized hardware across departments or institutions.
* **Exclusion of talented students and educators** from resource-constrained universities and regions.

---

## The HyperNova Solution

HyperNova provides a **decentralized platform** for resource sharing within and across universities.

### For Students & Researchers:

* Affordable, on-demand access to GPU, CPU, and storage for academic projects.
* A decentralized, privacy-preserving system that eliminates dependence on expensive cloud providers.
* Seamless integration into their development workflow (e.g., VS Code extension).

### For Teachers & Institutions:

* A way to **maximize underutilized lab hardware** by securely sharing idle compute with students and peers.
* Transparent allocation of resources for fair usage across departments.
* Incentivized participation through credit-based rewards for contributing compute cycles.

---

## Highlighted Innovation – HyperNova VS Code Extension

* **One-Click Resource Allocation:** Run AI models, simulations, or rendering tasks directly from the IDE.
* **Real-Time Monitoring Dashboard:** Professors and students can track resource usage, job status, and costs without leaving their workflow.
* **Seamless Academic Collaboration:** Enables sharing and reusing compute resources across institutions.
* **Partial Implementation due to time constrainsts**

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Desktop App with Electron
Used Electron so app can access local files directly.
Created separate builds for Windows/Linux/macOS.
Kept app lightweight by opening only required windows.
2. SSH Remote Device Connection
Enabled key-based login (no password).
Used a single fixed port and simple firewall rules.
Added auto-reconnect in case the connection drops.
3. Resource Monitoring & Limiting
Used simple ulimit to stop apps from using too much memory.
Added basic scripts to check CPU/disk usage.
Set up alerts by email/logs when usage is too high.
4. Containerisation
Built small Docker images to reduce size.
Used volumes for files that need to stay safe.
Managed containers with Docker Compose (no Kubernetes yet).
5. Session Management
Added basic login tokens that expire after some time.
Saved tokens in a local file (not plain text).
Added simple logout button to clear session.

**The Problem StrataAI Solves**

Managing access to multiple large language model (LLM) providers can be complex, fragmented, and inefficient. Different providers have varying APIs, authentication methods, pricing models, and performance characteristics. This often leads to integration challenges, inconsistent monitoring, unpredictable costs, and security risks for businesses and developers building AI-powered applications.

***

**How StrataAI Makes AI Integration Easier and Safer**

- **Unified Access:** Provides a single, OpenAI-compatible API to seamlessly connect to multiple LLM providers, eliminating the need to integrate with each separately.

- **Simplified Key Management:** Users securely store and manage all their provider API keys in one place, streamlining administration and reducing risk of key leakage or misuse.

- **Cost Transparency & Control:** Tracks token usage and spending across providers in real time, helping users prevent unexpected bills and optimize AI spend.

- **Comprehensive Observability:** Offers detailed analytics and logs for all model calls, empowering developers to troubleshoot, audit, and optimize AI usage effortlessly.

- **Secure & Compliant:** Built with enterprise-grade security best practices including role-based access, encrypted key storage, and compliance-ready features, increasing trust in AI deployments.

- **Interactive Playground:** Enables easy testing and comparison of multiple AI models from a single interface, speeding up experimentation and development cycles.

***

StrataAI makes using multiple AI models **simpler, safer, and more cost-effective**, enabling businesses to accelerate AI innovation without the headaches of juggling diverse provider ecosystems.

**The problem it solves**

# AgentGym (now VoiceGym) - “Automated Regression and Scenario testing for voice agents”

1. **What is AgentGym?** - A voice agent testing platform that automatically generates and tests voice agents against hundreds of scenarios, providing unit tests for conversational AI.

2. **How do I generate test scenarios?** - Use our AI-powered scenario generator that creates comprehensive test scenarios from natural language descriptions, including pass cases, failure cases, and complex edge cases.

3. **Can I test without my own voice agent?** - Yes, create test voice agents directly in our platform using the Agents page to see how our testing framework works.

4. **What metrics do we measure?** - Acceptance criteria pass/fail, first-audio latency (p95), barge-in handling, language switching, over-talk detection, dead-air gaps, and safety/compliance checks.

5. **Can I use AgentGym to create voice agents?** - Coming soon: A prompt-to-voice-agent builder that creates production-ready agents tested hundreds of times for robustness.

6. **How do I test my own voice agent?** - Integrate via WebRTC URL or WebSockets URL. This "Bring Your Own Voice Agent" feature is currently being finalized.

7. **How do you verify acceptance criteria?** - Two methods: Gray-box testing (agent calls our webhook URLs) and black-box testing (agent repeats information verified by LLMs).


- Like Cypress/Lighthouse, but for conversational voice.
- Built for teams shipping voice UX (support, bookings, sales, internal ops) who need proof it works reliably and not just a cool demo.
- Optimized for ElevenLabs-powered voice experiences (we showcase realtime TTS + voice persona switching). 

## Who it’s for
- **Product & CX owners:** “Did the agent actually complete the task?”
- **Engineers/Prompt writers:** “Did our latest prompt/template change break anything?”
- **Ops/Compliance:** “Did it say the required disclaimer and avoid PII leaks?”

## What it measures (out of the box)
- **Task success:** Did the conversation satisfy acceptance criteria (e.g., “table for 4 at 8pm booked, SMS confirmed”)?
- **Latency:** Turn-to-turn response time (esp. first-token/first-audio).
- **Turn-taking:** Barge-in detection/handling, over-talk, end-of-turn timing.
- **Language handling:** Can it continue in the user’s language mid-call (e.g., EN→HI)?
- **Safety/compliance:** Simple pattern checks (e.g., required disclaimer lines; no credit card numbers in transcript).

Slides link - https://gamma.app/docs/AgentGym-Robust-regression-and-scenario-testing-for-voice-agent-9ci1bgdnhzpbx5s

Demo Video link - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DQkPQ0TPOPE

**Challenges we ran into**

My system essentially spoofs the "user" side of a test scenario conversation using Eleven labs and for the sake of testing also spoofs a voice agent using OpenAI's realtime API . 
It was incredibly hard to get both these to work together in a manner as if they were having a real conversation . 
No amount of vibe-coding help was able to resolve this issue, I had to go through the documentation and examples to figure out what the problem was.
This was super frustrating but glad I was able to get it to work in time.

I managed to get an official example running , then slowly built up the core conversation engine piece-by-piece, first extending it to use audio from the microphone, then local voice clips, then streamed voice from Eleven Labs TTS and finally dynamic script with TTS.

It was a challenge but super rewarding in the end when everything started to work.

### Rancho's Platform
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/manoveda-8584) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://rancho-s-platform.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Guidance you can feel, futures you can trust.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![KNN](https://img.shields.io/badge/KNN-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Imagine a young professional, Aisha. She’s anxious about her future, juggling studies, side projects, and the uncertainty of tomorrow. She hears about Rancho’s Platform — a place that promises to “future-proof” her career. She signs up, hopeful.

Step 1: Overwhelmed at the Door Aisha is greeted by a wall of tools: Career Chaos Simulator, Burnout Blood Test, AI Salary Negotiator, AR Interview Dojo… She feels like she’s entered a carnival of futures. Instead of clarity, she feels lost. “Which one is for me? Where do I even begin?”

Step 2: Trust on the Line She tries the burnout test. It asks her to share personal text. She hesitates. “Will this platform keep my secrets safe? Or am I just data in another system?” The problem isn’t the tech — it’s the fragile trust between human and machine.

Step 3: Playful vs. Serious The simulator shows her a disaster scenario: AI layoffs in 2026. It feels like a game, but the stakes are real. She wonders: “Is this helping me prepare, or just scaring me?” The tension between gamification and genuine support is palpable.

Step 4: Alone in the Crowd She tries the Mili Meter Video Companion. It gives her meditation tips, book suggestions. But she still feels alone. “I don’t just want advice. I want someone who understands me.” The human problem here is connection — not just information.

Step 5: Craving Mentorship Finally, she sees Celebrity AI Mentor Speed Dating. It’s fun, but she longs for real mentors, real stories. “I want to hear from someone who’s walked this path, not just a simulation of Steve Jobs.”

❤️ The Human Diagnosis
Rancho’s Platform doesn’t suffer from lack of features. It suffers from human feelings left unresolved:

People feel lost instead of guided.

They feel exposed instead of safe.

They feel anxious instead of supported.

They feel alone instead of connected.

They feel entertained instead of mentored.

The true problem is not technical — it’s emotional. And solving it means designing for trust, simplicity, and human connection.

**Challenges we ran into**

😵 Overwhelm of Choice Too many tools at once (Career Chaos Simulator, Burnout Blood Test, AI Salary Negotiator…) can make users feel lost instead of empowered. The challenge is guiding them gently, like a mentor, rather than dropping them into a maze.

🔒 Fragile Trust Asking for sensitive inputs (burnout signals, salary data, personal reflections) raises fears: “Will my secrets be safe?” The challenge is building emotional trust through transparency, privacy assurances, and empathetic design.

🎭 Tone Balance Career chaos is serious, but gamified simulations can feel trivializing. On the other hand, too much seriousness can feel heavy. The challenge is striking a tone that is supportive yet engaging — playful without dismissing real struggles.

🤝 Connection Gap Tools like Mili Meter Video Companion offer advice, but users may still feel alone. The challenge is creating genuine human connection — making people feel understood, not just analyzed.

🌱 Mentorship Scaling Simulated mentors (celebrity AI speed dating) are fun, but users crave real stories and role models. The challenge is weaving mentorship and community into the platform so it feels alive, not just algorithmic.

📊 Data & Integration Without diverse datasets, predictions risk being shallow. And with so many features, integration can feel scattered. The challenge is making the system cohesive, accurate, and emotionally resonant.

❤️ The Core Human Challenge
Rancho’s Platform isn’t just about career foresight — it’s about how people feel when facing uncertainty. The real challenge is ensuring users feel:

Guided, not overwhelmed

Safe, not exposed

Supported, not anxious

Connected, not alone

Mentored, not gamified

**The problem it solves**

**🚩 Problems Cafes & Restaurants Face**

**Menu Management is Painful** → every time a price changes or an item is unavailable, menus need reprinting → costly & slow.

**Order Errors & Delays** → manual note-taking leads to wrong orders, missed add-ons, and frustrated customers.

**Customer Wait Times** → peak hours overwhelm staff, increasing wait time and reducing table turnover.

**No Insights** → owners don’t know what sells most, what’s underperforming, or how to optimize menu offerings.

**Limited Budgets** → small cafes can’t afford expensive POS or custom apps like big chains use.

**✅ How MenuBuddy Fixes These Problems**

**Instant Digital Menus (via QR)** → update prices, items, and offers in seconds → no printing costs.

**Error-Free Ordering** → customers order directly from their phones; waiters just deliver.

**Faster Service** → reduces staff load during peak hours, improving table rotation and sales.

Sales Analytics → see top-selling items, customer behavior, and sales trends → make data-driven decisions.

Affordable SaaS for Everyone → subscription-based, no heavy hardware/software investment → accessible even for small cafes.
[Live MenuBuddy](https://www.menubuddy.co.in/)

**Challenges we ran into**

****Challenges I Ran Into****

**Understanding the Gap**

Most small cafes & restaurants rely on outdated methods: paper menus, manual order-taking, or expensive POS systems.

The real challenge was to deeply understand why existing digital solutions weren’t working for them — too complex, too costly, or not user-friendly.

**Keeping It Simple for Customers**

Customers don’t want to download apps or sign up just to view a menu.

Challenge: how to make access frictionless.

Solution: QR-based digital menus — open instantly in the browser with zero learning curve.

**Balancing Owner’s Needs with Ease of Use**

Many restaurant owners are not tech-savvy. Complex dashboards scare them away.

Challenge: how to give powerful features (analytics, menu editing) but keep the UI simple.

Solution: built a clean, minimal Admin Dashboard where owners can update items or view top-selling dishes in just a few clicks.

**Building for Scale as a SaaS**

Cafes need something affordable and plug-and-play, not a custom app for each restaurant.

Challenge: how to design the system so one SaaS platform can handle many restaurants.

Solution: Multi-tenant SaaS model with role-based dashboards for each restaurant admin.

**Verbwire API Challenge**

- Integrated Verbwire AI Vision API to auto-generate dish names and descriptions from uploaded images.

- Makes it faster for restaurant owners to create menu items by just uploading a photo.

- Built a mock fallback for reliability, ensuring the feature always demos smoothly.

> Your Farming Assistant

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Database](https://img.shields.io/badge/Database-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**Problems**

**Lack of real-time information**: Farmers often don’t have easy access to current crop prices, market trends, or seasonal advisories, leading to lower profits.

**Crop management challenges**: Many farmers struggle with knowing optimal sowing time, water requirements, cost, and temperature needs for different crops.

**Decision-making inefficiency**: Without proper guidance, farmers make trial-and-error decisions about which crops to grow, how to care for them, or when to sell.

**Fragmented resources**: Information is scattered across government websites, local advisories, and social media, making it hard to access in one place.

**Solutions**

**Centralized crop data**: Shows crop names, main season, water requirement, and growing costs in one easy-to-use platform.

**Market insights**: Provides live or recent crop prices, trends, and simple analytics to help farmers sell smartly.

**Decision support**: Advises on which crops to grow based on season, temperature, and water availability.

**User-friendly interface**: A simple UI that farmers can navigate without needing tech expertise.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Challenges Faced**

**Data Availability for RAG Approach**:Gathering high-quality, structured data for the RAG pipeline was difficult.Many sources were unstructured or inconsistent, requiring extensive cleaning and formatting.Ensuring that the data was relevant, accurate, and up-to-date for retrieval was time-consuming.

**Crop Data Collection**:Reliable and free APIs for crop information (like seasonal requirements, water needs, and growing costs) were scarce.Most available datasets were either incomplete, outdated, or region-specific, making it hard to generalize.Integrating market prices and analytics data in a lightweight and accessible format for the app required custom solutions.

**Integration Challenges**:Merging the RAG pipeline with the crop advisory system demanded careful data structuring and retrieval optimization.Ensuring that responses were accurate and actionable for farmers while keeping the system fast and responsive was non-trivial.

> HPC DAG-based Authentication & Banking Platform

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-333333?style=flat-square) ![Golang](https://img.shields.io/badge/Golang-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![BlockDAG](https://img.shields.io/badge/BlockDAG-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Decentralized finance and peer‑to‑peer systems face a critical weakness: transactions and nodes cannot always be trusted. Current blockchain networks struggle with identity spoofing, Sybil attacks, tampered payloads, and inactive or malicious nodes, leading to fraud, instability, and massive financial losses. Traditional blockchains also suffer from scalability bottlenecks that make real‑time, high‑volume banking impractical. StriX addresses this by combining cryptographic node identities, verifiable transactions, and a scalable BlockDAG architecture to ensure that every node is genuine, every transaction is authenticated, and the network remains secure and resilient.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building StriX, we encountered several technical hurdles that tested both design and implementation. Setting up multiple server nodes in Docker required careful network configuration to simulate a realistic distributed environment. Establishing reliable internode communication was challenging, as we had to ensure messages and transactions were consistently transmitted and verified across containers. Keeping track of active vs. dead nodes introduced complexity, especially when implementing the heartbeat protocol to detect silent or inactive peers. Finally, simulating a fake TPM for cryptographic key binding and signing pushed us to creatively emulate hardware‑level security guarantees in software while still ensuring authenticity and tamper‑evidence. These challenges deepened our understanding of decentralized system design and improved the robustness of StriX.

**DeFi projects leveraging BlockDAG technology.**

**BlockDAG Layer**: Each transaction/state change is stored in a local DAG (per institution or node cluster). Local DAGs sync to a global DAG distributed across multiple servers.
**TPM Integration**: Each participating node uses Trusted Platform Module to verify:
Integrity of its OS / runtime environment.
Cryptographic identity (signatures bound to hardware).
**Result:** Even if one node is compromised:
Tampered data fails validation because other DAG replicas + TPM attestation reject it.
Malicious node gets quarantined automatically.

### Collab AI
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/collab-ai-d03e) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://ai-collab-app.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> teams and AI brainstorm together in real time.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Git](https://img.shields.io/badge/Git-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In today’s digital age, teams are forced to juggle between multiple tools — Slack for chatting, Trello for tasks, Google Docs for brainstorming, and ChatGPT for AI help. This constant switching slows teams down, makes collaboration messy, and often leaves people struggling to stay on the same page.

Collab AI solves this by bringing everything into one seamless workspace. It allows teams to:

Chat in real time with each other.

Collaborate with AI instantly by tagging @ai within conversations.

Manage projects faster without hopping between multiple apps.

Right now, our app allows any user to create an account and log in to a global shared chat. While this works as a proof of concept, it does raise privacy concerns since all logged-in users can see the same conversation. We consciously chose not to implement multiple groups/channels yet due to time constraints.

But this limitation also gives us a clear path forward: in the next iteration, users will be able to create private groups, generate invite links, and collaborate in their own secure spaces. This feature will make Collab AI not just functional but also safe and adaptable for real-world teams.

By focusing on simplicity and accessibility first, we’ve created a strong foundation. Even in its current form, Collab AI makes teamwork smarter, faster, and less fragmented — and with upcoming privacy-focused features, it can evolve into a powerful all-in-one collaboration hub.

**Challenges we ran into**

Like any ambitious hackathon project, building Collab AI wasn’t without its hurdles:

Real-time sync issues: In the early version, messages only appeared after refreshing the page, which broke the whole "live collaboration" idea. We fixed this by integrating Supabase’s real-time subscriptions, ensuring chats update instantly.

Deployment headaches: Our first Vercel deployment kept failing due to strict TypeScript/ESLint rules complaining about 'any' types. After some debugging, we learned to selectively disable linting during build while still keeping local checks for clean code.

Managing secrets safely: Accidentally committing API keys was a real risk. To solve this, we added .gitignore rules and created a .env.local.example file so the app runs without exposing sensitive information.

Each challenge forced us to think more like production developers rather than just hackathon builders. By solving them, we made the app more robust, secure, and ready for future scaling.

Team **Lalilalo** -- [Soumyadeep Sahoo](https://github.com/awwws0m), [Suraj Sahu](https://github.com/raindr0-0p)

**The problem it solves**

UNOMEDS addresses the challenge of easily accessing reliable medical information and guidance. Many people, especially the elderly or those in remote areas, struggle to get quick, understandable answers about diseases, symptoms, medications, treatments, and wellness. Searching online often yields complex or inconsistent information, which can be confusing or misleading. UNOMEDS solves this by providing a friendly AI chatbot, unoBOT, that delivers clear, step-by-step medical advice in simple language. It ensures responses are easy to read, structured, and actionable while reminding users to consult a doctor for personal concerns, bridging the gap between medical knowledge and user accessibility.

**Challenges we ran into**

During development of UNOMEDS, I might face a few challenges. Integrating the Google Gemini API smoothly and handling any errors or timeouts could be tricky. Connecting the frontend (`chatbot.html`) with the Flask backend and managing CORS issues might need careful setup. Validating user input and making sure the AI responses display correctly without breaking the interface is important. Setting up the environment, managing dependencies, and preparing the app for deployment can also be challenging. Overall, debugging, handling unexpected API outputs, and keeping the UI simple and user-friendly will require attention.

### CareQueue
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/carequeue-ed14) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/126p9M88gUzjdzFPAJKuL8nXNeyOtMcCo?usp=drive_link) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackBuild-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackbuild.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Transforming clinic queues into care flows

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Maps API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Maps%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![WebSOC](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebSOC-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Native](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Native-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**Problem**

Imagine you’re sick, stuck in a crowded clinic. You don’t know if your turn is in 10 minutes or 2 hours. The receptionist is overloaded, patients are frustrated, and clinics struggle to manage the flow.

**Our Solution – CareQueue**

CareQueue is an AI-driven, real-time clinic queue management system that streamlines patient flow and optimizes clinic operations.

✅ Map-based view of nearby clinics with live wait times & smart filters.
✅ AI support: predictive wait times, triage assistance, and doctor recommendations.
✅ AI-powered booking: patients can directly select their slot; the receptionist gets notified instantly, and the calendar updates automatically.
✅ Seamless booking & notifications to minimize patient stress.
✅ Inclusive features: SMS check-in for non-tech users, multilingual interface, emergency fast-track.

**Impact:**

Reduces patient waiting stress by up to 40%.

Increases clinic efficiency during peak loads.

Frees staff from repetitive queue-related tasks.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Real-time accuracy** – queues change every minute, making it tough to keep wait-time predictions reliable.

**AI-powered booking sync** – ensuring that when a patient books a slot, the receptionist’s calendar updates instantly without errors.

**Scalability under load** – designing a system that stays smooth even when hundreds of patients check clinics at once.

**Inclusive design** – making the system work for both smartphone users (app) and non-tech users (SMS check-in).

**AI reliability** – training the triage assistant to give safe, meaningful suggestions that patients can trust.

**The problem it solves**

RIVELY’s AI-powered Competitive Intelligence Platform streamlines competitor monitoring, addressing the inefficiencies that businesses, particularly startups, face. Manually tracking competitors’ social media, websites, and news is time-intensive and often yields incomplete data. RIVELY automates this process, collecting insights from diverse sources like LinkedIn, news mentions, and regulatory filings, saving valuable time and resources.

Instead of overwhelming users with raw data, RIVELY’s LLM module delivers concise, actionable insights tailored to specific departments—Product, Marketing, Sales, HR, and Finance. Real-time updates, daily role-specific emails, and weekly newsletters ensure timely, relevant information, empowering businesses to make informed decisions, identify market opportunities, and stay ahead of competitors.

The platform is user-friendly: companies register, select competitors (with AI suggestions based on industry and region), and choose key topics like pricing or M&A. The intuitive dashboard supports collaboration, allowing users to tag colleagues, share insights, and integrate with Slack or MS Teams. Beyond updates, RIVELY provides strategic recommendations, such as targeting companies similar to a competitor’s new clients, driving measurable outcomes like improved product roadmaps or sales strategies.

Designed with startups in mind, RIVELY offers affordable pricing and a clean interface, avoiding information overload. Scalable for medium-sized businesses and enterprises, it ensures precise, actionable intelligence to enhance decision-making and competitive edge.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a00c987faa404f1ca05cf44bc375b4be/c07e7f34-d2fa-456d-b252-2e97022a27e3.jpeg)

**Challenges we ran into**

A significant challenge in building RIVELY was likely ensuring that the data from different sources is properly processed by a single unified LLM module. Each source has unique structures, APIs, or access restrictions, leading to incomplete or noisy data. For instance, scraping dynamic websites or handling rate-limited APIs (e.g., Twitter or LinkedIn) could result in missing critical competitor updates, undermining the platform’s reliability.

How It Was Overcome:

Robust Scraping Framework: The team likely adopted a modular scraping pipeline using Python (as mentioned in the tech stack). Libraries like BeautifulSoup was used for web scraping, while APIs were accessed with proper authentication and rate-limit handling.

Error Handling and Retries: Implemented retry mechanisms and error logging to manage intermittent failures, ensuring data collection resumed after temporary issues.

Data Validation: Introduced validation checks to filter out incomplete or irrelevant data before feeding it into the LLM module for insight generation.

Robust LLM Module: Built an AI layer with prompt chaining after experimentation.

**Generative AI**

RIVELY’s core functionality aligns closely with the Generative AI track, as its competitive intelligence platform heavily relies on AI-driven processes to deliver actionable insights. Specifically, RIVELY uses a Large Language Model (LLM), as mentioned in the tech stack (Llama through Groq), to transform raw data from diverse sources (e.g., social media, news, company filings) into concise, meaningful insights tailored to user needs. This generative AI capability is central to the platform’s value proposition, enabling the following:

Insight Generation: The LLM module processes fragmented data, such as competitor pricing updates or hiring announcements, and generates actionable summaries with appropriate tags, making complex information accessible and relevant across departments (Product, Marketing, Sales, etc.).
Personalized Recommendations: RIVELY’s AI analyzes competitor and user company data to provide customized suggestions, such as targeting companies similar to a competitor’s new clients, enhancing strategic decision-making.
Automated Summaries and Quotes: The platform generates summaries and highlights key quotes from competitors’ public statements, streamlining the delivery of critical information.
Auto-Translation: Generative AI enables real-time translation of regional news or data, ensuring comprehensive coverage without language barriers.

**The problem it solves**

## The Problem

Many students in Nepal still rely on rote memorization and textbook-based learning. They often study by reading and repeating formulas without fully understanding the real concepts behind them. This becomes a serious issue in subjects like **Physics and Biology**, where **visualization and practical understanding** are essential.

For example:
- A student may know the formula for projectile motion but has never seen how it works in real time.
- They may memorize the structure of the human heart but cannot imagine how blood flows through it.
- They may prepare for **IOE or medical entrance exams** but struggle because they lack real, interactive tools.

Additionally:
- **Most learning tools are not designed for Nepal's curriculum.**
- **Many schools lack labs or equipment.**
- **Interactive platforms like PhET don't fully cover the NEB or entrance syllabus.**

As a result, students feel disconnected, confused, and underprepared — not because they’re weak, but because the system is.

**Our platform solves this by turning complex textbook topics into interactive AR models and simulations**, built specifically for **Grade 11–12 NEB, IOE, and medical entrance students** in Nepal.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges We Faced

While building this platform, we faced several key challenges — especially with integrating Augmented Reality (AR) in a way that actually works for students across Nepal.

### 1. Device Compatibility

Many Nepali students use low-end Android phones with limited RAM and older browsers. Making AR content work smoothly on these devices was difficult. We had to test and optimize models to ensure they could load quickly and run without crashing.

### 2. Internet Limitations

AR platforms often require fast internet and powerful hardware. But in rural areas of Nepal, internet access is slow or sometimes unavailable. We had to build a system that could **cache or preload AR content**, allowing offline access after the first load.

### 3. Educational Clarity in AR

It’s easy to make a 3D heart spin on the screen — but that doesn't help students learn. We had to make sure our AR models were **educational**, not just visual. This meant smooth interactivity (zoom, rotate)


### 🛠️ 4. AR.js Limitations

Using **AR.js** was a good choice for mobile access, but it came with limitations:
- Marker-based tracking is sensitive to lighting
- Performance drops if models are too detailed

We had to **balance model detail and performance**, and build our own layers on top of AR.js for a better learning experience.

Despite these challenges, we found smart solutions to make the platform run on low-end phones, support offline learning, and provide **curriculum-specific, AR-powered education** for every Nepali student.

**Ed-Tech**

This project is a strong fit for an Ed-Tech platform because it makes learning more engaging through interactive tools like AR models and physics simulations. Many students struggle with understanding science and math by just reading textbooks or watching videos. Our platform helps them learn by seeing and interacting with the concepts, especially those in the Grade 11–12 IOE and medical entrance syllabus. It is made for Nepali students, works on low-end phones, and can be used even without internet after setup. Since it has a modular design, any Ed-Tech platform can easily add it to their system and offer students a better, more practical learning experience.

## � The Problem It Solves

**CVForge.ai eliminates the guesswork and time-consuming manual work in job applications by automating resume creation and optimization.**

### **Key Problems We Solve:**

| **Challenge** | **CVForge.ai Solution** |
|---------------|-------------------------|
| **🕐 Hours spent writing resumes** | ⚡ **AI generates complete resumes in minutes** |
| **❓ Unknown ATS compatibility** | 📊 **Real-time ATS scoring (0-100%) with detailed feedback** |
| **📝 Manual customization for each job** | 🤖 **AI adapts content based on job descriptions** |
| ** Scattered profile data** | 🔗 **Import from LinkedIn & GitHub automatically** |
| **🎨 Poor formatting & design** | ✨ **4 professional templates with perfect formatting** |

### **Who Uses CVForge.ai:**

- **🎓 Job Seekers**: Generate tailored resumes from LinkedIn/GitHub profiles
- **💼 Career Changers**: AI reframes experience for new industries  
- **🏢 Companies**: Post jobs and manage applications with built-in ATS scoring
- **📊 Anyone wanting ATS insights**: Upload existing resumes to get compatibility scores

### **Core Use Cases:**

1. **Import & Generate**: Connect LinkedIn → AI creates professional resume → Download PDF
2. **ATS Optimization**: Upload resume → Get compatibility score → Receive improvement suggestions  
3. **Job Applications**: Browse jobs → Generate tailored resume → Apply with confidence
4. **Chat-based Editing**: "Make my resume more technical" → AI updates content → Live preview updates

**Result**: Transform hours of manual resume work into minutes of AI-powered optimization.

**Challenges we ran into**

## 🚧 Challenges I Ran Into

### **1. ATS Scoring Algorithm Accuracy**
**Problem**: Initial keyword matching was too simplistic, missing semantic context and giving poor scores.
**Solution**: Implemented hybrid approach combining semantic similarity (40%) with intelligent keyword extraction (60%) using specialized resume-job matching embeddings.

### **2. AI Agent Memory Management**
**Problem**: LangChain agent losing conversation context and resume state between interactions.
**Solution**: Implemented persistent conversation store with pickle serialization and conversation backup/restore functionality.

### **3. Frontend-Backend-Agent Communication**
**Problem**: Coordinating data flow between React frontend, Node.js backend, and Python AI agent.
**Solution**: Designed clear API contracts with standardized JSON schemas and proper error handling across all services.

### **4. Resume Template Formatting**
**Problem**: Dynamic content rendering with different template layouts while maintaining professional appearance.
**Solution**: Created modular template system with consistent data mapping and CSS-based responsive design.

### **5. Social Media Data Extraction**
**Problem**: Inconsistent data formats from LinkedIn/GitHub APIs and scraping reliability.
**Solution**: Built robust data normalization layer with fallback handling and structured profile schema validation.

## 🎓 Key Learnings
- **Microservices Complexity**: While microservices offer scalability and technology flexibility, they require sophisticated inter-service communication strategies. 

- **Data Consistency Across Services**: Managing data synchronization between Node.js user management, Python AI processing, and MongoDB storage required careful transaction design and eventual consistency patterns.

- **Prompt Engineering at Scale**: Designing robust prompts for Google Gemini that consistently produce structured outputs required extensive testing, fallback mechanisms, and output validation layers.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Mid-Hackathon Hurdles We (Barely) Survived

Hackathons are basically sleep-deprived marathons where your code breaks, your backend disappears, and your idea changes three times before you’ve finished your coffee.
Here’s what went horribly wrong (and how we duct-taped it back together):

---

###  **The Great Mid-Hack Pivot™**

We *thought* we were going to build a **decentralized voting app** — sounds fancy, right?
12 hours in:

* It was way too ambitious. Like, “we-need-a-PhD-and-a-week” ambitious.
* Our crucial API decided to ghost us like an unreliable ex.

So... we **panicked**, regrouped, and came up with something simpler and cooler:
**A Chrome extension that summarizes articles using AI.**
Still cool. Still techy. And *actually possible* within 24 hours.

---

###  Bug #1: React Decided to Disappear

**Error:** `Cannot find module 'react' in use_mobile.tsx`
**Us:** "Wait… isn't React supposed to *just work*??"

**Root cause:** Our folder structure was a hot mess. Webpack was like “nope.”
**Fix:** We moved files around like a Jenga tower, fixed some alias imports, restarted the dev server — boom, React came back like it never left.

---

###  Bug #2: The API Strikes Back

**Symptoms:**

* `fetch()` was failing like it forgot how the internet works.
* Sometimes the backend wasn’t even awake when the frontend called it.

**Fixes:**

* Enabled CORS (shoutout to Stack Overflow).
* Added loading states so the frontend stopped acting needy.
* Wrapped everything in `try/catch` like a warm error-handling blanket.

---

###  Lessons from the Code Trenches

* **Pivot early** — better to change ideas than cry over broken dreams.
* **CORS will find you. Always.** Be ready.
* **“Small bugs” are never small at 3 AM.**
* **Postman mocks and caffeine** = MVPs.

---

# SIGMOYD: Natural Language-Driven AI Workflow Automation

---

## **Inspiration**

**Problem**  
Modern professionals often struggle with repetitive workflows and unstructured communication—especially in customer support across vast and dynamic data sources. Traditional automation requires technical know-how, limiting accessibility.  
There is a growing need for a natural language-based platform that allows effortless task automation.

---

## **What It Does**

**Solution**  
SIGMOYD is a **prompt-driven platform** that enables users to **create, visualize, and deploy intelligent agentic workflows**. These AI agents integrate with tools like:

- Gmail
- Notion
- GitHub
- Slack
- RAG Tools
- External APIs
- Web platforms
- Custom MCP Servers

Users can trigger actions via events or prompts, participate in community chats, and maintain transparency, memory, and secure cross-platform automation.

---

## **Target Audience**

SIGMOYD is designed for **teams and individuals** looking for smarter work execution:

- Product Managers  
- Operations Leads  
- Customer Support Teams  
- Sales & Marketing Analysts  
- IT Teams  
- Solo Founders  
- Government Agencies  

The platform offers **no-code automation** for non-technical users and **developer-friendly customizations** for technical teams.  
Perfect fit for **startups, fintech, web3, logistics**, and **remote-first organizations**.

---
## **Use Cases**
Customer Support Email arrived: Classify incoming emails, retrieve relevant context from collection, generate and send the reply . Route the comples queries to relevant slack channel or google sheet.
Linkedin job cold email automation: Find job postings from linkedin posts, scrape jd , recruiter emails, generate a personalized cold email with context from resume for each scraped job, send the email to recruiter with resume.
Sales Data Analysis: Upload CSV → Ask questions → Get insights
..and so much more.
The possibilities are limitless with MCP + Tool integration

**Challenges we ran into**

- Designing optimal prompt structures for diverse workflows was a challenge. We refined the system prompt to work for all kinds of user prompts, and to reduce LLM hallucinations.

- Visualizing complex workflows in an intuitive UI  was also a big challenge. First we decided about the  node schema, then creating intuitive UI using React Flow involved many iterations. 

- Handling errors gracefully during workflow execution was a big challenge. Initially the workflow had many errors like - getting stopped in between. We fixed all those errors, included validator, iterator and deligator as well as input validation before each tool execution. Getting structured response from LLM was also a challenge.

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![C++](https://img.shields.io/badge/C++-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![C](https://img.shields.io/badge/C-333333?style=flat-square) ![JSX](https://img.shields.io/badge/JSX-333333?style=flat-square) ![axios](https://img.shields.io/badge/axios-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML/CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML/CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

This virtual lab, developed by AIML students at Ramdeobaba University, Nagpur, addresses a major challenge faced by learners: understanding and mastering Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) using traditional methods. Conventional learning—through textbooks or isolated videos—often fails to bridge the gap between theoretical concepts and their real-world applications. Our lab solves this by offering a comprehensive, interactive, and intuitive platform that transforms how students engage with DSA.

Key features of the lab include interactive visualizations that help learners clearly understand complex data structures like trees, graphs, and heaps. Through simulations and real-time tests, users can explore the step-by-step execution of algorithms, improving both comprehension and retention. The platform offers hands-on coding practice with immediate feedback, enabling students to debug, learn, and grow their coding skills efficiently.

We’ve included application-oriented examples to show how algorithms apply in real-world scenarios, making learning more meaningful. Learners can also access conceptual reading modules for deeper theoretical insights and video-based explanations for every major topic, making it ideal for visual learners.

Additionally, performance analysis tools allow students to measure time and space complexity of their code, promoting optimization. This lab turns passive learning into an engaging and effective experience—making DSA easier, clearer, and more enjoyable.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the major challenges we encountered while building this virtual lab was **designing real-time interactive visualizations** that were both intuitive and accurate. Representing data structures like trees and graphs in a dynamic and user-friendly way required extensive experimentation with frontend libraries such as D3.js and React. Initially, the visuals were either too cluttered or too simplistic, making it hard for users to follow algorithm logic. We overcame this by implementing step-wise animations and allowing users to control the execution speed, pause/resume actions, and view algorithm states at each step.

Another significant hurdle was **providing real-time feedback on code submissions**. Building a backend system that could safely and efficiently compile and execute user-submitted code across multiple programming languages, while handling infinite loops, syntax errors, and malicious inputs, was technically challenging. We resolved this by using Docker containers to sandbox code execution and implemented a robust timeout and error-handling mechanism.

We also faced issues with **performance analysis tools**, especially in accurately displaying time and space complexities. After several iterations, we integrated basic profiling and benchmarking utilities within the code editor to help users get a better sense of their algorithm’s efficiency.

These challenges taught us the importance of **iteration, testing, and user feedback** in building a truly useful learning platform.

**Ethereum Track**

Our project fits into the Ethereum Track at ETHIndia by demonstrating how decentralized applications (dApps) and smart contracts can be used to create a secure, transparent, and immutable platform for learning Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA). By integrating Ethereum, learners' progress and achievements can be verified on-chain, ensuring authenticity. Moreover, user contributions—such as adding new problems or visualizations—can be rewarded through token-based incentives. This promotes community-driven growth and builds trust in the platform. The blockchain backbone also prevents data tampering and ensures a fair, open-source educational ecosystem.

### VahaanBandhu: Quantum Logistics for Truck Drivers
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/vahaanbandhu-quantum-logistics-for-truck-drivers-491e) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Niranjan1Praveen/VahaanBandhu) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/WG5Hdsbq0Rg) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack%20With%20Gujarat-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hack-with-gujarat.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> AI + Quantum-powered logistics platform optimizing rural truck routes and return trips for farmers, drivers, and agri-dealers.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![GPS](https://img.shields.io/badge/GPS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square) ![Prisma](https://img.shields.io/badge/Prisma-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In rural India, **over 30% of agricultural trucks return empty**, leading to:

- **Lost income** for truck drivers  
- **Increased fuel and logistics costs**  
- **Spoilage of perishable produce**  
- **Limited market access** for smallholder farmers  

These inefficiencies stem from **fragmented transport systems**, poor route coordination, and lack of visibility between stakeholders like farmers, truckers, and agri-input dealers.

**VahaanBandhu** solves this by:

-  **AI + Quantum-powered route optimization** for timely, fuel-efficient deliveries  
-  **Circular logistics model** that incentivizes return trips with commission-based profit sharing  
-  **Farmer-trucker matchmaking engine** to minimize idle truck time and crop delays  
-  **Live tracking and GPS routing** for transparency and coordination  
-  **Predictive demand analytics** to reduce transport delays and wastage  

This platform supports **SDG 2 (Zero Hunger)**, **SDG 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth)**, and **SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure)** by creating efficient, inclusive, and sustainable rural logistics.

**Challenges we ran into**

**1. Real-Time Load Matching Logic**  
Coordinating multiple farmer requests with available truck routes in real time was complex. We solved this by integrating **PostGIS-powered spatial queries** for geo-matching and optimized cache handling.

**2. Quantum Hardware Limitations**  
Simulating traffic route decisions using quantum circuits is limited to ~5 qubits. We worked around this by applying **quantum logic only to critical segments**, while the classical system handled broader routing.

**3. Rural Connectivity Issues**  
Poor internet in villages limited app reliability. We implemented **Progressive Web App (PWA)** support and **SMS-based OTP login** to ensure offline accessibility and minimal data usage.

**4. Adoption Resistance from Truck Unions**  
Truckers were hesitant to use a tech-based model. We introduced a **transparent profit-sharing system**, **early-bird incentives**, and **in-person onboarding drives** via FPOs and mandi networks.

### DevVault – Secure Secret Sharing for Teams
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/devvault-secure-secret-sharing-for-teams-8127) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/logitechsabarni/Dev-Vault) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack%20With%20Gujarat-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hack-with-gujarat.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> DevVault – Securely store and share secrets with your dev team. End-to-end encryption, role-based access, and GitHub integration for safe, smart secret management.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-333333?style=flat-square) ![JWT](https://img.shields.io/badge/JWT-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express-333333?style=flat-square) ![Rest APIs](https://img.shields.io/badge/Rest%20APIs-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Developers often share API keys, credentials, and secrets through insecure channels like email, Slack, or even hardcoded in repos — leading to data breaches, broken workflows, and manual cleanups.

DevVault solves this by providing:

Secure, encrypted storage of secrets with access control.

One-time shareable links to safely transmit sensitive data.

GitHub integration that auto-detects hardcoded secrets and suggests vault storage.

A CLI and web UI that streamline managing secrets across teams and microservices.

This tool makes secret management safer, prevents leaks, and enhances team productivity by centralizing access in a controlled, auditable way.

**Challenges we ran into**

One major challenge was encrypting secrets securely while still allowing team-based access. We had to balance security with usability.

Initially, sharing encrypted secrets between users with different keys was tricky. We overcame this by implementing asymmetric encryption for sharing and AES-256 for storage.

Another issue was GitHub webhook latency when scanning for secrets in pushed code. We optimized this by building a lightweight regex-based scanner and offloading to a background job queue.

Despite tight hackathon time limits, we prioritized modular architecture to allow future plug-ins for CI/CD tools and more cloud integrations.

> Kshatratej is an AI-powered platform showcasing global military strength with 3D models, intelligent scraping, and real-time defense news summarization for enthusiasts and defence analysts.

![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Beautiful Soup](https://img.shields.io/badge/Beautiful%20Soup-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In an age of growing geopolitical tensions and rapid advancements in military technology, the common citizen remains unaware of their nation's true defense capabilities. Access to reliable, up-to-date military data is scattered, overly technical, and often inaccessible to the public. Furthermore, while India's defense achievements—from indigenous fighter jets to advanced missile systems—are a matter of national pride, they are rarely showcased in a way that educates and inspires.

Kshatratej addresses this critical gap. Named after the Sanskrit concept of warrior valor, Kshatra, the platform presents comprehensive, structured, and visually immersive information about the military strengths of nations. With the words of Lord Krishna in the Gita, "तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचम"—valor, forgiveness, determination, and purity—as guiding virtues, and the vision of Ved Vyas, who glorified heroic conduct in the Mahabharata, Kshatratej rekindles awareness of modern-day defense strength as a continuation of ancient ideals.

The system uses intelligent AI agents to dynamically scrape verified military data, summarize global defense news, and filter 3D models of military vehicles for better understanding. It empowers defense enthusiasts, students, researchers, and strategists to stay informed, engaged, and prepared. By making advanced defense knowledge accessible, Kshatratej not only honors our military’s sacrifices but also fosters an aware and confident generation, capable of understanding the power that silently protects them.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building Kshatratej came with several complex challenges that demanded both technical depth and creative problem-solving. One of the primary hurdles was designing a truly dynamic AI-powered web scraping system. Unlike traditional scrapers, ours needed to interpret diverse user queries, identify the right source, and generate scraping code on-the-fly—relying on intelligent agents that could reason and adapt like a human researcher.

Another challenge was finding credible and structured sources for defense-related data. Military information is scattered across sites with varying reliability, formats, and access policies. Our AI agents had to learn to differentiate between low-quality and high-authority content while ensuring the data remains up-to-date and contextually correct.

Creating a flagship-level, visually rich UI was another hurdle. Integrating real-time data, advanced comparison tools, and intuitive interfaces for users required significant design iteration. Adding accurate and high-quality 3D models of jets, tanks, and warships—filtered intelligently via AI—was difficult, as public repositories often lacked proper classification or metadata.

Integrating globe.gl for a geographic visualization layer added both complexity and power. Ensuring smooth interaction with a 3D Earth model while dynamically showing country-specific military information required optimizations for performance, responsiveness, and device compatibility.

Finally, summarizing global military news using AI brought its own set of linguistic and contextual challenges. Defense news is technical and multi-layered. Building a news summarization agent that preserves strategic depth while making it readable and relevant for users required carefully crafted prompt engineering and filtering mechanisms.

Despite these hurdles, each challenge helped us build a more intelligent, robust, and impactful system.

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Gunicorn](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gunicorn-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

# 🤖 CLI-Aware LLM Terminal Assistant (MCP-Integrated)



A context-aware, AI-powered terminal assistant that understands natural language, interprets your filesystem, and suggests safe CLI commands — all powered by the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Built to help developers navigate and command their local system intelligently and safely.



---



## 🧩 Problem Statement



Using the terminal is essential — but error-prone.



- Developers forget syntax or fear making mistakes.

- Deep project structures make navigation complex.

- Accidental execution of harmful commands can be disastrous.

- While LLMs are helpful, they lack awareness of your real system’s context.



---



## 💡 Our Solution



This project provides a *safe, local, intelligent terminal companion* that:



- Understands your *natural language instructions*

- Reads your *actual file system and project structure*

- Suggests *safe shell commands*, explained and previewed before execution

- Uses *MCP* to expose structured tools, prompts, and data to the LLM



---



## ✨ Features



- 🧠 Natural Language → Terminal Commands  

  > “List all Python files in the project” → find . -name "*.py"



- 🗂 Context-Aware  

  > Understands your current directory, files, project metadata, and history



- 🔐 Secure & Confirmed Execution  

  > Blocks unsafe commands (e.g. rm -rf /) and always asks before executing



- 🧰 Pluggable APIs  

  > Frontend-ready with clean HTTP interface for terminal UIs



- 🧑‍💻 Runs Locally  

  > No cloud dependency — 100% offline-safe and privacy-first



---



## 🎯 Use Cases



- Developers who want safer, smarter command-line assistance

- Learners who want to "talk" to the terminal using plain English

- Hackathon participants building CLI-based AI tooling

- Advanced users looking for fast, AI-assisted workflows with control



---



## 🏗 Architecture
[User] ↔ [Frontend Terminal UI] ↔ [MCP Server] ↔ [Gemini API / LLM]
↕
Filesystem / Tools / Git / Logs

---
