**Description of your solution**

****Calmate — Agentic AI-Powered Mental Health Companion for Corporate Well-being****
Calmate is an Agentic AI-powered Mental Health Companion that proactively connects with employees through natural, empathetic conversations on a audio phone call helping them express emotions and release work stress in a private, stigma-free way helping the corporate with anonymized, actionable well-being insights.

****How we are planning to build Calmate?****

We are building an **Agentic AI framework** using an **Agent Development Kit (ADK)** that spawns multiple agents.
Each agent is responsible for **proactively calling an employee** after work hours and having a genuine, human-like conversation asking simple yet emotionally engaging questions like:
- “How was your day?”
- “What’s something that made you smile today?”
- “Is there anything at work that’s been stressful lately?”

These conversations are analyzed by our **AI Engine**, which performs:
- **Emotion & sentiment analysis**
- **Context understanding**
- **Automatic anonymization to remove personally identifiable details**

Aggregated and anonymized insights are shown on a **secure admin dashboard**, accessible only to HR.
This gives organizations a **real-time pulse** of employee well-being **without compromising privacy.**

****How this is helpful?****

This will help ***employees in saying things that they generally can't to others*** eventually **reducing the stress** and organisation **tracking the wellbeing of employees**. Corporate will get a overall insight of the wellbeing and whats the thing that bothering the employees. *Currently HR usually relies on surveys or exit interviews which is outdated, biased, and too late.* Calmate provides real-time, anonymous emotional insights like:
- **“Most mentions of stress relate to project X.”**
- **"Mood trends improved after flexible hours."**
- **"Employees dissatisfaction post workload distribution in a team"**

This gives HR ***actionable intelligence***, not just data.
Also, this is proactive system which pushes employees to talk which is better than ChatGPT or Gemini Assistant as they don't initiate conversation without user manually going to app and give verbal prompt and talk. 

****What Impact it can have?****

Happier employees → higher engagement → better output.
If 10% productivity improves, the cost of Calmate is justified and eventually leads to ***increased sales/revenue***.

****What about GTM and Revenue Streams?****

**Target Market**
B2B — mid-to-large corporate organizations (especially tech, consulting, and startups).

**Initial GTM Strategy**
- Start with funded startups (Series A and beyond) who face high workloads and stress.
- Offer a 1-week free trial to demonstrate impact and gather anonymized well-being insights.
- Use successful case studies from 2–3 startups as proof points to approach larger enterprises.

**Revenue Model**
- One-time license cost for setup and deployment.
- Monthly maintenance fee for updates, analytics improvements, and AI tuning.

This approach creates predictable, recurring revenue while maintaining strong data control for corporates.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

**Employees** silently struggle with stress and burnout due to the lack of continuous, personalized, and stigma-free mental health support. **Corporates**, on the other hand, have no real-time or privacy-preserving way to understand workforce well-being before it ***impacts productivity***.

**How Calmate Fits into the Healthtech (Agentic AI) Track?**

1. Growing Mental Health Crisis in the Workplace:- Employee burnout and chronic stress have become **leading causes of mental health decline**, directly impacting overall wellness and ***organizational efficiency***.

2. Healthtech Relevance:- **Calmate** targets ***psychological well-being***, which is the most ignored but critical health factor in modern workplaces.

3. Agentic AI Integration:- Calmate behaves as an **autonomous mental health agent** operating in isolated environment which **monitors, analyses, and acts on emotional health data** responsibly.

**Description of your solution**

FactSure is an AI-powered web platform designed to combat online misinformation and help people verify the truth behind any piece of content in seconds.

The idea is to build a social-media-like website where users can:

Paste any link, upload a file (PDF, news article, post, video, etc.), or type a claim they want to verify.

Our AI verification engine (built using Gemini / LangChain) will automatically read the content, cross-check it with trusted sources, and return a result indicating whether the information is True, False, or Misleading — along with a short explanation and verified references.

Once verified, the user can post the result publicly on FactSure, creating a community fact-check feed where others can:

- View, comment, and re-verify the same claims

- Rate the credibility of posts

- Help flag new misinformation trends

The platform will also feature a “Trending Misinformation Dashboard” that tracks and visualizes:

- Emerging false topics circulating online

- Popular claims being verified by users

- Real-time insights into how misinformation spreads around current global or local events

In short, FactSure acts as a crowdsourced misinformation detection and verification network powered by AI — turning users from passive readers into active fact-checkers.

detailed technical architecture:

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/1cbc8d8cfe8246308d62fcf41ba8dbbc/4dc8970a-e811-450a-9734-aedd023c910c.png)

We have created a multimodal agentic AI system for FactSure that can process inputs from multiple sources, including social media links, PDFs, and text claims. The system intelligently extracts content, cross-verifies it against trusted sources like WHO and Google Fact Check, and uses a combination of LangChain reasoning, Gemini API, and ML classifiers (BERT / scikit-learn) to determine whether information is true, false, or misleading. It then generates clear, contextual explanations, enabling users to make informed decisions and contribute to a community-driven fact-checking ecosystem.

**Target Audience**

FactSure is designed for a broad audience concerned with misinformation and fact verification:

- General Users / Social Media Consumers

Anyone who wants to verify claims, news articles, or social media content before sharing.

- Journalists & Media Professionals

Helps verify sources, detect trends, and ensure accurate reporting.

- Researchers & Policy Makers

Provides analytics on trending misinformation topics for studies or governance.

- Educational Institutions & NGOs

Useful for teaching media literacy and promoting informed decision-making.

**Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy**

- Web Launch / Social Media Campaigns

Launch a web-based platform and promote on social media channels to reach early adopters.

- Partnerships

Collaborate with media outlets, universities, and fact-checking organizations for credibility and user adoption.

- Community Engagement

Encourage users to submit and review claims, gamifying participation through badges or reputation scores.

**Revenue Streams**

- Freemium Model

Free basic verification for all users

Premium subscription for advanced analytics, batch verification, or PDF/document checks

- Enterprise / Institutional Licensing

Sell licenses to news agencies, schools, NGOs, or government organizations for bulk use or dashboards

- API Access

Offer API for third-party apps, social media platforms, or research institutions to integrate FactSure’s verification engine

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Even though FactSure is designed as a general-purpose misinformation verification platform (so it technically fits PS2), it also already satisfies all PS1 requirements:

- Scanning multiple content streams

FactSure can process social media links, news articles, and uploaded PDFs, just like PS1 requires.

- Detecting misinformation trends

FactSure generates trending misinformation topics from user posts and global content streams, which is exactly what PS1 wants for crisis monitoring.

- Verifying claims with cross-references

The platform uses trusted sources (WHO, Google Fact Check, verified news portals) and a multimodal agentic AI layer to confirm or refute claims.

- Producing accessible, contextual explanations

FactSure provides clear AI-generated explanations for each claim, ensuring users understand why a piece of information is true, false, or misleading.


Using a multimodal agentic AI system, FactSure can process inputs from social media links, news articles, PDFs, and user-submitted claims, cross-verify them with trusted sources, and classify them as true, false, or misleading. The system also generates clear, contextual explanations and tracks emerging misinformation trends, enabling a community-driven fact-checking ecosystem—demonstrating both innovation in misinformation detection and practical use of agentic AI.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![spaCy](https://img.shields.io/badge/spaCy-333333?style=flat-square) ![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Whisper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Whisper-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**NeuraVault — Offline Multimodal Intelligence Engine**

Our solution, NeuraVault, is a secure, AI-powered intelligence vault designed to enable multimodal information retrieval and reasoning in air-gapped or offline environments. It unifies text, image, and audio data under a single semantic search and retrieval framework — ensuring complete data sovereignty and zero cloud dependency.

NeuraVault works as an offline Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that integrates open-source models like Llama-3, CLIP, and Whisper. Texts, images, PDFs, and voice recordings are ingested, semantically embedded, and stored in a FAISS vector database. When a user issues a natural-language query such as “Show meeting notes related to the 2024 drone project”, NeuraVault performs cross-modal similarity search and provides a context-aware response with citation links to original sources.

The system supports hybrid search (semantic + keyword), role-based access, and an intuitive Streamlit/React dashboard for analysts and administrators.
All operations are fully local, running efficiently on an 8 GB GPU with sub-3-second latency using quantized models and containerized deployment (Docker + NVIDIA runtime).

*Why it matters*:
NeuraVault enhances analyst productivity, accelerates decision-making (reducing retrieval time from 45 min to 3 min), and supports secure collaboration between departments. It aligns with India’s data sovereignty goals and provides a cost-effective, open-source alternative to cloud-based AI systems — reducing infrastructure costs by over 80 %.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

*Misinformation — Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI*

**Reason**: NeuraVault enables offline, multimodal intelligence and semantic retrieval across documents, images, and voice data, allowing secure verification and contextual reasoning. This architecture can be extended to misinformation analysis in restricted domains where internet-based models aren’t viable.

**Description of your solution**

FinPilot is an agentic AI system built to guard the financial health of students, freelancers, and gig workers who live on irregular incomes.
Instead of being a passive budget tracker, FinPilot acts as a proactive financial guardian — it predicts upcoming cash-crunch situations before they occur and takes preventive actions to maintain a healthy balance.

It continuously learns from past transactions and spending habits to detect early “financial stress signals.” Using predictive modeling, it forecasts when the user’s balance might hit critical lows and simulates multiple micro-decisions like delaying bills, pausing subscriptions, or moving small savings automatically.
The agent communicates with users through smart, conversational nudges that adapt their tone depending on user behavior — from gentle reminders to firm alerts.

During the hackathon, we’ll build an end-to-end prototype that:

- Uploads or connects to a mock bank transaction CSV,
- Runs the AI cashflow prediction and decision engine,
- Displays the “before vs after” financial outcome visually on an intuitive dashboard.

FinPilot’s ultimate goal is to prevent users from hitting ₹0 balance by combining predictive intelligence + autonomous action in one seamless agent experience.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

**FinPilot** fits this Fintech track perfectly — it is an **autonomous financial coaching agent** built specifically for individuals with irregular income patterns such as gig workers, freelancers, and students.

The system **adapts** continuously to real user behavior by learning from transaction histories, spending cycles, and income variability. Using predictive modeling and agent-based decision logic, FinPilot anticipates upcoming cash-crunch situations and proactively suggests — or simulates — corrective actions like *pausing subscriptions, delaying bills, or auto-saving small amounts*.

This directly aligns with the track’s goal of helping citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively rather than reactively.

Unlike traditional budget trackers, FinPilot doesn’t just analyze — it acts. It provides dynamic, personalized recommendations and adapts its tone based on user behavior, representing a truly agentic financial coach that evolves with the user over time.

In short, FinPilot embodies the spirit of this track: AI that understands, predicts, and acts for financial well-being.

What is TrulyAI?

TrulyAI is a cutting-edge artificial intelligence platform designed to combat misinformation and verify claims through comprehensive multimodal analysis. In an era where false information spreads rapidly across social media, TrulyAI provides users with transparent, evidence-based fact-checking powered by advanced AI models and authentic news sources.

Core Mission

Fighting Misinformation Through AI-Powered Analysis

TrulyAI addresses the critical challenge of information verification in the digital age by:
- Analyzing Claims: Processing text, images, videos, and audio content
- Cross-Referencing Sources: Comparing claims against authenticated news sources
- Providing Transparency: Offering clear credibility scores with supporting evidence
- Real-Time Processing: Delivering fast, accurate fact-checking results

Key Features

Multimodal Content Analysis
- Text Analysis: Natural language processing for claim extraction and sentiment analysis
- Image Recognition: Visual content analysis, object detection, and text extraction
- Video Processing: Frame-by-frame analysis and scene understanding
- Audio Transcription: Speech-to-text conversion and audio content analysis

Social Media Monitoring
- Platform Integration: Analyzes content from YouTube, Twitter, Reddit, and other platforms
- Viral Content Detection: Identifies trending claims and potential misinformation
- Source Tracking: Traces the origin and spread of information across platforms

Credibility Scoring System
- Evidence-Based Scoring: 0-100% credibility ratings based on supporting evidence
- Transparent Methodology: Clear explanation of how scores are calculated
- Color-Coded Results: Green (Likely True), Yellow (Partially Verified), Red (Questionable)

Authentic Source Verification
- Curated News Sources: 19 authenticated sources across fact-checking, mainstream, tech, and academic categories
- Source Credibility Ratings: Each source has a predefined credibility score (0-100%)
- Cross-Reference Analysis: Compares claims against multiple reliable sources

How It Works

4-Stage Analysis Pipeline

1. Input Processing
   - Users submit claims, social media links, or upload media files
   - AI refines and extracts key information from the input
   - System identifies relevant search terms and platforms

2. Content Segregation
   - Extracts media content from social media posts
   - Downloads images, videos, and audio for local analysis
   - Organizes content by type and source platform

3. Multimodal Analysis
   - AWS Bedrock Nova models analyze visual and audio content
   - Extracts text, identifies objects, transcribes speech
   - Generates comprehensive content understanding

4. Fact-Checking & Verification
   - Searches authenticated news sources for verification
   - Compares evidence from multiple sources
   - Calculates final credibility score with supporting evidence

User Experience

Simple 4-Page Journey:
- Ask Page: Submit your claim or upload media
- Clarity Page: View initial analysis and social media findings
- Process Page: Watch real-time analysis with live progress updates
- Truth Page: See final results with credibility scores and evidence

AI Technology Stack

Amazon Web Services (AWS)
- AWS Bedrock: Cloud-based AI model access
- Nova Pro v1:0: Primary multimodal AI model for comprehensive analysis
- Nova Lite/Micro: Fallback models for efficient processing
- AWS Transcribe: Professional audio transcription service

Google AI Integration
- Gemini AI: Text processing and claim refinement
- Advanced Language Models: Natural language understanding and generation

OpenAI Integration
- Whisper API: High-accuracy audio transcription (fallback option)
- GPT Models: Text analysis and reasoning (future enhancement)

Real-World Applications

For Individuals
- Social Media Verification: Check viral posts before sharing
- News Validation: Verify news articles and claims
- Media Authentication: Analyze suspicious images, videos, or audio

For Organizations
- Content Moderation: Automated fact-checking for platforms
- Journalism Support: Research assistance for reporters and editors
- Educational Tools: Teaching media literacy and critical thinking

For Researchers
- Misinformation Studies: Analyze patterns in false information spread
- AI Research: Study multimodal content analysis techniques
- Social Media Analysis: Understand information flow across platforms

Privacy & Security

Data Protection
- Temporary Processing: Files automatically deleted after analysis
- No Data Retention: No permanent storage of user content
- Local Processing: Sensitive analysis performed locally when possible

Transparent Operations
- Open Source: MIT licensed for community contribution
- Clear Methodology: Transparent scoring and analysis methods
- Audit Trail: Detailed logging of all analysis steps

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Truly AI uses tools like AWS Nova, Gemini, Perplexity AI to find social media sources that potentially be misinformative, make Multi-Modal analysis on them seamlessly and give fact-checking conclusions with citations on whether the claims made in those social media contents are true or false

**Description of your solution**

In times of crisis, be it from floods to pandemics, false information travels more quickly than it can be verified, creating confusion, panic, and even loss of life.

Miss. Information is our solution, an agentic, multimodal AI system that **identifies**, **authenticates**, and **clarifies** misinformation in real-time on social media (like Instagram and Facebook) and messaging apps (like WhatsApp and Telegram).
 
Multiple specialized AI agents work autonomously to power the system:
 
1. **Collector Agent** persistently collects data from WhatsApp forwards (through user uploads), Twitter, Telegram, Facebook, and news APIs.
 
2. **Claim Detection Agent** extracts factual "claims" from text, images, videos, and memes using NLP and vision models.
 
3. **Fact Verification Agent** compares these claims with government portals, reliable fact-check databases, and fact-checked news APIs.
 
4. **Explanation Agent** provides users with lucid, contextual explanations, not merely stating "Fake" but telling us why.
For Example: "This is false: WHO validated X on this date".
 
5. **Distribution Agent** conveys validated results instantly through a **WhatsApp bot**, **Telegram bot**, **Instagram/Facebook Integration**, and **Browser extension.**
 
The platform also includes **deepfake and media forgery detection** (faces, voices, frames), reverse image search, and audio analysis to identify manipulated content.

**A Crisis Dashboard** graphically depicts rumor dissemination with real-time heatmaps, alert levels, and geographical insights.

**Gamified Modules** such as:
1. **Rumor Run**: Players see a live map of a virtual city where rumors spread like infections. They must fact check and contain the outbreaks.

2. **Truth Swipe** (Tinder style fact game): Users swipe left for Fake and right for Real based on real viral news snippets, memes or images.

3. **Spot the Fake**: Users see two side by side images, one real and one altered. They must find and click differences.

4. **Voice or Noise**: Play two short voice clips, one real and one AI-generated. Users must identify which is synthetic. 
 
These interactive games are designed especially for **young users** help them develop **critical thinking and media literacy** from an early age in a fun, rewarding approach.

By combining automated fact-checking, community engagement and youth friendly gamification, Miss. Information serves as an advanced defense system in real-time against disinformation, empowering citizens with truth and transparency in times of crisis.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

Our project, **Miss. Information**, tackles misinformation head-on by developing an **agentic, multimodal artificial intelligence framework** that can autonomously recognize, authenticate, and justify the credibility of information on platforms like **WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, and Facebook.**
 
It fits the Misinformation track to a tee through the utilization of multiple specialized agents acting in unison:
 
- **A Collector Agent** that perpetually fetches real-time content from messaging and social platforms.
 
- **A Claim Detection Agent** which scans text, images, video, and memes to mark out doubtful claims.
 
- **A Fact Verification Agent** which cross-checks these claims against reputable sources like government websites and confirmed fact-checking databases.
 
The system uses **multimodal analysis** to identify **deepfakes, image forgeries, and AI-generated speech**, providing end-to-end misinformation detection.

**Explanation Agent** subsequently converts the results into transparent, context-relevant explanations, assisting users in comprehending why something is false instead of just flagging it.
 
Embedded in daily channels such as **WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, Facebook and a Chrome plugin**, Miss. Information makes verified insights available to users in real-time.

To encourage early awareness and critical thinking, it features engaging **games** enabling **younger users** to be **taught media literacy through games**.
 
In effect, **Miss. Information** utilizes Agentic AI for real-time detection of misinformation, fact-checking, and public education, bringing to fruition the Misinformation track's full vision of an honest, transparent information ecosystem.

To address these challenges, an intelligent agent can be developed that integrates data from key sources such as PAN-Aadhaar databases, GSTN, banking transaction records, and regulatory alerts. **Impact:-**
Deploying such an agent would significantly enhance the efficiency and accuracy of AML efforts in India by automating data analysis, reducing manual oversight, and enabling proactive intervention. This would not only strengthen regulatory compliance and deter financial crimes but also build greater public trust in the integrity of India’s financial system.

**Description of your solution**

The Challenge:
 In todays digital world, anyone can easily publish any type of content like text, images, or files on social media or on Internet. Because of this Fake news, misleading documents or visual can be spread easily and can impact millions of people with misleading and confusion. People struggle to differentiate between disinformation and confirmed facts. Especially the misinformation majorly appears in viral images and shared files not just in articles.

   What if AI can teach , guide and empower everyone to be an astute news investigator in addition to verifying the facts,  regardless of the format in the which misinformation appears.

  Our solution :
TruthGuard AI is a AI powered Truth News Agent, A web-based adaptive platform in which users may verify the validity of:

1.News articles (through URL or copy-paste)
2.Uploaded images (screenshot, viral graphics, memes)
3.Uploaded text documents (docs, PDFs)

The processed content is all searched through by our multi-modal agentic AI, which cross-verifies proof, rates trust-worthiness, and locates the most valid sources on each assertion.

Key Features
Universal Input Modes: Evaluate news for truth/falsity independent of whether it is delivered as a link, typed text, image, or uploaded file. The agent can pull out and fact-check headlines, read text from images (OCR), and even parse documents.

Autonomous Multimodal Evidence Search: For each input, the agent collates indexed news, fact-checks, and reliable references (The Hindu, TOI, ANI, BBC, and others), and then presents direct links to ensure transparency.

Visual Manipulation Detection: Images are checked for evidence of editing, deepfake anomalies, watermark manipulation, and compared to recognized viral fakery databases.

Personalized News IQ Quiz: Educates and involves new and repeat users—tailored by content trends and user learning history.

Proactive Alerts & Adaptive Learning: The agent identifies spikes in suspect viral images/files, learns from user behavior, and adapts capabilities by regularly retraining on fresh cases of misinformation.

Community Empowerment: Each scan strengthens the AI, and they work together towards a crowd-sourced shield against new tricks in misinformation.

Improved User Experience
Submit source: Copy-paste news, upload photo, or choose file.

Agent review: Text is pulled out from any format, facts are checked, visual forgeries are analyzed, and credibility is scored.

Transparency in results: User is given a verdict (True/False/Neutral), trust score, and trusted reference article list.

Learn and improve: Quiz interactions teach users and further tune the AI’s fraud-spotting skills.

Technical Advantage
Multimodal AI pipeline blends NLP for text analysis and Computer Vision for images (OCR, forgery detection).

Background agentic processing links all evidence autonomously—no manual intervention required.

Scalable: APIs can support browser plugins, newsroom integrations, and community fact-checking campaigns.

Demo Highlights
Home page for news checks (by text/link/upload)​
Daily quiz to teach real-world skills​
Visual output with links to trustworthy sources​
Table of results for scanned content from trusted media

Our system has a genuinely agentic AI: it scans independently for evidence, evolves its verification logic as it goes along, cross-references credible sources, and actively educates users.

4. Maximal Utilization of the Track's Creative Licence
This project is the epitome of the hackathon's vision for the open problem track: allowing teams to create their own challenge and autonomous AI-driven solution to misinformation, with the utmost creativity and impact.

We couple technical innovation (multi-modal agent, autonomous learning, scalable APIs) with social applicability (user engagement, news literacy, broad topic coverage).

**Description of your solution**

**Stocker AI : An Agentic AI-Powered Autonomous Trading Platform**

Stocker AI is an Agentic AI-powered autonomous trading and investment platform designed to revolutionize how traders analyze markets and execute trades. The system functions through a network of intelligent financial agents that think, plan, analyze, and act collaboratively — just like a team of expert traders — but powered by AI precision, speed, and adaptability.

1. **Market Intelligence Agent (Market Scanner)**: Continuously **monitors live market feeds, price action, order book depth**, and liquidity imbalances to **detect trend shifts, breakouts, and high-probability** setups. It identifies market regimes (bullish, bearish, range-bound) and early signals that human traders often miss.

2. **Strategy Architect Agent (Algo Strategist)**: **Automatically generates, backtests, and optimizes trading strategies using reinforcement learning** and evolutionary algorithms. It dynamically selects trend-following, mean-reversion, or breakout strategies based on current market volatility and momentum indicators.

3. **Execution Agent (Trade Execution Specialist)**: Executes trades with precision using slippage prediction, optimal order slicing, and liquidity analysis. It **ensures trades hit ideal entry and exit levels**, manages position sizing, and adjusts in real time to high-frequency market fluctuations.

4. **Pattern Recognition Agent (Chart Pattern Analyzer)**: Detects classic technical formations like **head & shoulders, double tops/bottoms, triangles, flags, and wedges**across multiple timeframes using AI-driven computer vision. Provides predictive insights for trend reversals and continuation patterns.

5. **Risk & Hedge Agent (Portfolio Risk Manager)**: Continuously **monitors drawdown, VaR, volatility, and beta exposure**, applying dynamic stop-loss, trailing stops, and hedging strategies. Optimizes capital allocation to reduce risk while maintaining return potential.
 
6. **Reinforcement Trader Agent** (Adaptive Algo Trader): **Learns from historical trades, evaluating profit/loss ratios**, Sharpe ratios, and strategy efficiency. Continuously fine-tunes position entries, exits, and strategy parameters for maximum risk-adjusted returns.
 
7. **Sentiment & Crowd Analyzer Agent** : Analyzes news, social media, and financial forums to quantify fear and greed indices, market sentiment, and retail vs. institutional activity. Integrates psychological insights with technical and fundamental signals for emotion-aware trading decisions.

**Why Stocker AI is Exceptional**:

- **70% trading-focused Agentic AI**(technical analysis, strategy creation, order flow, execution)
- **30% fundamental/financial intelligence** (earnings, valuation, news impact)
- Fully autonomous, self-learning, and adaptive, continuously evolving strategies and execution in real time
- Combines technical, fundamental, and sentiment analysis in one intelligent ecosystem

This makes Stocker AI a next-gen trading assistant and autonomous market strategist, unlike any existing platform, perfect for traders seeking AI-driven, data-first, emotion-free trading decisions.

![Langchain framework](https://img.shields.io/badge/Langchain%20framework-333333?style=flat-square) ![Weaviate (Vector Database)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Weaviate%20(Vector%20Database)-333333?style=flat-square) ![Llama 3 (Large Language Model)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Llama%203%20(Large%20Language%20Model)-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

We are building TrueTrace, an AI-powered real-time misinformation detection system that helps users verify the credibility of online content instantly. In today’s digital world, false information spreads faster than facts, and users lack simple tools to verify what they see or share.

TrueTrace addresses this by allowing users to paste any social media post or news link, which the system then analyzes through a combination of:

AI-based Natural Language Processing (NLP) using LangChain with Llama 3,

Semantic search on verified data sources through Weaviate, and

Cross-referencing with trusted news APIs like NewsData.io or Mediastack.

The platform generates a Credibility Score along with source-backed explanations, helping users make informed decisions before believing or forwarding information.

The solution includes:

An interactive and animated web dashboard where users can verify content in real-time.

A browser extension interface for quick link scanning on social media.

A modular backend powered by Node.js and deployable on AWS Lambda or Render (Free Tier) for scalability.

Our focus is on creating a lightweight, visually appealing, and fully functional demo that demonstrates the potential of real-time misinformation detection powered by AI.

By combining AI fact-checking, semantic search, and an intuitive user interface, TrueTrace empowers users to combat misinformation efficiently, fostering a more informed and trustworthy digital environment.

Uniqueness

Hybrid Fact Verification: Combines semantic similarity (LLMs like Llama 3) with API-based truth validation from trusted news sources for higher accuracy.

Real-time Credibility Scoring: Instantly analyzes and assigns a credibility score to posts or shared links.

Browser Extension + Web App Integration: Works seamlessly as both a social media plugin and a standalone verification dashboard.

Multilingual Support: Uses LLM fine-tuning to understand misinformation in regional languages (Hindi, Marathi, etc.).

Weaviate Vector Database: Enables contextual cross-referencing across large verified datasets for deep fact validation.

Privacy-first Architecture: Performs checks using serverless (AWS Lambda) functions without storing user data.

Future Scope

Integration with Social Media APIs: Direct fact-checking of posts on X (Twitter), Facebook, Instagram, etc.

Voice & Chatbot Support: Add voice-based query verification and a chatbot assistant for instant user interaction.

Blockchain-backed Verification: Record verified facts and claims on a public ledger for long-term authenticity tracking.

Community-driven Misinformation Reports: Allow users to flag and contribute to a verified fact database.

AI Explainability: Introduce a “Why this is fake/true” feature for transparency and better user awareness.

Educational Integration: Deploy the tool in schools and universities to train digital literacy and critical thinking.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

Our project, the AI Fact-Checking Assistant, directly addresses the core challenge of the Misinformation Track — combating the spread of false or misleading information on social media and digital platforms.

Social media users are constantly exposed to unverified posts, edited images, and manipulated news that spread rapidly without validation. Our system helps tackle this issue by:

Automatically scanning shared links or posts on platforms like X (Twitter), Facebook, and Instagram.

Cross-referencing content with trusted news APIs and verified databases using semantic similarity models (via LangChain + Llama 3).

Generating a credibility score that helps users instantly judge whether the information is reliable or suspicious.

Offering explainable outputs, so users understand why a post was flagged as true or false.

Supporting multiple languages, making fact-checking accessible to a broader audience in India and beyond.

By providing real-time verification, transparency, and digital awareness, the project empowers users to think critically before sharing content, which is the main objective of the Misinformation track.

In an era where information spreads instantly, the proliferation of misinformation poses a significant threat to public trust, especially during times of crisis. To combat this challenge, we propose an AI-powered agentic system has been developed to proactively detect and neutralize harmful narratives online.

This solution is an "Agentic AI" system. This means it doesn't just perform tasks, it's a proactive, learning collaborator. It is designed to autonomously scan a wide array of digital sources in real time, from social media platforms to news outlets, to identify and verify emerging information.

*   **Critical Information Analysis:** The AI is equipped to identify and prioritize critical claims within online posts. It will then validate their authenticity by scouring the internet and other reliable sources.
*   **Clear and Contextual Updates:** A core function of the system is to provide the public with easy-to-understand, contextual updates on verified information. This will empower users to make well-informed decisions during rapidly evolving events and crises.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

CrisisWatch - Real-Time Misinformation Detection & Correction Agent

Our AI agent tackles misinformation spread during critical emergencies like earthquakes, floods, disease outbreaks, and geopolitical crises. During these high-stress moments, false information spreads faster than facts - causing panic, wrong evacuations, dangerous remedies, and loss of life.

How it works:
The agent continuously monitors Twitter, Facebook, WhatsApp, news sites, and YouTube in real-time. It uses advanced NLP and cross-referencing to identify false claims about ongoing crises, rank them by severity, and instantly generate clear, contextual corrections for non-technical audiences. It works in Hindi and English, adapting explanations for different regions and literacy levels.

Real Problem Example:
During the 2023 Turkey-Syria earthquake, false evacuation routes spread on WhatsApp causing people to run to unsafe zones. During COVID, fake remedies like cow urine went viral. During communal tensions, inflammatory misinformation creates riots. Our agent catches these within minutes, not hours.

Target Users:
- Government disaster management agencies (NDMA, State DMAs)
- News organizations and fact-checkers
- NGOs and crisis response teams
- Vulnerable populations needing verified information during emergencies

Revenue Model:
1. Government contracts with NDMA and state agencies (₹20+ lakhs annually per state)
2. B2B partnerships with news organizations for fact-checking integration
3. NGO subscriptions for real-time crisis monitoring
4. Future: API licensing to social platforms for automated fact-checking

Why it wins:
✓ Directly prevents misinformation harm during crises
✓ AI agent is core - continuously learns and adapts
✓ Clear revenue from government and media
✓ Scalable across all crisis types and regions
✓ Proven market demand from recent crisis events

**Description of your solution**

**AarogyAI** is a *smart AI-powered hospital assistant* built to help hospitals in India prepare better during busy times like **festivals, pollution spikes, or disease outbreaks**. During these events, hospitals often face sudden patient surges, staff shortages, and supply issues. AarogyAI uses data and intelligent agents to **predict what’s coming and help hospitals plan in advance** — making healthcare smoother, faster, and more reliable.

The system has four main AI agents that work together. The **SentinelAgent** watches real-world data like air quality, weather, and festival dates to predict when patient numbers might rise. The **CoordinatorAgent** suggests how many staff and supplies will be needed. The **CareCompanionAgent** connects with patients or staff through chat or SMS to send important updates and advice. Finally, the **SupervisorAgent** manages and coordinates all the other agents.

The project shows how **Agentic AI** can think, plan, and act on its own — helping hospitals stay ready before crises happen. It’s practical, fast, and designed to make *healthcare management smarter and easier for everyone*.

# CyberGuard: Banking Threat Intelligence Platform
## Solution Description & Technologies

---

## SOLUTION DESCRIPTION

### The Problem

Banks take 4-6 hours to respond to cyber threats manually. Attackers use this delay to steal data, disrupt payments, and cause millions in damages. Current security systems only alert humans who must then investigate and respond.

### Our Solution

Cyber Guard is an AI-powered dashboard that shows how autonomous agents detect threats and respond in under 60 seconds. The platform demonstrates multi-agent collaboration for banking cybersecurity through five specialized interfaces.

### How It Works

**Six AI Agents Working Together:**

1. Triage Agent - Analyzes threats and assigns priority
2. Investigation Agent - Identifies attack patterns and threat actors
3. Response Agent - Plans defensive actions
4. Execution Agent - Implements security controls automatically
5. Learning Agent - Improves detection over time
6. Explanation Agent - Generates compliance reports

**Process Flow:**
Threat Detected → AI Agents Analyze → Actions Executed → Report Generated

**Time:** Under 60 seconds from detection to mitigation

---

## THE 5 DASHBOARD SCREENS

### 1. Threat Intelligence Hub
Real-time threat monitoring with live feed, severity indicators, and IOC details (IPs, domains, malware hashes)

### 2. Multi Agent Workspace
Visualizes AI agent collaboration, shows decision-making process, and displays MITRE ATT&CK framework mapping

### 3. Executive Security Center
High-level overview with security scores, KPIs, and risk assessment for management and executives

### 4. SOC Performance Analytics
Team performance metrics including response times, resolution rates, and automation ROI

### 5. Compliance Audit Center
Regulatory tracking for PCI-DSS, GDPR, and other banking requirements with automated report generation

---

## KEY BENEFITS

**Speed** - Responds in 30 seconds vs 4+ hours manually

**Automation** - Handles 90% of threats without human intervention

**Visibility** - Complete view from threat detection to compliance reporting

**Cost Savings** - Reduces SOC workload by 90%, saves $8M+ annually per bank

**Compliance** - Built-in audit trails for banking regulations

---

### Frontend
- React  - Component-based dashboard
- Tailwind CSS - Responsive design with blur effects
- Recharts - Data visualization and charts

### AI Integration (Ready to Connect)
- Google Gemini - Powers AI agent reasoning

### Backend (Prepared for Integration)
- Firebase/Supabase - Real-time database
- Cloud Functions - Serverless agent execution
- RESTful APIs - Threat feed integration

### External Services
- VirusTotal API - Malware analysis
- AbuseIPDB - IP reputation
- MITRE ATT&CK - Threat classification

- Continuous compliance documentation

---

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

## THE PROBLEM

Banks get attacked 10,000+ times every day. When hackers break in, security teams take 4-6 hours to stop them. In those hours, hackers steal money, customer data, and shut down payment systems.

**Why this matters for fintech:** No security = No trust = No digital banking.

---

## OUR SOLUTION

SENTINEL uses 6 AI agents that work like a security team, but 100x faster.

**What each agent does:**

1. **Triage Agent** - Finds threats and says which ones are dangerous
2. **Investigation Agent** - Figures out who the hacker is and what they want
3. **Response Agent** - Decides how to stop the attack
4. **Execution Agent** - Actually blocks the hacker (no human needed)
5. **Learning Agent** - Gets smarter after each attack
6. **Explanation Agent** - Writes reports for bank regulators

**Result:** Stops attacks in 30 seconds instead of 4 hours.

**Description of your solution**

We’re solving the problem of misinformation by building an on-demand Agentic AI system called "**Claricure**", which helps users verify and correct any content they’re unsure about—*whether it’s a viral claim, image, video, or educational material*. 

Instead of scanning the web constantly, our system activates when a user submits something, analyzes it using NLP and media forensics, and searches trusted sources like fact-checking platforms, government portals, academic databases, and credible news outlets to retrieve accurate, up-to-date information. It then provides a clear verdict—true, false, misleading, or unverifiable—along with corrected facts, simple explanations, and links to reliable sources. We’re building this using Python, FastAPI, LangChain, OpenAI GPT, Hugging Face Transformers, MongoDB, Redis, Twilio, WhatsApp Cloud API, and ReactJS. 

*This empowers users to challenge misinformation confidently and promotes informed decision-making in everyday life.*

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

**Unique Approach:** Unlike systems that scan the internet constantly, Claricure activates only when a user submits content they want verified — making it efficient, focused, and user-centric.

**Agentic AI Use:** It behaves autonomously by analyzing the input, detecting manipulation (e.g., deepfakes), verifying claims, and retrieving accurate data from trusted sources — all without human intervention.

**Custom Problem Framing:** You’ve brought your own angle to misinformation; empowering individuals to challenge falsehoods in real time, whether it’s a viral video, a misleading post, or flawed educational content.

**Impactful Solution:** Claricure promotes informed decision-making, combats misinformation at the grassroots level, and builds public trust — especially valuable during crises or viral disinformation waves.

**The problem it solves**

# 💫 Wonder Converter

### 🚀 Offline Universal File Converter

Wonder Converter is a **cross-platform desktop app** built with **Electron** that converts almost any file type — images, documents, spreadsheets, and text — **completely offline** and **with no data tracking or upload to cloud servers**.

---

## 💡 Problem Statement

In a world full of online converters, users often face:
- 🌐 **Privacy risks** — Sensitive files are uploaded to unknown servers.  
- ⚡ **Slow conversions** — Internet dependency makes conversion unreliable.  
- 🔐 **Limited formats** — Most online tools support only one or two conversion types.  
- 💰 **Paywalls & limits** — “Free” converters restrict file sizes or conversions per day.  

Students, freelancers, and professionals all need a **secure, all-in-one, offline** tool to handle file conversions **instantly and privately**.

---

## ✅ Solution: Wonder Converter

**Wonder Converter** provides a **lightweight, secure, and offline** alternative to all those online tools.  
Built using **Electron + Node.js**, it performs every conversion locally — ensuring your data never leaves your device.

---

## ✨ Key Features

### 🖼️ Image Conversion
- Convert between formats: **PNG, JPG, BMP, etc.**
- Merge or batch-convert images into a single **PDF**

### 📄 Document Conversion
- **DOC → PDF**
- **PDF → DOCX**
- **TXT → PDF**
- **TXT → DOCX**
- **PDF → TXT**

### 📊 Spreadsheet Conversion
- **XLSX → PDF**
- **CSV → PDF**

### 🔒 File Encryption
- Convert **any file** into a **password-protected ZIP** archive for secure sharing

---

## 🧠 Tech Stack
| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-------------|
| Frontend | Electron, HTML, CSS, JavaScript |
| Backend | Node.js, fs, path, and third-party libraries like `sharp`, `jsPDF`, `xlsx`, `docx`, etc. |
| Platform | Cross-Platform (Windows, macOS, Linux) |

---

## 🧩 Architecture Overview
- `main.js` — Electron main process, handles window creation & IPC.  
- `controllers/` — Individual handlers for each conversion type (image, pdf, docx, csv, etc.).  
- `renderer/` — UI logic and event bindings for file upload and conversion.  
- `output/` — Default directory for converted files (`~/wonder-converter-output`).

---

## 🔐 Why It Stands Out
- 100% **offline**
- **No file size limits**
- **Privacy-first design**
- **Unified interface** for all conversion types
- **Cross-platform** — works on Windows, macOS, and Linux

---

## 💻 Future Scope
- Add **OCR** (optical character recognition) for scanned PDFs.  
- Introduce **batch automation** with drag-and-drop folders.  
- Optional **CLI tool** for developers.


---

> “Convert anything, anywhere — securely, privately, and offline.”  
> — *Wonder Converter*

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Real-Time Message Sync Issue

Issue:
Messages between users (citizen ↔ worker) were not updating in real time after being sent.

Cause:
The onSnapshot listener in React was not correctly scoped to the selected complaint or wasn’t re-subscribed when the selected chat changed.

2. Auto-Scroll Conflicts in Chat Window

Issue:
Initially, the chat window auto-scrolled to the latest message even when the user was manually scrolling through older messages, causing poor UX.

Solution:
I implemented manual scrolling — auto-scroll now only triggers when the user is near the bottom. This provided a smooth, chat-like experience similar to messaging apps.

Routing and Rendering Errors

3. Issue:
During development, the app often showed blank pages or the wrong component after login or signup. Sometimes, protected routes were not redirecting correctly, and components failed to re-render when user state changed.

Cause:
This happened due to improper usage of BrowserRouter, Routes, and ProtectedRoute logic in React, along with missing dependency updates in state-based conditions.

Solution:
I restructured the routing using React Router v6 and wrapped the app with a proper AuthContext provider.

**The problem it solves**

Many people struggle to find the right teammates for projects or hackathons. Current ways like manual searching or random networking take too much time and often don’t work well.

With our platform, people can:

1. Quickly find teammates who have matching skills and interests.
2. Form balanced teams (like coder + designer + manager).
3. Discover hackathons and projects that fit their profile.
4. Work together easily, even if they are from different places.

This makes teamwork faster, easier, and more effective, so fewer opportunities are lost

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenge: While building the recommendation system, we struggled with making AI understand user project ideas that were written in very different ways. Normal keyword matching was giving poor results.

Solution: We solved this by using NLP embeddings (Sentence Transformers) instead of plain keywords. This helped the system capture the real meaning of the text and improved the accuracy of collaborator matching.

Another hurdle was storing and searching embeddings efficiently as the data grew.

Solution: We integrated FAISS for semantic search, which made similarity matching much faster and scalable.

The AI-Enhanced Career Guidance and Monitoring System addresses the 

"Career Confusion Crisis" , a significant issue for youth aged 15-25 who struggle with making informed career choices in a hyperconnected world filled with digital distractions. The project aims to solve the problem of 


mismatched careers, where studies show that 70% of students end up in jobs that don't align with their skills or interests, leading to unemployment and underutilized potential. Traditional career counseling is often generic and lacks the personalization, real-time monitoring, and AI-driven feasibility analysis that today's youth need.


How People Use It and Its Impact 🚀
This platform revolutionizes career guidance by making it personalized and proactive. Users can use the system for the following:


Getting Personalized Career Recommendations: Instead of generic advice, the system provides highly personalized career recommendations by analyzing a user's academic performance, interests, and psychometric assessments. This ensures that the suggested careers are a strong match for their individual skills and interests.


Creating a Personalized Roadmap: The system provides clear skill development roadmaps, relevant course recommendations, and targeted internship opportunities. This helps users understand the steps they need to take to achieve their career goals.


Monitoring and Guidance: The system’s unique hardware monitoring capability tracks a user’s focus and activity levels. This feature ensures that the suggested career paths are not only a good fit on paper but are also practically achievable based on the user's real-world engagement and capabilities.






Navigating the Job Market: The platform gives users insights into the current job market and industry trends, which helps them make strategic decisions about their future.


Reducing Career Mismatches: The ultimate benefit is a projected 70% reduction in career mismatches, helping students avoid entering unsuitable careers. This fosters a more engaged and successful workforce, as the system guides youth toward their optimal futures.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges and Mitigation Strategies 🐛
While building this project, Team Debug Dynamos anticipated and faced several key challenges:


Data Privacy Concerns: This was a major hurdle due to the sensitive nature of the user data being collected, including academic and psychometric information.



Mitigation: The team addressed this by implementing GDPR-compliant encryption, along with obtaining explicit user consent and maintaining transparent data usage policies.


Hardware Accuracy: Ensuring the continuous accuracy of the real-time sensor data from the wearable devices was a significant technical challenge. The system's effectiveness relies on precise data about focus and activity levels.



Mitigation: The solution involved comprehensive sensor calibration using machine learning baselines and continuous accuracy validation.


Algorithm Bias: A common issue in AI development is the potential for algorithms to exhibit bias, leading to unfair or skewed career recommendations.


Mitigation: The team's proactive approach included using diverse training datasets, conducting regular bias audits, and adopting inclusive model development practices to ensure fairness and accuracy.


Technical Demo Risks: As with any live demonstration, there was a risk of technical failures, such as connectivity issues, which could disrupt the presentation.


Mitigation: The team prepared for this by having offline prototype backups and multiple connectivity options to ensure a seamless and reliable demonstration.

By proactively identifying these challenges and developing robust mitigation strategies, the team demonstrated its commitment to delivering a reliable, ethical, and scalable solution that prioritizes user trust and system integrity.

**$300(Open): Cash Prize**

The system is a unique fusion of several disciplines, including 

artificial intelligence, software development, and hardware engineering. It is not a simple app or a pure hardware device; instead, it combines a mobile and web application with specialized hardware for a seamless and holistic user experience.

Our solution tackles the "Career Confusion Crisis" by providing a personalized platform that goes beyond traditional guidance. It leverages 


AI and machine learning to analyze user data and provide highly personalized career recommendations. Furthermore, our innovative use of hardware to track real-world focus and activity patterns sets it apart from other projects.


The project demonstrates a high level of technical complexity and a clear, well-defined vision to create a scalable solution. It showcases a robust tech stack, including Python/Flask for the backend, React for the frontend, and C++ for hardware integration. This multifaceted approach and its potential for significant social impact make it an ideal candidate for the Open category.

**Ethereum Track**

Our project, the AI-Enhanced Career Guidance and Monitoring System, can be enhanced by integrating with the Ethereum blockchain to create a secure, transparent, and user-centric professional identity. By leveraging Ethereum, we can solve critical issues related to data integrity and credential verification in the career development space.

Here’s how we propose to integrate our system with the Ethereum track:

Decentralized Professional Identity (DID): A user's academic records, certifications, and skill endorsements, which are currently part of our centralized database, can be stored as verifiable credentials on the Ethereum blockchain. This would give users full ownership and control over their data, making their professional identity censorship-resistant and portable across different platforms.

Immutable Credentialing: When a user completes a course or earns a certification recommended by our AI, a non-fungible token (NFT) or a smart contract could be minted to create an immutable record of that achievement. This would prevent fraudulent claims and provide a tamper-proof history of a user's skill development, which can be verified by employers.

Smart Contract-Based Incentives: We can use smart contracts to create a transparent system for rewarding users for achieving milestones in their career roadmap. For example, completing a skill development path could automatically trigger a reward or a digital badge stored on the blockchain, encouraging engagement.

This integration would transform our centralized guidance system into a decentralized, trustless ecosystem, empowering users with secure data ownership and verifiable professional credentials.

> Reducing Friction in tracking performance

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenAi](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenAi-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square) ![claude](https://img.shields.io/badge/claude-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

AI models are powerful, but they are far from perfect. Teams spend hours manually analyzing outputs, often missing subtle errors, and struggle to understand why a model fails in certain scenarios. Tracking performance metrics and organizing error patterns is slow, fragmented, and error-prone. EvalLens solves this by providing an all-in-one platform to automatically analyze AI outputs, cluster similar errors, track metrics, and allow human annotations—helping teams identify, understand, and fix model errors faster.

Check out the presentation here : https://www.loom.com/share/c458d26de728427caf6dac1b0484d7d6?sid=98cefab9-25d7-4b11-b256-ceec5b7ddf99 

Text Version : https://app.chroniclehq.com/share/850cd747-fb2f-494c-a6df-07a41cca68c1/1b190dba-587c-4373-9e92-7831bf101145/intro

Try out the platform : https://eval-lens.streamlit.app/

Polished UI that will be shipped soon : https://eval-lens-frontend-83.lovable.app/

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges & How I Overcame Them

- **Aggregating and clustering errors:** Model outputs had inconsistent formatting, making clustering difficult.  
  **Solution:** Implemented preprocessing pipelines to normalize outputs, ensuring consistent embeddings and accurate error grouping.

- **Latency and performance tracking:** Real-time metrics risked slowing down the dashboard.  
  **Solution:** Separated base output metrics from fine-tuned evaluation, computing the latter only when available to reduce load.

- **Human annotation interface:** Early designs overwhelmed reviewers.  
  **Solution:** Built a lightweight, guided annotation interface with inline examples and auto-suggestions for faster, intuitive labeling.

- **Labeling clusters with an LLM:** Achieving accurate labels required extensive prompt engineering and dataset curation.  
  **Solution:** Iteratively refined prompts and curated datasets, using multiple evaluation rounds to ensure meaningful, actionable cluster labels.

- **Coding the clustering solution:** Issues with JSON formatting, incorrect labels, and poorly sized clusters reduced usefulness.  
  **Solution:** Added robust JSON validation, sanity checks, and experimented with clustering thresholds to balance the number of clusters and ensure useful insights.

### GovForm Helper
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/govform-helper-f9eb) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://govform-helper-web-gpnf681.public.builtwithrocket.new) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-mosAIc:%20AI%20in%20action%20with%20The%20Product%20Folks-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mosaicbytpf.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Your multilingual companion for government forms.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The problem it solves

Government forms are often long, technical, and available only in one language. Many citizens — especially those with limited literacy, limited digital skills, or who speak a different regional language — struggle to understand what each field means, what documents are required, or how to correctly complete and submit a form. That leads to mistakes, rejected applications, wasted time, frustration, and increased load on helpdesks and frontline workers.

Who can use it

Everyday citizens (urban and rural) who need help filling government forms.

Elderly users or low-digital-literacy users who prefer voice guidance.

NGO volunteers, community workers, and social workers who assist groups of people.

Government help-desk staff who want a consistent, plain-language explanation to give callers.

Field officers who need offline capture and a reliable checklist for follow-ups.

What people can use it for (real tasks / scenarios)

Apply for or renew passports, PAN, ration cards, pensions, and welfare schemes.

Register births, deaths, marriages, and property records.

Submit tax forms, scholarship applications, and student admission forms.

Prepare and upload the exact set of supporting documents required by an office.

Convert a filled paper form into a correctly formatted digital copy ready for submission.

Train volunteers: bulk-prep prefilled forms for beneficiaries (NGO workflows).

How it makes tasks easier, faster, and safer

Easier

Breaks forms into bite-sized, plain-language steps (English & Hindi) so users don’t have to parse dense instructions.

Voice (TTS) reads instructions aloud; users can speak answers (STT) — lowers the barrier for non-readers.

Faster

Profile-based prefill maps commonly repeated fields (name, address, DOB), cutting repetitive typing.

Auto-generated document checklist avoids trips to the office for missing papers.

Real-time progress & validation reduce rework caused by format errors (e.g., date formats, length limits).

Safer & more reliable

Shows provenance and confidence for each instruction (links to official source) so users can verify before submitting.

Ephemeral processing and strict PII controls (consent, encryption, deletion options) reduce data exposure risk.

Highlights low-confidence items and offers human escalation before submission to prevent incorrect/legal mistakes.

Example user journeys (short)

Rita — renews passport

Uploads passport form PDF → app highlights fields → reads each field in Hindi → she speaks answers → profile prefill fills name/address → document checklist shows required ID & photo → preview PDF → downloads and prints for submission.

Community volunteer — helps 50 beneficiaries

Creates a beneficiary profile CSV → app batch-prefills the correct local welfare form → volunteer reviews & uploads supporting documents → exports ready-to-submit PDFs — saves dozens of hours.

Elderly user — files pension form

Chooses Hindi, listens to each field, marks “Don’t know” for a bank detail → asks a human through the “Help” flow only for that field → completes form with confidence.

Safety, privacy & trust protections (how the app reduces risk)

Consent-first: explicit consent screen before processing any PII or external connectors.

Ephemeral-by-default: raw uploads deleted after 7 days unless the user opts to save.

Encryption & access controls: TLS in transit, encrypted storage, RBAC for admin tools.

Provenance & warnings: every guidance item shows source links and confidence; ambiguous guidance says “verify.”

Regulatory guardrails: blocks or flags handling of restricted data (e.g., Aadhaar biometrics) and requires legal review for identity integrations.

How success looks (metrics to track)

Form completion rate — % users who finish and export/submit a filled form.

Time-to-complete — median time per form (goal: reduce by 30–50% vs manual).

Error reduction — % fewer rejections or help-desk follow-ups for pilot forms.

User satisfaction — average helpfulness rating (goal ≥ 4/5).

Adoption by helpers — number of NGO/field officers using batch workflows.

Limitations & user guidance

The app provides guidance, not legal advice. For legally sensitive or contested cases, users should verify with the issuing authority.

Handwritten fields and extremely poor scans will lower OCR accuracy — app will surface confidence and recommend human review.

Integrations with identity systems (DigiLocker, eSign, passport portal) should be enabled only after legal & security review.

**Challenges we ran into**

Out-of-date or wrong instructions (govt updates form text/layout) → wrong guidance to users.

Missing authoritative source (field-level guidance not available or inconsistent across sources).

ML hallucination when using LLMs (invented requirements).

Poor mapping between instruction text and form fields (esp. on scanned/handwritten forms).

Language errors in Hindi translations (meaning drift, wrong legal nuance).

> See how your model thinks

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![Heroku](https://img.shields.io/badge/Heroku-333333?style=flat-square) ![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-333333?style=flat-square) ![XGBoost](https://img.shields.io/badge/XGBoost-333333?style=flat-square) ![d3.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/d3.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Plotly](https://img.shields.io/badge/Plotly-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**AI Is a Black Box**

- Black-box issue: Most AI models, especially deep learning, are extremely hard to interpret. End users, regulators, and even developers don’t trust predictions if they can’t explain “why.”
- Without explanations, users don’t trust AI, developers can’t debug AI, and businesses can’t adopt AI safely.


**Who Needs This?**

1. Students & Learners

- Want to see how models think instead of just numbers.
- Makes learning ML more visual & interactive.

2. Developers & AI Engineers
- Helps debug and fine-tune models quickly.
- Spot biases (e.g., gender or location affecting predictions unfairly).

3. Startups & SMBs
- Need affordable interpretability tools to show customers why AI decisions are safe and fair.
- Avoid legal/compliance risks (GDPR, HIPAA).

4. Business Users / Clients
- Can trust AI more when given human-friendly explanations.
- Example: “Loan rejected because income < 30k and credit score low” → easy to understand.


**How It Makes Tasks Easier & Safer**

1. Easier Model Debugging

- No need to run complex Jupyter notebooks with SHAP/LIME.
- Upload→ visualize → understand in minutes.

2. Safer AI Decisions
- Identifies biases and hidden risks in models before deployment.
- Example: Detects if a hiring AI unfairly favors one gender.

3. Faster Trust & Adoption
- Provides instant natural-language summaries for non-technical users.
- Businesses can use this to justify AI outputs to clients and regulators.

4. Better Learning Tool
- Students can interactively explore how changing data affects predictions.
- Turns abstract ML math into visual stories.

**Top 100 Participants**

GlassBox AI transforms complex ML explainability libraries into a no-code, SaaS-style platform that anyone can use. Instead of writing Python scripts, users simply upload their model/data and instantly get interactive dashboards, feature importance heatmaps, and natural language explanations. By lowering the barrier to entry, we make AI transparency accessible to startups, educators, and SMBs, perfectly aligning with Lovable’s vision of building impactful AI-powered apps with ease.

**AI Evals & Observability | Powered by Maxim**

AI Interpretability Companion empowers AI developers, students, and small teams to deeply understand their models through clear, visual, and shareable explanations. By integrating tools like SHAP, LIME, Captum, and even natural-language summaries, the platform delivers essential observability—unveiling how models make decisions on features, samples, and layers. This not only aids debugging and model comparison, but also fosters trust and accountability in AI systems—perfectly complementing the “AI Evals & Observability” focus of Maxim.

Alto.ai is designed to revolutionize retail operations through intelligent automation and data-driven insights.

**1.AltoGeospatial Hub** : Visualizes real-time demand and inventory flow in map and widget view
**2.Automated Stock Reallocation:** Monitors stock levels and triggers transfers between stores to meet customer demand efficiently.
**3.Predictive Analytics:** Real-time demand forecasting and inventory adjustments based on historical sales data.
4.**Distraction and Safety Risks for Drivers**
Traditional route management often requires drivers to look at screens or phones while driving, increasing the risk of accidents.Alto.ai eliminates screen dependence, providing voice-guided instructions so drivers can stay focused on the road.
5.**Inefficient Route Planning**
Dispatchers manually updating drivers or relying on static maps can cause delays, missed deliveries, or wasted fuel.Alto.ai dynamically optimizes routes in real-time, adjusting for traffic, delivery priorities, and unexpected changes.
6.**Communication Bottlenecks**
Coordinating between dispatchers and drivers can be slow, especially for last-minute changes or emergencies.Alto.ai communicates instantly via voice, reducing response time and ensuring everyone is aligned.
7.**Driver Fatigue and Cognitive Load**
Switching between maps, messages, and tasks can overwhelm drivers.
Alto.ai provides a hands-free, voice-driven workflow, simplifying task management and reducing mental strain.

**Voice AI & Conversational Products | Powered by Elevenlabs**

1. Voice-First Interaction for Drivers

Problem in traditional delivery: Drivers often have to interact with screens or apps while on the road, which is unsafe and distracting.

Voice solution: Using ElevenLabs’ high-quality text-to-speech (TTS) and speech synthesis, Alto.ai can speak instructions directly to drivers in natural, human-like voices, eliminating the need for screens.

Benefit: Drivers stay hands-free, eyes on the road, and fully focused on deliveries.

2. Conversational Agents for Real-Time Task Management

Dynamic task updates: Using ElevenLabs’ conversational agent capabilities, Alto.ai can handle complex dialogue with drivers:

“Next stop is delayed, adjust route.”

“Pickup location has changed, confirm availability.”

Adaptive responses: Agents can answer questions, clarify tasks, or provide additional instructions in natural language, making the system intuitive for drivers without prior training.

3. Integration into the Delivery Workflow

Dispatch communication: The conversational agent acts as a bridge between dispatchers and drivers, automatically translating real-time route optimizations and task updates into spoken instructions.

Context-awareness: The agent can understand driver context — e.g., location, remaining stops, traffic delays — and respond appropriately:

“You have 3 stops left; the fastest route is via Elm Street.”

Feedback collection: Drivers can give verbal feedback to the agent, which can be logged for route optimization and operational improvements.

4. How ElevenLabs Makes This Feasible

Natural voice quality: Ensures clarity and reduces cognitive load.

Multi-voice support: Different voices can be assigned for different instruction types (e.g., normal updates, alerts).

Low-latency streaming: Real-time TTS ensures instructions are delivered without delay, crucial for dynamic routing.

Conversational AI integration: ElevenLabs can be paired with AI agents (e.g., LLMs) to generate dynamic responses instead of pre-recorded prompts.

**The problem it solves**

About the Project

Logforms is an end-to-end AI-powered form builder that makes it easy to create, share, and analyze forms. Beyond traditional form builders, Logforms introduces live voice-to-text transcription, allowing users to answer open-ended questions effortlessly without typing.

Key Features:
	•	AI Form Generation – Instantly build forms with 14+ field types, customizable properties, and feature toggles.
	•	Voice-Powered Responses – Real-time transcription for text-based answers, making forms faster and more accessible.
	•	Drag-and-Drop Builder – Simple, intuitive editor with live preview.
	•	Responsive Design – Forms adapt seamlessly across all devices.
	•	Advanced Analytics – Summaries, insights, and response tracking.
	•	Customization Options – From animated backgrounds to granular element-level controls.
	•	Smart Autosave & State Management – Ensures no progress or data is lost.
	•	Advanced Validations – Robust checks to ensure accurate data collection


Who It’s For
	•	Everyday Users – Anyone who just wants to quickly create and share forms.
	•	SMBs – Small businesses that need branding, control over responses, and seamless data collection.
	•	Brands & Enterprises – Teams that require full customization, deep analytics, and advanced response management.

⸻

The Problems It Solves
	•	Form Building Made Simple: AI doesn’t just generate questions; it also suggests relevant customizations and allows you to toggle features on/off, making form creation faster and smarter.
	•	Better Data Collection: While choice-based questions (like MCQs) are easy, qualitative answers often become a barrier because typing is cumbersome. Logforms solves this with real-time voice transcription — users simply speak their answers, making it easier to capture richer insights.

**Challenges we ran into**

**1. State Synchronization Issues**
While building the project, the AI mistakenly wrapped two different top-level layouts with the same state provider responsible for managing and saving the builder state. This led to a critical synchronization problem: whenever the user made changes, the auto-save would trigger twice — once from each provider. The second save would overwrite the first, causing user changes to be lost. Debugging this was challenging, as the issue only appeared during the save cycle.

**2. Multiple Race Conditions**
During authentication implementation, I ran into race conditions caused by the frontend being slower than the backend. Several useEffect hooks were firing simultaneously and overwriting each other. As a result, opening any saved form would fail to load correctly on the first attempt — the data only appeared after refreshing the browser multiple times. To fix this, I refactored a significant portion of the code and introduced context hooks to properly manage data flow and synchronization.

**3. Duplicated Types Files**
The AI also generated a separate types file for almost every component, creating multiple sources of truth. This made it unclear which component was supposed to receive which props and parameters. I had to consolidate all of these into a single, unified types file to ensure consistency and maintainability.
