[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/connectr-59d8) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/tejashwini-h/ConnectR_DSATM) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-UDAYA%201.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://udaya-1-0.devfolio.co)

> community forum notes sharing platform

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Django](https://img.shields.io/badge/Django-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Natural language processing (NLP)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Natural%20language%20processing%20(NLP)-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Students often struggle to find well-organized and relevant study material. Notes are scattered across different platforms, shared informally, or difficult to search effectively. This leads to wasted time, limited access to quality resources, and duplication of effort. Our platform solves this problem by providing a centralized community-driven space where students can upload, explore, and filter notes easily. With AI-powered keyword extraction, it further enhances discoverability, making it easier for learners to quickly find the most relevant content for their studies.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the main challenges I faced was integrating AI into a traditional Django-based notes-sharing platform. Handling file uploads of different types (PDF, Word, PPT) and extracting meaningful keywords from them required exploring NLP libraries and making sure they worked smoothly with Django. I also ran into database issues when modifying models, especially while adding new fields like subject and semester, which required careful handling of migrations without losing existing data. Another challenge was designing the search and filtering functionality in a way that felt user-friendly but also scalable for future AI features like recommendations and summarization. These challenges helped me learn how to balance backend logic, AI integration, and frontend usability.

**AI in Education**

Our project fits into the AI in Education track by going beyond a simple notes-sharing platform and introducing intelligence into the way students access learning materials. Using AI-based keyword extraction, the system automatically generates tags from uploaded notes, making resources easier to search, filter, and discover without relying only on manual input. This reduces the effort for students, ensures relevant content is surfaced quickly, and lays the foundation for advanced features like personalized recommendations and AI-powered summarization in the future. By saving time and improving accessibility, our platform enhances the learning experience and demonstrates how AI can directly support education.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

When new students join a college, they step into a completely unfamiliar environment where access to the right information is often scattered, unclear, or delayed. The first and most common challenge they encounter is navigating the campus—identifying where different departments, classrooms, laboratories, libraries, and administrative offices are located. Without proper guidance, this often results in wasted time, unnecessary stress, and reduced confidence in exploring the campus freely. Another major difficulty lies in identifying and approaching faculty members. New students usually do not know who the faculty are, which subjects they handle, or how to reach out to them for academic or personal support. This gap in communication delays the process of building strong student–faculty relationships that are essential for academic success. Furthermore, students often miss important updates about ongoing and upcoming activities, such as examinations, cultural fests, workshops, and seminars, because there is no single, consolidated source of reliable information. Event schedules may be shared through notice boards, emails, or word-of-mouth, which can lead to confusion or incomplete awareness. In addition to academics and events, daily lifestyle needs such as food create another layer of uncertainty. Newcomers have little idea about what type of food is served in the canteen, the timing of meals, the nutritional value of the diet, or whether vegetarian and non-vegetarian options are available. All these issues combined make the initial college experience overwhelming and unstructured for students, leaving them in constant search for information rather than focusing on learning, socializing, and adapting to their new life.

**Challenges we ran into**

We felt demotivated at times, but we all cheered up because we knew it was a real problem that required fixing and we knew with this it can help change many lives of the students.

**AI First Campus Digitization for DSI**

We feel this is really required and it will help automate various tasks that saves time and energy, and also clears confusion, both teachers and students will benefit from this and will create a noticeable impact on the campus

### Skill-It
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/skillit-1db0) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/khailesh-kumar-sa/Skill-It) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HICR-lLrBRi02yujAvyCBbq1mKMpHppt) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/Tihb0RATAMY) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-TIC%20Pinnacle%20Hacks%20--%20Edition%201-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://tic-pinnacle-hacks-2025.devfolio.co)

> 3in1 AI powered peer to peer educational platform

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**Problem Statement:**
Current educational and career preparation tools often operate in silos. Students may take personality tests, attend career counseling, watch video tutorials, or practice interview questions individually. However, there is no unified ecosystem that allows learners to assess their interests, find mentorship through peer networks, and simultaneously train for interviews in a real-time, AI-supported setup. Furthermore, many learners, especially from non-metro regions, lack access to personalized guidance and affordable career navigation tools. The fragmented nature of current solutions leads to inefficient and inconsistent outcomes in skill-building and employability.The real problem is not that people lack ambition it’s that the system doesn’t support them affordably or efficiently

Today’s young people face 3 big problems

- First- they are confused, about what suits them.
- Second- they are stuck;they want to learn but can’t afford expensive confuses.
- Third- they are scared . Interviews feel overwhelming and they get nervous
****
**Proposed Solution:**
Skill It integrates three core modules into a single platform to offer a seamless experience:

**Skill Swap: **Users can list the skills they know and the skills they wish to learn. A matchmaking algorithm intelligently pairs them with suitable peer mentors or learners for mutual exchange. This live exchange model promotes engagement, collaboration, and community building.

**Career Test:** An AI-powered module presents users with a series of multiple choice questions (MCQs) designed to assess aptitude, personality, and interests. The responses are evaluated using a custom-trained Hugging Face model that maps patterns to recommended career fields such as software development, data science, cybersecurity, design, etc.

**Interview Trainer:** A voice-enabled AI tool built with React Voice simulates real interview environments. Users speak their responses, and the NLP engine analyzes tone, content, grammar, and confidence. Constructive feedback is generated to help users identify areas of improvement, making this a virtual mock interview coach.

This triad ensures that the learning journey is not just informative but interactive, personalized, and aligned with career goals.

**Credibility and Reliability check for those who swap skills:**
1) Built-in Quiz (Pre-screening)
When a user adds a skill to teach, Skill-IT gives them an AI-generated quiz to check their fundamentals.
Pass the threshold → approved status. Fail → redirect them to learning resources.

2) **Demo Video**
Require potential swappers to upload a 3–5 minute video explaining a topic from their chosen skill.
Manual (or an automated review process) assess relevancy, clarity, communication, and accuracy.
Bonus: AI auto-check via speech-to-text + keyword analysis to see if they actually used relevant concepts.

3) **Peer Reviews**
Once a session is over peers can review each other

4) **Tiered Swapper Levels (Gamification + Trust)**
Level 1: If learners wants just knowledge in a specific skill but not A-Z
Level 2: If learners wants complete course.
Level 3: If learner wants top level knowledge in the specific skills. (High peer ratings)
Levels visible to learners so they can choose trusted teachers.
We are also planning to proctore credibility quizes with full screen mode proctore to avoid plagarism of answers and potraying themselves as hugehr tier users.

5) **Progressive Trust System**
Trust score increases with:
Completed sessions
Positive reviews
Passed internal tests
Uploaded proof (certs, portfolio, demos)
Score directly affects profile visibility in search results.

**Encouragement to teach and learn via token rewarding system:**
- Users will get 10 tokens (for eg.) for successful completion of 1 session of teaching and 5 tokens (for eg.) for successful completion of 1 session of learning.
- And these credits can be used to access hig profiles Users who are expertise in the field.
- This helps to boost the encouragement of users to teach as well as learn.

**Future Scope:**

- **Future upgrades to Skill It will include:** Deaf-Friendly Video Courses: Adding real-time deaf transcription overlays (bottom-right corner) for course videos to improve accessibility.

- **Multilingual Support:** Support for regional languages to expand reach across India and eliminate language barriers.

- **Advanced Interview Simulations: **Introducing video-based mock interviews with AI feedback on tone, confidence, and posture.

- **Placement Integrations:** Collaborating with companies and placement cells for real-world job opportunities

- **Gamified Learning: **Adding badges, streaks, and challenge-based progress to boost engagement.

- **Skill Certificates:** AI-evaluated micro-certifications based on completed swaps or training modules

- **Addition of Non-technical skills:** Allowing users also to swap and learn non-technical skills like music, online learnable games and other skills.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest hurdles wasn’t just a technical bug, but a conceptual challenge. When we first started building Skill-It, the idea was much simpler—just a peer-to-peer skill sharing app. But as we worked on it and gained feedback, we realized the gaps: how do we validate whether someone can actually teach? How do we make the platform truly useful for career growth instead of just casual exchanges? These questions forced me to redefine and refine the project multiple times. For example, we added credibility checks like demo videos and certifications, and later integrated AI-driven career tests and interview training after seeing how many students struggle with direction and communication. So, the real bug was conceptual, and we overcame it by listening, iterating, and expanding—turning Skill-It into the 3-in-1 career growth ecosystem it is today.

### OrganIQ
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/organiq-d644) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/kalpithasv/pinnacle-hacks) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/pef3PE9quVo) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-TIC%20Pinnacle%20Hacks%20--%20Edition%201-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://tic-pinnacle-hacks-2025.devfolio.co)

> One click, complete analysis.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Analytics](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Analytics-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

This project helps early-stage startups, especially in the agriculture and rural innovation sector, quickly generate structured market research without the high costs and delays of traditional reports. By entering details like location, business model, land type, or target market, users can instantly receive tailored insights that save time, reduce guesswork, and make safer, data-backed decisions. Whether for founders validating an idea, investors assessing opportunities, or students learning business analysis, the tool provides export-ready PDF reports that make complex research fast, affordable, and shareable.

**Challenges we ran into**

One major challenge I ran into was dealing with authentication issues while connecting the frontend and backend APIs. At one point, the requests from the frontend kept failing with a 403 Forbidden – Invalid token error, which blocked the analysis generation flow. Debugging this took time because the issue wasn’t in the business logic but in how tokens were being passed and validated between the client and server. I overcame this by carefully tracing the request flow, adding logging, and verifying the token handling in both the backend routes and frontend API calls. Once I ensured proper token generation, storage, and inclusion in request headers, the issue was resolved, allowing secure and smooth communication across the system.

### Swasthya
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/swasthya-66da) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/cr3ativ3cod3r/swasthya/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-DSU%20DevHack%202.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://dsudevhack2.devfolio.co)

> GSV Enabled Federated Learning Platform

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

AI is widely used in healthcare today. However, with the rapid growth of AI models, the risk of data infringement also increases. Since medical data is highly sensitive, the risks are even more serious. AI models need to be trained efficiently without the need of using patient data directly. The system that has the ability to do this also need to be protected and secured against malicious attacks.

Swasthya provides a platform with Federated Learning (FL) enabled. FL doesn't require sharing data directly with the global server, thus preserving privacy. The platform is also protected by a semi novel Gradient Signature Verification system that flags and blocks any malicious attacks against the system. 

Thus the platform resolves all the problems discussed above and facilitates training efficient AI models that can save countless lives.

**Challenges we ran into**

The Gradient Signature Verification system we developed initially had this issue of blocking even the non-malicious clients. We understood that it was due to not giving enough warm up  periods for the FL system to learn from data. Additionally the penalizing term and initial threshold was too high that it even blocked realistic updates. We understood this and resolved the bugs.

> BetaPilot

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Product Managers and development teams often face significant challenges when organizing beta tests for their products. Key issues include:

- **Time-consuming recruitment** of qualified beta testers  
- **Complex coordination** of test schedules and communications  
- **Difficulty consolidating and interpreting** vast amounts of raw feedback  
- **Lack of real-time insights** to make quick, data-driven decisions  
- **Manual, error-prone processes** that delay product improvements  

**PilotBeta** solves these problems by providing an all-in-one SaaS platform that:

- Automates recruitment and management of beta testers, reducing manual effort and accelerating onboarding  
- Streamlines scheduling to coordinate tests efficiently without confusion  
- Collects, organizes, and analyzes tester feedback in real time, turning raw data into actionable product insights  
- Provides intuitive dashboards for monitoring progress, spotting issues, and optimizing the beta process  
- Helps teams iterate faster and launch higher-quality products with confidence and less risk  

In short, PilotBeta makes managing beta tests easier, faster, and smarter — saving time and ensuring better product outcomes.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. GitHub Push (No Pull)
Currently, Rocket.new supports pushing code to GitHub but not pulling it back in.

Pain Point: I can push code to GitHub, edit it in an IDE, but then I’m forced to copy-paste changes back into Rocket.new. This workflow is inefficient and prone to errors.

Ideal Flow: Build UI in Rocket.new → debug/refactor externally → pull fixed code back in seamlessly → continue building new UI or features.

Workaround Tried: I’ve been using Windsurf as my AI coding partner for better control and debugging logic.

2. Context Handling
Sometimes Rocket.new forgets prior context or unexpectedly rewrites workflows.

Solution: Improve context memory by focusing on micro-changes and strengthening prompt handling. Tools like ChatGPT or Copilot helped stabilize workflows.

3. Out-of-the-Box Login Integrations
Configuring Resend for login integrations was more challenging than expected.

Workaround: I leaned on ChatGPT and Copilot to figure out missing steps and resolve setup issues.


4. Token Consumption Optimization
Minor changes or standard components (like login pages or dashboards) consume a large number of tokens in rocket.new.

Solution: I requested a coupon code (thanks to ProductFolks for delivering!).
Also  To optimize further, enable lighter token usage for common components paired Rocket.new with tools like Copilot and Windsurf to efficiently build and troubleshoot apps.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

# What Problem Does ATMOS Solve?

ATMOS addresses the **"Cultural Intelligence Blindness"** that plagues Indian organizations - the inability to understand, measure, and proactively manage the real cultural dynamics happening within their workforce.

## The Core Problem

Most organizations operate with a **massive blind spot**: they have sophisticated systems to track financial performance, operational metrics, and business outcomes, but lack any meaningful real-time visibility into the cultural and behavioral patterns that ultimately drive all business results.

## Specific Problems ATMOS Solves

### 1. **The Trust-Information Paradox**
- **Problem**: Organizations need honest feedback about cultural issues to improve, but employees can't provide it safely through existing channels due to fear of retaliation
- **ATMOS Solution**: Anonymous multi-channel reporting and AI intermediaries that create psychological safety for authentic feedback

### 2. **Reactive vs. Proactive Cultural Management**
- **Problem**: Organizations only discover cultural problems when they manifest as crises (harassment lawsuits, mass resignations, public scandals)
- **ATMOS Solution**: Predictive analytics that detect toxic patterns and cultural risks before they escalate into costly organizational disasters

### 3. **Leadership-Reality Disconnect**
- **Problem**: Leadership makes cultural decisions based on assumptions, outdated annual surveys, or rose-colored reports from middle management
- **ATMOS Solution**: Real-time culture pulse data and AI-driven insights that show leaders what's actually happening versus what they think is happening

### 4. **Cultural Risk as an Unmeasured Business Risk**
- **Problem**: While organizations measure financial, operational, and compliance risks, cultural toxicity remains unmeasured despite being a major driver of attrition, productivity loss, and legal liability
- **ATMOS Solution**: Transforms culture from abstract concept to measurable business metric with clear ROI implications

### 5. **Ineffective Cultural Intervention**
- **Problem**: When cultural issues are identified, organizations lack data-driven guidance on what interventions actually work for their specific context
- **ATMOS Solution**: AI-powered coaching recommendations and benchmarking that provide actionable, contextual solutions rather than generic HR responses

## Why This Matters for Indian Organizations

Indian organizations face unique cultural complexity due to hierarchical structures, diverse workforce demographics, and rapid growth. ATMOS specifically addresses the Indian context where:
- Traditional hierarchy suppresses upward feedback
- Cultural issues often go unreported until they explode
- Rapid scaling creates cultural fragmentation
- ESG and DEI compliance is becoming business-critical

 ********The Bottom Line********

ATMOS solves the problem of **cultural management operating in the dark**. It transforms organizational culture from something that "just happens" to something that is continuously monitored, proactively managed, and strategically optimized - just like any other critical business function.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Product Management Challenges**
A key challenge is prioritizing the feature list. Since the project is more of a platform than a single product, it's difficult to prioritize feature sets while ensuring that all user profiles derive value. The goal is to build a platform that encourages widespread adoption and creates strong network effects, which depends on delivering value to different user segments simultaneously.

**Tooling Challenges**
One significant challenge is maintaining design consistency with the previous version of the product; the design language must remain similar. Additionally, there are multiple tools available, and understanding which tool is appropriate for a specific task is a persistent difficulty.

> Tech events made simple, all in one place.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Tech undergrads and new grads often have trouble finding events they'd like to attend.  They either hear about events too late, or not at all. Information is scattered across Discord servers, on-campus, social media, or group chats, and it’s easy to miss opportunities to network, learn, or showcase involvement. 

Platform gives students a single place to discover, share, and keep track of events. They can see what’s coming up, filter by interest, and even get recommendations based on what they’ve engaged with before. Instead of chasing information across different channels, students can focus on showing up and getting value out of the events that matter most to them.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the trickiest parts was setting up the database so that the ‘interested’ status stayed consistent everywhere an event appeared.  It took a lot of back and forth with Supabase queries and checking my schema until I finally got it synced.  I also ran into issues handling the temporary authorization Supabase grants during password resets.

I discovered some quirks with Windsurf along the way too.  For example, if you roll back a step, it forces you to auto-accept previous changes - which was unexpected.  And when Cascade planned a solution in chat before implementing, it didn’t actually save any time or prevent the same issues from coming up again once I switched to agent.  It still had to look at the files in context, plan, and ended up running into the same errors it did in chat.

**What people can use it for:**

- Reduces staff interruptions: Clinical staff can focus on patient care instead of answering phones
- Ensures consistency: Same accurate information provided every time, reducing miscommunication

**Challenges we ran into**

**Windows Development Environment Issues:**

- PowerShell execution policy blocked npm commands
- Solution: Used Command Prompt instead of PowerShell and proper environment variable setup

**Iterative Testing and Debugging:**

- Chatbot responses weren't working correctly at first - some questions weren't being recognized, bullet points displayed horizontally instead of vertically, "yes" responses weren't triggering appointment information
- Solution: Constant testing throughout development, debugging each response type, fixing display issues one by one, and refining the conversation flow until it actually worked as intended

**Deployment Configuration:**

- GitHub Pages failed due to Jekyll processing node_modules folder in telegram-bot directory
- Railway deployment initially failed because wrong root directory (deployed from main folder instead of telegram-bot subfolder)
- Solution: Added .nojekyll file to bypass Jekyll, configured Railway root directory properly

**Security Best Practices:**

- Accidentally committed bot token in .env.example file, detected by GitGuardian
- Solution: Implemented proper environment variable management, removed hardcoded tokens from public repository

**Cross-Platform Logic Consistency:**

- Ensuring same conversation flow worked identically on web interface and Telegram
- Solution: Extracted shared response logic into reusable functions, maintained consistent state management across platforms

**Strategic Development Decisions:**

- Balancing feature complexity with weekend timeline constraints
- Choosing optimal deployment platforms and architecture approaches
- Solution: Used Claude AI for strategic guidance, architecture planning, and real-time problem-solving throughout development process

> simplified cli

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Of course. Here is a breakdown of the problems Autopilot solves and how it makes existing tasks easier and safer for users.

### The Core Problem: The Complexity and Fragmentation of the Modern Command-Line

For developers, system administrators, and even power users, the command-line interface (CLI), while powerful, presents significant challenges:

*   **High Cognitive Load:** Users must memorize a vast and ever-growing number of commands, flags, and syntax variations across different operating systems (like Linux distributions and macOS) and tools.
*   **Risk of Human Error:** A small typo or incorrect command can lead to misconfigured systems, data loss, or security vulnerabilities. Executing complex, multi-step operations manually increases this risk exponentially.
*   **Time-Consuming and Repetitive Tasks:** Setting up a new development environment, managing system updates, or organizing files often involves a tedious sequence of commands that consumes valuable time and diverts focus from more critical work.

---

### How Autopilot (AP) Makes Tasks Easier, Safer, and More Efficient

Autopilot acts as an intelligent abstraction layer over the command line, translating simple, natural language instructions into precise and safe system operations.

#### 1. It Radically Simplifies Complex Operations

Instead of chaining multiple commands, you can state your goal in one sentence.

*   **Before AP:**
    ```bash
    # Setting up a basic web server on Ubuntu
    sudo apt update
    sudo apt install nginx -y
    sudo ufw allow 'Nginx HTTP'
    sudo systemctl start nginx
    sudo systemctl enable nginx
    ```

*   **With AP:**
    ```bash
    ap set up nginx and configure firewall
    ```

#### 2. It Eliminates Cross-Platform Inconsistencies

AP automatically detects the underlying operating system and its specific tooling, allowing you to use the same command everywhere.

*   **Before AP:**
    *   On macOS: `brew install git && brew install --cask visual-studio-code`
    *   On Ubuntu: `sudo apt-get install git && sudo snap install code --classic`

*   **With AP (on any platform):**
    ```bash
    ap install git and visual studio code
    ```

#### 3. It Makes System Interaction Safer

AP adds a layer of intelligence and confirmation to prevent common mistakes, especially with potentially destructive commands.

*   **Built-in Safeguards:** For operations requiring root privileges (sudo), AP will first explain *why* elevated permissions are necessary before prompting the user for confirmation. This prevents accidental execution of harmful commands.
*   **Progressive Error Handling:** If a command fails, AP doesn't just give up. It automatically retries, analyzes the error using AI, and attempts intelligent alternative solutions. This is much safer and more effective than a user blindly re-running a failed command.
*   **Conservative by Design:** AP is built with a "do no harm" philosophy, prioritizing system stability and data integrity.

#### 4. It Accelerates Development and DevOps Workflows

AP is a powerful productivity tool for developers, automating common and repetitive tasks.

*   **One-Command Environment Setup:**
    ```bash
    # Instead of a long script, just say what you need
    ap set up a react development environment with typescript
    ```
*   **Automated Project Scaffolding:**
    ```bash
    ap create a new node project and initialize git
    ```
*   **Complex Task Orchestration:**
    ```bash
    ap use my resume at ~/resume.pdf to create a portfolio website and deploy it
    ```

#### 5. It Democratizes the Command-Line

AP lowers the barrier to entry, making powerful system administration capabilities accessible to a broader audience.

*   **Natural Language is the New Syntax:** Users no longer need to be command-line experts to perform advanced tasks. If you can describe what you want, AP can likely do it.
*   **Personalized and Context-Aware:** AP learns your preferences and system configuration over time, making its suggestions and actions more relevant and efficient with each use.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenge: The AI Was Too Fast for Its Own Good

My biggest challenge was that the AI would plan tasks perfectly but execute them too quickly. For example, if you asked it to create a new project and open it, the system would fire off all the commands at once. It would try to enter the new project folder before the creation command was finished, causing the entire task to crash simply because the folder didn't exist yet. This created a domino effect of errors, and the AI, blind to the timing issue, would offer unhelpful solutions.
Solution: Teaching the AI Patience with a "Done Check"

The solution was to teach the AI to not just think about what to do, but also how to know when it's done. I rebuilt the execution engine to work like a checklist. Now, after Autopilot runs a command like create a new project, it pauses. It then performs a quick check: "Does the project folder actually exist now?" Only after confirming that the step was truly and completely successful does it move on to the next one. This simple change transformed Autopilot from a fast but fragile tool into a patient and reliable assistant that can handle complex, multi-step tasks without failing.

**All Registered Participants**

While an AI IDE like Windsurf excels at writing, debugging, and reviewing code, developers still constantly need to drop out of their editor to perform critical tasks in the terminal:

    Installing a new system dependency (brew install redis).

    Setting up a project environment (python -m venv venv).

    Running system updates (sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade).

    Configuring local infrastructure like databases or firewalls.

This context-switching is a major productivity killer.

By integrating Autopilot directly into the Windsurf IDE, you create a truly seamless, end-to-end development workflow. A developer could simply open a terminal panel within Windsurf and use natural language to manage their entire environment without ever leaving the editor.

In this integrated vision:

    Windsurf helps you write the code.

    Autopilot helps you manage the world the code runs in.

A developer could be working on a Python application in Windsurf and, without missing a beat, type ap install postgresql and start the service. Autopilot would handle the platform-specific commands in the background, allowing the developer to remain focused on their primary task: building great software. This synergy directly fulfills Windsurf's mission to create an IDE that removes friction and supercharges productivity.

![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-333333?style=flat-square) ![Git](https://img.shields.io/badge/Git-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square) ![HuggingFace](https://img.shields.io/badge/HuggingFace-333333?style=flat-square) ![langchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/langchain-333333?style=flat-square) ![FAISS](https://img.shields.io/badge/FAISS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Primary Problem:
The Freedom of Legal Information: Indian citizens have difficulties in accessing accurate and updated information regarding Indian laws and provisions of the constitution.
Language Barrier: Legal documents are complex, not easily understandable for the common citizen
Time-Consuming Research: Manually searching through long legal documents (constitution, BNS) would take much time.
Accuracy of Information: Obtaining useful information on legal matters from various sources and from the right sources may sometimes be inconsistent.
Specific Use Cases:
Citizens looking for a quick answer on a particular topic related to their rights and/or their obligations toward the law
Students studying Indian law and the Indian constitution
Lawyers who need to refer to specific provisions quickly
Businessmen for knowing about compliance issues
The general public searches for a simple explanation to very complicated legal things

**Challenges we ran into**

Technical Challenges:
Model Deprecation Issues
Groq kept decommissioning the various Groq models (llama3-8b-8192, llama3-70b-8192)
Had to keep updating to the latest model (llama-3.3-70b-versatile)
LangChain API Changes
load_qa_chain and .run() got deprecated
Had to move on to create_stuff_documents_chain and .invoke()
Infinite Loop Problems
Agent executor was stuck in loops
Had to bring in timeouts, iteration limits, and fallback mechanisms
Performance Issues
Very high processing times with inefficient agent configurations
Optimization with appropriate timeouts and execution limits was needed
Integration Challenges:
Multiple LLM Providers
Trade-off between Groq (cloud) and OLLAMA (local) options
Handling of various API configurations, timeouts
PDF Processing
Large legal documents (Constitution, BNS) required efficient chunking
Vector database creation and management for FAISS indices

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/inclusiviq-3fdc) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://inclusiviq.lovable.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://vimeo.com/1116521744?share=copy) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-mosAIc:%20AI%20in%20action%20with%20The%20Product%20Folks-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mosaicbytpf.devfolio.co)

> Intelligent Access, Accelerated Performance.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

## The Problem InclusivIQ Solves

- Accessibility standards like WCAG, ADA, and Section 504 are complex and often misunderstood by development teams.
- Manual audits for accessibility and page performance are time-consuming, producing overwhelming lists without clear prioritization.
- Existing tools lack the ability to simultaneously analyze accessibility and page speed, creating fragmented workflows.
- Teams struggle with false positives and irrelevant issues, leading to wasted effort.
- Continuous monitoring for regressions is difficult without proper integration in development pipelines.
- SMEs need secure, easy-to-use solutions that integrate well with their tools and workflows.

***

## How InclusivIQ Makes It Easier and Safer

- Provides automated, AI-powered dual audits that simultaneously check accessibility compliance and page speed performance.
- Uses intelligent, impact-driven prioritization to highlight the most critical issues first.
- Offers actionable, code-level fixes with clear explanations to empower teams to resolve issues quickly.
- Integrates seamlessly with CI/CD pipelines and collaboration tools like Jira and GitHub.
- Provides unified dashboards and exportable reports for easy stakeholder communication.
- Ensures enterprise-grade security and privacy to build trust and meet regulations.

***

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges I Ran Into

### 1. Differentiating Accessibility vs. Performance Issues  
- Initially, the system mixed accessibility (WCAG, ADA) issues with page speed insights.  
- This caused confusion for users and reduced trust in the audit results.  
- To fix this, we implemented strict separation of audit data streams and reporting sections.

### 2. False Positives and Context Awareness  
- Early AI models flagged many false positives, overwhelming developers.  
- We trained the AI to better understand page context and reduce irrelevant warnings.  
- Iterative testing and real-user feedback helped improve accuracy.

### 3. Performance & Scalability Constraints  
- Running dual audits with AI in real time was resource-intensive, causing delays.  
- We optimized backend architecture with caching, asynchronous processing, and cloud scaling.

### 4. Integrating Seamlessly Into User Workflows  
- Users needed easy export and integration with tools like Jira and GitHub.  
- We developed API integrations and collaboration features to support agile processes.

### 5. User Experience vs. Security Balance  
- Ensuring enterprise-grade data security while keeping sign-up and usage friction low was tricky.  
- We iterated on authentication flows to balance trust with smooth user onboarding.

**Top 100 Participants**

InclusivIQ makes digital experiences truly lovable by empowering teams to build accessible, high-performing websites and apps that everyone can enjoy. Our AI-driven platform prioritizes fixes that have the biggest real-world impact, helping developers create products people love to use. By transforming complex accessibility challenges into user-centered, actionable insights, InclusivIQ fits perfectly in the Lovable track—enabling technology that is approachable, inclusive, and enjoyable for all.

> Personal AI Trainer - anytime, anywhere.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Many people who workout struggle with maintaining proper posture and form, which can lead to injuries, especially people doing workout at home. Additionally, people trying to lose weight or build fitness often need guidance and encouragement to stay consistent. 
Everyone needs an personalised work out plan specifically for them.

 FormWhisper solves these problems by providing a virtual AI fitness assistant that:
- Monitors your exercise in real-time and gives verbal feedback to ensure correct posture and form, helping prevent injuries.
- Offers motivation and encouragement to help users stay consistent and achieve their fitness goals.
- Assess your fitness level and injuries to create a personalised workout plan for you.

With FormWhisper, anyone—whether a beginner or experienced fitness enthusiast—can work out safely, efficiently, and confidently from home or anywhere.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest hurdles I faced was integrating the voice assistant into the project. I used LiveKit to build the assistant, but I wanted it to do more than just respond to user prompts. Specifically, I needed to send cues and information from my frontend code so the assistant could proactively give feedback to the user, without waiting for input.

At first, this was tricky — even ChatGPT was of not much help.

To overcome this, I went through LiveKit documentation and explored the examples in detail. By carefully studying the APIs and experimenting, I figured out how to pass cevents/messages from the frontend to the assistant pipeline. This allowed the assistant to speak up at the right moments and guide the workout experience seamlessly.

**Top 100 Participants**

We used Lovable to create the website and frontend. It allowed us to quickly generate a clean, multi-page React framework, which we then customized for our AI fitness assistant.

**All Registered Participants**

We used Windsurf for vibecoding the entire project, which streamlined our development workflow.

**All Registered Participants.**

We used ElevenLabs for Text-to-Speech, which gave our AI fitness assistant a natural and engaging voice. This allowed the assistant to provide real-time verbal feedback to users during workouts, making the experience more interactive and human-like.

**The problem it solves**

**The Problem It Solves**

Managing events — whether college fests, workshops, conferences, concerts, or seminars — can be time-consuming and unorganized when done manually. Traditional event management often involves:

* Multiple registrations handled through paper forms or scattered Google Sheets

* Payment tracking issues due to offline transactions

* Lack of a centralized platform to browse, register, and manage events

* Difficulty for organizers to update event details and communicate with participants

* Users struggling to keep track of upcoming events and their registrations

* Event Sync solves all these problems by providing a centralized, secure, and automated platform where:

* Organizers can create, edit, and manage events easily

* Users can browse, register, and pay for events online

* Participants get a personal dashboard to track registrations & payments

* Integrated payment processing ensures quick and safe transactions

* Everything is responsive and accessible on mobile & desktop

* With Event Sync, the entire event management process becomes faster, safer, and more efficient, saving time for both organizers and participants.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into
Dual Backend Architecture Confusion
The Problem:
Initially built with Node.js/Express, then added Python/FastAPI for AI features, creating two separate backends that confused environment configuration.

The Hurdle:
Node.js backend expected .env file

Python backend expected config.env file

API keys weren't loading properly

Different port configurations (5000 vs 8000)

How I Solved It:
Created separate environment files for each backend and implemented fallback configuration loading in Python to handle both file types.

🤖 AI Model Integration Complexity
The Problem:
Integrating multiple AI services (OpenAI GPT-4, Google Vision, Clarifai, Azure) with different response formats and rate limits.

The Hurdle:
Each AI service had different authentication methods

Inconsistent response structures

Rate limiting across multiple providers

Fallback mechanisms when services failed

How I Solved It:
Built a unified AI service layer with standardized response formatting and implemented graceful fallbacks when primary services were unavailable.

📸 Image Upload & Processing Pipeline
The Problem:
Handling image uploads for skin analysis while maintaining performance and security.

The Hurdle:
Large image file sizes affecting performance

Security concerns with user uploads

Multiple image formats to support

Real-time processing expectations

How I Solved It:
Implemented image compression, validation middleware, and asynchronous processing with progress indicators to maintain smooth user experience.

🔄 Frontend-Backend Communication
The Problem:
CORS issues and API endpoint mismatches between React frontend and dual backend setup.

The Hurdle:
Frontend couldn't connect to backend APIs

Authentication token handling across different ports

Inconsistent API response formats

Development vs production environment differences

How I Solved It:
Standardized API response formats, implemented proper CORS configuration, and created environment-specific API base URLs.

📊 Database Schema Evolution
The Problem:
Started with MongoDB for Node.js backend, then needed SQLite for Python backend, causing data inconsistency.

The Hurdle:
Two different database systems

Schema synchronization issues

Data migration between systems

Maintaining data integrity

How I Solved It:
Created database abstraction layers and seed scripts that work with both systems, ensuring consistent data structure across backends.

🎯 AI Prompt Engineering
The Problem:
Getting consistent, accurate skincare recommendations from AI models required extensive prompt optimization.

The Hurdle:
AI responses were too generic

Inconsistent recommendation quality

Balancing detailed analysis with response time

Ensuring medically safe advice

How I Solved It:
Developed structured prompt templates with specific skincare expertise context and implemented response validation to ensure quality recommendations.

Each challenge taught me the importance of planning system architecture early and building with scalability in mind from the start.

> Smarter Weather, Cleaner Air, Safer You

![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

ClimaSafe is more than just a weather app. It’s a personal safety companion that helps you make smarter choices about your daily activities by combining real-time weather updates, air quality index (AQI), and AI-powered forecasts.

👨‍👩‍👧 What people can use it for

Planning Outdoor Activities

Going for a jog, cycling, or a walk? ClimaSafe checks the air quality and weather before you step outside.

Health Protection

Sensitive groups like children, elderly, or asthma patients get timely warnings if the air is unsafe.

Daily Commute Safety

Know in advance if pollution spikes or sudden rain might affect your travel.

Smart Event Planning

Organizers and schools can use it to schedule events safely and avoid cancellations.

⚡ How it makes life easier & safer

Instead of checking multiple apps for weather, pollution, and health tips, you get everything in one simple dashboard.

AI-generated 5-day forecast adds a predictive edge, so you’re never caught off-guard.

Activity advisories turn complex data into simple actions → “Safe to run”, “Better to stay indoors”, or “Carry a mask today”.

Helps build a culture of awareness and prevention rather than reacting too late.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest hurdles we ran into was with the forecast graphs.
At first, our 5-day forecast chart showed a straight flat line — which didn’t make sense for real weather data. The issue was that our machine learning model was trained on very limited synthetic data, so the predictions were coming out almost constant.

✅ How We Solved It

Instead of giving up, we:

Diagnosed the problem → realized the model was not dynamic enough.

Tweaked the model → added variations and noise to make the predictions more realistic.

Validated with visuals → once we updated the logic, the chart became dynamic and actually useful for showing trends.

This was a great reminder that in hackathon projects, sometimes the solution is not just technical accuracy, but also user experience — people should be able to see and understand the forecast, even with limited data.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/autvid-ai-0d9a) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ArtExists/AutVid-AI) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/TEvYFpwAPeI) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co)

> Video emotion detection for Autistic Individuals

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Whisper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Whisper-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square) ![Unsloth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Unsloth-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

This project, the Real-Time Multi-Modal Emotion Analyzer, solves the problem of understanding complex emotional cues in social interactions, particularly for individuals who find this challenging.

It acts as a "social interpreter," providing a combined analysis of facial expressions, vocal tone, and spoken language in real-time. This helps users, especially those with conditions like autism, to get a clear, concise summary of the emotional context, which can be difficult to interpret from non-verbal and verbal cues alone.

In essence, it simplifies a complex social interaction into an easy-to-understand emotional summary, bridging a gap in communication and social understanding.

**Challenges we ran into**

A significant hurdle in developing the "Real-Time Multi-Modal Emotion Analyzer" was the performance of the large language model (LLM), specifically Meta's Llama 3. The original plan was to use Unsloth for fast, efficient summarization on a GPU. However, a major issue arose: Unsloth is designed to accelerate training and inference on GPUs, and it simply did not function correctly or provide any speed benefits without a GPU. This meant that running Llama 3 on a CPU was incredibly slow, making the "real-time" aspect of the project unfeasible. The summarization step would take several seconds, disrupting the smooth flow of the application.

The initial thought was to switch to a smaller, more CPU-friendly model like BERT, which is known for its efficiency on standard hardware. However, this would have meant sacrificing the nuanced, human-like summarization capabilities of a more powerful model like Llama 3.

### DisasterIQ
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/disasteriq-af62) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/PratyushKumar43/Disaster) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://disasterapp-ten.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co)

> #SavePeopleandSaveLives

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![scikit-learn](https://img.shields.io/badge/scikit--learn-333333?style=flat-square) ![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![GeoJSON](https://img.shields.io/badge/GeoJSON-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Natural disasters like **forest fires, floods, cyclones, and droughts** are becoming increasingly frequent due to climate change. The biggest issues faced during such disasters are:  
- Lack of **early warning systems** for communities.  
- Difficulty in **predicting risks** before they escalate.  
- **Slow or mismanaged response** from authorities due to limited real-time insights.  
- **Communication gaps** between affected people, NGOs, and government agencies.  

Our project **Disaster App (Agnirodhak)** directly addresses these challenges:  
- 🌍 **Real-time Data Integration** – Uses **Google Earth Engine** to pull satellite imagery and geospatial data for environmental monitoring.  
- 🔥 **AI-Powered Fire Risk Prediction** – A trained ML model (joblib) predicts the likelihood of wildfires, helping authorities act before they spread.  
- 📍 **Location-Based Alerts** – Users receive disaster notifications and resources based on their GPS location, making it highly relevant and life-saving.  
- 🗺️ **Interactive Maps & Dashboards** – Authorities and NGOs can visualize disaster-prone zones and plan resource allocation more effectively.  
- 👨‍👩‍👧 **Community-Centric** – Ordinary citizens can access reliable safety guidelines, evacuation routes, and emergency contacts in one place.  

👉 In short, the platform makes disaster management **smarter, faster, and safer** by turning raw data into **actionable insights**.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building this project came with several technical and non-technical hurdles:  

1. **Google Earth Engine Authentication**  
   - Problem: Earth Engine integration in a **Next.js + Express.js** setup was complex because service account credentials (credentials.json) caused errors when bundled in frontend environments.  
   - Solution: We moved authentication to the **backend server**, securely loaded credentials via environment variables, and exposed only safe APIs to the frontend.  

2. **Machine Learning Model Integration**  
   - Problem: Serving a **fire-risk ML model** (rf.joblib) inside the backend was difficult due to dependency mismatches between Python (scikit-learn) and Node.js.  
   - Solution: We created a **separate FastAPI microservice** for ML inference, exposed prediction endpoints, and connected it seamlessly with the frontend dashboard.  

3. **Deployment Issues**  
   - Problem: Hosting on **Vercel (frontend)** and **Render/Railway (backend)** initially led to **CORS conflicts**, broken API routes, and environment variable misconfigurations.  
   - Solution: We debugged step by step — added proper CORS headers, separated staging and production environments, and ensured secure handling of API keys.  

4. **Large Data Processing**  
   - Problem: Working with **massive geospatial datasets** slowed down queries and map rendering.  
   - Solution: We optimized with **server-side caching, lazy loading, and lightweight queries** to make the app responsive even under heavy data.  

5. **Team Collaboration**  
   - Problem: Since this was a collaborative project, syncing code between multiple GitHub repositories (frontend + backend + ML) sometimes caused merge conflicts.  
   - Solution: We enforced **branch-based workflows**, frequent pull requests, and clear GitHub issues to streamline collaboration.  

These challenges helped us grow not just technically but also in **problem-solving, teamwork, and system design**. The final system is more **robust, scalable, and production-ready** because of the hurdles we overcame.

**Best Use of Akash**

Our project leverages **Akash Network** to deploy critical components of the disaster management platform in a decentralized, cost-effective, and highly scalable way.  

- 🌍 **Resilient Infrastructure**: Disaster response systems must remain available even when centralized cloud providers fail or local servers go down. By deploying on Akash, we ensure a **fault-tolerant, globally distributed backend** that stays accessible during emergencies.  

- ⚡ **AI & Geospatial Workloads**: The **fire-risk prediction model** (joblib + FastAPI) and **Google Earth Engine data pipelines** require significant compute resources. Akash provides a flexible environment for hosting ML inference services and geospatial APIs without being locked into expensive centralized cloud providers.  

- 🔒 **Security & Privacy**: Akash’s decentralized architecture allows us to deploy sensitive disaster-related data services with **greater transparency and control**, reducing single points of failure.  

- 💰 **Cost Efficiency**: Since Akash lowers hosting costs, we can **scale predictions, alerts, and dashboards to more regions** (beyond a hackathon demo) without huge expenses — making it realistic for governments, NGOs, and communities to adopt.  

In short, Akash enables us to build a **scalable, secure, and globally available disaster management platform** that aligns perfectly with the track’s vision of decentralization and real-world social impact.

> find leads across platforms in a minute

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![reddit](https://img.shields.io/badge/reddit-333333?style=flat-square) ![RestAPIs](https://img.shields.io/badge/RestAPIs-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Finding business leads on Reddit is currently manual, time-consuming, and scattered across multiple subreddits.

Many potential customers openly discuss their problems on Reddit, but businesses miss them because there’s no streamlined way to discover these opportunities.

Leadly automates this by scanning, filtering, and analyzing posts/comments, surfacing high-intent leads that match your service.

Saves hours of manual searching, enabling businesses, freelancers, and agencies to scale outreach efficiently.

Future scope

Multi-platform support: Extend beyond Reddit to Twitter/X, LinkedIn, and Discord communities.

Advanced filtering: Add sentiment analysis and urgency scoring to prioritize high-value leads.

Notifications & integrations: Push leads directly to Slack, email, or CRM tools like HubSpot or Salesforce.

Self-serve dashboard: A web app where businesses can set service descriptions, view leads, and customize scans.

Marketplace model: Let freelancers/companies subscribe to niche lead streams.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/7d4af37f9e08437880f3c0ae8f32202d/5cbb0337-28b5-4bac-b992-fff7ab9d45dd.png)

**Challenges we ran into**

Reddit API restrictions: Handling rate limits with Async PRAW and ensuring efficient extraction.

AI prompt engineering: Making Gemini AI correctly identify leads (avoiding false positives/irrelevant results).

**The problem it solves**

Most cybersecurity training today feels boring, expensive, or overly theoretical, leaving learners without the chance to actually practice in safe, real-world scenarios. Our platform changes that by turning cybersecurity education into an interactive, gamified experience where people can safely face simulated attacks, build defense strategies, and learn by doing. It makes learning both fun and practical—whether you’re a student starting out, a professional brushing up skills, or just curious about staying safe online—while ensuring that complex concepts become easier, safer, and far more engaging.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges we faced was bringing the web platform and compute engines together in a way that felt smooth for users. At first, the system would break or slow down when trying to run heavier tasks, making it hard to deliver real-time labs. Another hurdle was creating safe, isolated environments for attack simulations—we needed a setup where users could practice without risking actual systems. After struggling with this, we moved to a **dockerized lab environment**, which gave us both safety and scalability. It took a lot of trial and error to get the integration right, but once we did, it made the platform much more stable, secure, and user-friendly.

**Vultr Cloud Deployment Track**

We use **Vultr Cloud virtual machines** to build safe and realistic cyber labs where learners can practice real-world attack and defense scenarios. Each lab is cloud-based, fully isolated, and scalable, giving the feel of working in an actual company network. By combining offensive exercises, defensive strategies, and gamified challenges, we make cybersecurity training engaging, hands-on, and practical for industry readiness.

**Education**

We have designed cyber threat attack simulations that are safe, interactive, and gamified, making learning both engaging and practical. The hands-on approach helps users understand real-world threats in an informative way while keeping them motivated and interested throughout the experience.

**Open Innovation**

We believe this fits the Open Innovation track because it combines cybersecurity, gamification, and cloud-based labs in a way that can be adapted for multiple use cases beyond just training. The platform encourages collaboration, experimentation, and knowledge sharing, making it open for integration with new technologies, ideas, and real-world scenarios while staying accessible to learners, educators, and organizations alike.

### EduLearn Platform
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/edulearn-platform-b44b) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Rutwik8257/status-app) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-StatusCode%202-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://statuscode-2.devfolio.co)

> Experience Science Beyond the Classroom

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MySQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/MySQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Many students face challenges in accessing quality, practical education beyond traditional subjects. Physical limitations, cost barriers, and lack of resources often restrict opportunities for experiential learning in science, financial literacy, and general knowledge. Moreover, important life skills such as managing personal finance, understanding civics, and developing problem-solving abilities are sometimes overlooked or taught in abstract, non-engaging ways.

How This Platform Helps
Comprehensive Learning Hub: Beyond virtual labs, the platform offers interactive lessons on financial literacy, general knowledge, and essential life skills that empower students to navigate real-world challenges confidently.

Practical and Relevant Education: Provides hands-on, scenario-based learning experiences in finance, such as budgeting and saving, alongside scientific experiments to foster well-rounded development.

Accessible Anytime, Anywhere: Eliminates barriers of physical location, allowing students to learn complex subjects and practical skills at their own pace, whether at home or in the classroom.

Safe and Engaging Environment: Through interactive tools like drag-and-drop labs and simulations, students engage actively with material, which enhances retention and deep understanding without any risk.

Cost-Effective and Scalable: Reduces dependency on costly real-world materials or instructors for certain topics, making high-quality education more affordable and deliverable to larger audiences.

Empowers Critical Thinking and Decision-Making: By simulating both scientific and financial decision scenarios, students develop critical reasoning skills vital for academic success and practical life.

Supports Remote and Hybrid Learning: Ideal for distance education needs, bridging gaps caused by remote learning and enabling continuous skill-building regardless of circumstances.

This all-in-one learning platform transforms how students acquire scientific knowledge, financial literacy, and general life skills—making education more practical, engaging, and accessible for the challenges of today and tomorrow.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building this educational platform, I faced a few significant challenges:

Keeping the Frontend and Backend in Sync:
It was often tricky to make sure that any changes on the frontend, like saving experiments or updating lesson progress, were accurately reflected on the backend and vice versa. Sometimes data wouldn’t update immediately, which could confuse users.
How I Got Over It: I focused on improving the API communication and added WebSocket support for real-time updates. Testing different scenarios helped me catch and fix many syncing issues.

Making the Database Work Smoothly:
Setting up the MySQL database in the cloud and ensuring secure, stable connections from the backend was harder than I expected. Managing credentials, preventing connection leaks, and handling multiple users at once took extra effort.
How I Got Over It: Using a managed database service simplified security and scaling. I also implemented connection pooling and carefully set environment variables to keep everything running reliably.

Balancing Detail and Simplicity:
I wanted to provide detailed explanations and interactive content, but I didn't want to overwhelm students with too much information or a complicated interface. Finding the right balance was challenging.
How I Got Over It: I gathered feedback from potential users and made the interface cleaner and more intuitive, breaking content into manageable sections and adding clear navigation.

Handling Video Content Integration:
Integrating suitable educational videos that align perfectly with each topic was tougher than expected. Sometimes video content didn’t quite match the lesson, which affected the learning flow.
How I Got Over It: I refined how videos are selected and linked, using better prompts and curating sources more carefully to ensure videos always supported the topic clearly.

These challenges pushed me to think critically and improve every part of the project, making it more reliable, user-friendly, and effective for learners

**Education**

My project fits perfectly into this track by addressing the core goal of enhancing education through technology-driven solutions. It combines interactive virtual laboratories with comprehensive lessons on science, financial literacy, and general knowledge—all delivered through an accessible online platform. This aligns with the track’s emphasis on innovative educational tools that make learning more engaging, practical, and inclusive.

By leveraging modern web technologies like Next.js and Python, along with features such as drag-and-drop interactivity and multimedia content integration, the project facilitates hands-on learning that can adapt to diverse student needs and learning environments. It supports both remote and in-person education, making quality educational resources available beyond traditional classroom settings.

Overall, this project advances the track’s mission by creating a scalable, user-friendly platform that empowers students with essential knowledge and skills, preparing them better for both academic and real-world challenges

**The problem it solves**

**CareQueue** is a map-first, community-based platform that aims to make healthcare clinics more accessible in local neighborhoods by giving users up-to-date information on queues, wait times, and availability. Patients can immediately see clinics around them on an interactive map, see current waiting times, ask for a slot, and even chat with the clinic staff for answers. **The platform also offers driving or walking directions to clinics, making the process easier for students, working professionals, and families who are in a new city**. Clinics, meanwhile, get an admin panel that is simple to operate and enables receptionists to manage queues, update wait times, tag priorities, and send notifications to patients. By synchronizing real-time updates with open communication, CareQueue decreases patient anxiety, avoids congestion, enhances efficiency in clinics, and creates a safe, inclusive healthcare environment that enables even small neighborhood clinics to engage in a city-wide digital network.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/carequeue-2dfb) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Satyamku88/CareQueue) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackBuild-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackbuild.devfolio.co)

> A Proposal to Revolutionize Local Clinic Access

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Maps API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Maps%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firestore](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firestore-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

For Patients

- Find nearby clinics instantly instead of relying on word-of-mouth or outdated websites.
- Know real-time wait times before leaving home, reducing wasted trips.
- Stress-free in emergencies – quickly identify which clinics are open and available.
- Direct communication with staff replaces confusing phone calls or unanswered queries.
- Anonymous check-ins make the process safer and more private.
- Multilingual support helps newcomers and students in unfamiliar cities.

🏥 For Clinics

- Efficient queue management reduces chaos at peak hours.
- Less receptionist overload – fewer repeated phone calls about waiting times.
- Real-time triage tagging ensures urgent patients are prioritized fairly.
- Better patient distribution across multiple clinics prevents overcrowding.
- Digital records and insights replace manual logs, helping with long-term planning.

🌍 For the Community

- Builds trust in local healthcare by making services transparent and reliable.
- Improves accessibility for underserved populations who need walk-in care.
- Strengthens the healthcare network by connecting clinics into one city-wide system.
- Saves time and resources for patients, clinics, and the community at large.

**Challenges we ran into**

**🔧 Technical Challenges**

Real-time queue synchronization

- Issue: Keeping patient apps and receptionist dashboards updated simultaneously without delays.
- Solution: Implemented WebSockets (Socket.io) for live updates instead of traditional REST polling.

Maps integration

- Issue: Displaying multiple clinics with dynamic wait-time overlays on the map.
- Solution: Used Google Maps / MapLibre APIs with custom markers and info windows showing queue length & status.

Multilingual support

- Issue: Many patients in new cities may not understand the default language.
- Solution: Integrated i18n (internationalization) libraries to support multiple languages seamlessly.

**🧑‍🤝‍🧑 User Experience Challenges**

Reducing receptionist workload

- Issue: Staff were concerned about spending extra time updating queues in the system.
- Solution: Designed a minimal, one-click interface for check-ins, check-outs, and delay updates.

Anonymous check-ins

- Issue: Balancing privacy while still keeping queue data accurate.
- Solution: Allowed patients to check in without personal info but linked updates to unique session IDs.
**
🚀 Deployment Challenges
**
Low-tech infrastructure in small clinics

- Issue: Some clinics had weak internet or only a single desktop.
- Solution: Built a lightweight web version of the admin panel that runs on any browser, even with limited connectivity.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Overview

CareQueue is an AI-powered healthcare assistant that streamlines the patient journey from symptom detection to recovery. It helps patients quickly identify their health issues, find the right clinic, manage appointments, and ensures recovery through automated post-treatment support.

3. Key Features

Patient Side

AI Symptom Checker (powered by GPT-4).

Smart Clinic Finder with wait times and directions.

Appointment booking + live queue tracking.

Chat with clinic staff.

WhatsApp AI Agent → medicine reminders, treatment summaries, recovery tracking.

Clinic Side

Dashboard for queue management and scheduling.

Real-time patient updates and emergency alerts.

Auto-generated visit summaries.

AI-assisted communication with patients.

4. Tech Stack

Frontend: React Native (Mobile), Next.js (Dashboard).

Backend: Node.js + Express with WebSockets.

AI: GPT-4 API (symptom analysis), Python microservice (clinic recommendation).

Database: MongoDB (records), Redis (queues).

Integrations: Google Maps API, WhatsApp Business API via Twilio.

Hosting: AWS ECS + S3, secure with JWT authentication & encryption.

5. Benefits

Patients → Faster clinic access, reduced waiting, proper recovery support.

Clinics → Smarter queue management, less admin work, better patient engagement.

Healthcare System → Digitised, scalable, secure records with real-time health insights.

6. Conclusion

CareQueue is more than a booking app — it is a complete healthcare ecosystem that ensures patients not only get treated but also fully recover, while helping clinics operate efficiently.

**Challenges we ran into**

Problems We Aim to Solve

For Patients

No clarity on symptoms → panic or delayed care.

Difficulty finding the right clinic or doctor.

Long, unpredictable waiting times.

Missed medicines and follow-up appointments.

For Clinics

Manual queue management and heavy admin workload.

Overcrowding at peak hours, underuse at others.

No automated patient follow-ups.
